verses.textZh: 哈迦利亚的儿子尼希米的言行录：亚达薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在书珊宫中，
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈迦利亚的儿子尼希米的言行录：亚达薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在书珊宫中，
verses.textZhCuv: 哈迦利亚的儿子尼希米的言语如下： 亚达薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在书珊城的宫中。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of Nehemiah son of Hakaliah: In the month of Kislev in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,
verses.textEnEsv: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now it happened in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the citadel,
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. It came to pass in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the citadel,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the memoirs of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah. In late autumn, in the month of Kislev, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes’ reign, I was at the fortress of Susa.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now it happened in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in Susa the capitol,
verses.textEn: The words of Nehemiah son of Hakaliah: In the month of Kislev in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,

verses.textZh: 我的一位兄弟哈拿尼和几个人一起从犹大来到；我询问他们关于那些从被掳逃脱的犹大余民和关于耶路撒冷的景况。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的一位兄弟哈拿尼和几个人一起从犹大来到；我询问他们关于那些从被掳逃脱的犹大余民和关于耶路撒冷的景况。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有我一个弟兄哈拿尼，同着几个人从犹大来。我问他们那些被掳归回、剩下逃脱的犹大人和耶路撒冷的光景。
verses.textEnNiv: Hanani, one of my brothers, came from Judah with some other men, and I questioned them about the Jewish remnant that had survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: that Hanani, one of my brothers, came with certain men from Judah. And I asked them concerning the Jews who escaped, who had survived the exile, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Hanani one of my brethren came with men from Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews who had escaped, who had survived the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Hanani, one of my brothers, came to visit me with some other men who had just arrived from Judah. I asked them about the Jews who had returned there from captivity and about how things were going in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: that Hanani, one of my brothers, and some men from Judah came; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped and had survived the captivity, and about Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Hanani, one of my brothers, came from Judah with some other men, and I questioned them about the Jewish remnant that had survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们对我说："那些从被掳剩下的余民，在犹大省那里遭遇大患难，受到凌辱。耶路撒冷的城墙倒塌，城门也被火烧毁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对我说："那些从被掳剩下的余民，在犹大省那里遭遇大患难，受到凌辱。耶路撒冷的城墙倒塌，城门也被火烧毁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对我说：「那些被掳归回剩下的人在犹大省遭大难，受凌辱；并且耶路撒冷的城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to me, "Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to me, "The remnant there in the province who had survived the exile is in great trouble and shame. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are destroyed by fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to me, "The survivors who are left from the captivity in the province are there in great distress and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire."
verses.textEnNlt: They said to me, "Things are not going well for those who returned to the province of Judah. They are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem has been torn down, and the gates have been destroyed by fire."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to me, "The remnant there in the province who survived the captivity are in great distress and disgrace, and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down and its gates have been burned with fire."
verses.textEn: They said to me, "Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire."

verses.textZh: 我听见了这些事，就坐下哭泣，悲伤了好几天，在天上的神面前禁食祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见了这些事，就坐下哭泣，悲伤了好几天，在天上的神面前禁食祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见这话，就坐下哭泣，悲哀几日，在天上的神面前禁食祈祷，说：
verses.textEnNiv: When I heard these things, I sat down and wept. For some days I mourned and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as I heard these words I sat down and wept and mourned for days, and I continued fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned formany days; I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: When I heard this, I sat down and wept. In fact, for days I mourned, fasted, and prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when I heard these words, I sat down and wept and mourned for days; and I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
verses.textEn: When I heard these things, I sat down and wept. For some days I mourned and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.

verses.textZh: 说："耶和华天上的神，伟大可畏的神啊，你向那些爱你，遵守你诫命的人，守约施慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："耶和华天上的神，伟大可畏的神啊，你向那些爱你，遵守你诫命的人，守约施慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－天上的神，大而可畏的神啊，你向爱你、守你诫命的人守约施慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said: " Lord , the God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,
verses.textEnEsv: And I said, "O Lord God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and steadfast love with those who love him and keep his commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said: "I pray, Lord God of heaven, O great and awesome God, You who keep Your covenant and mercy with those who love You and observe Your commandments,
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "O Lord , God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps his covenant of unfailing love with those who love him and obey his commands,
verses.textEnNasb: I said, "Please, Lord God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps the covenant and faithfulness for those who love Him and keep His commandments:
verses.textEn: Then I said: " Lord , the God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,

verses.textZh: 求你侧着耳，睁着眼的，垂听你仆人的祷告，我今天在你面前昼夜为着你的仆人以色列人祷告，承认以色列人所犯的罪，就是我与我父的家向你所犯的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你侧着耳，睁着眼的，垂听你仆人的祷告，我今天在你面前昼夜为着你的仆人以色列人祷告，承认以色列人所犯的罪，就是我与我父的家向你所犯的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你睁眼看，侧耳听，你仆人昼夜在你面前为你众仆人以色列民的祈祷，承认我们以色列人向你所犯的罪；我与我父家都有罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: let your ear be attentive and your eyes open to hear the prayer your servant is praying before you day and night for your servants, the people of Israel. I confess the sins we Israelites, including myself and my father’s family, have committed against you.
verses.textEnEsv: let your ear be attentive and your eyes open, to hear the prayer of your servant that I now pray before you day and night for the people of Israel your servants, confessing the sins of the people of Israel, which we have sinned against you. Even I and my father’s house have sinned.
verses.textEnNkjv: please let Your ear be attentive and Your eyes open, that You may hear the prayer of Your servant which I pray before You now, day and night, for the children of Israel Your servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against You. Both my father’s house and I have sinned.
verses.textEnNlt: listen to my prayer! Look down and see me praying night and day for your people Israel. I confess that we have sinned against you. Yes, even my own family and I have sinned!
verses.textEnNasb: let Your ear now be attentive and Your eyes open, to hear the prayer of Your servant which I am praying before You now, day and night, on behalf of the sons of Israel Your servants, confessing the sins of the sons of Israel which we have committed against You; I and my father’s house have sinned.
verses.textEn: let your ear be attentive and your eyes open to hear the prayer your servant is praying before you day and night for your servants, the people of Israel. I confess the sins we Israelites, including myself and my father’s family, have committed against you.

verses.textZh: 我们故意行极大的恶事得罪你，没有遵守你吩咐你仆人摩西的诫命、律例和典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们故意行极大的恶事得罪你，没有遵守你吩咐你仆人摩西的诫命、律例和典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们向你所行的甚是邪恶，没有遵守你藉着仆人摩西所吩咐的诫命、律例、典章。
verses.textEnNiv: We have acted very wickedly toward you. We have not obeyed the commands, decrees and laws you gave your servant Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: We have acted very corruptly against you and have not kept the commandments, the statutes, and the rules that you commanded your servant Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have acted very corruptly against You, and have not kept the commandments, the statutes, nor the ordinances which You commanded Your servant Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: We have sinned terribly by not obeying the commands, decrees, and regulations that you gave us through your servant Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: We have acted very corruptly against You and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances which You commanded Your servant Moses.
verses.textEn: We have acted very wickedly toward you. We have not obeyed the commands, decrees and laws you gave your servant Moses.

verses.textZh: 求你记念你吩咐你仆人摩西的话，说：‘你们若是不忠，我就把你们分散在万民中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念你吩咐你仆人摩西的话，说：‘你们若是不忠，我就把你们分散在万民中。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你记念所吩咐你仆人摩西的话，说：『你们若犯罪，我就把你们分散在万民中；
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember the instruction you gave your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember, I pray, the word that You commanded Your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations;
verses.textEnNlt: "Please remember what you told your servant Moses: ‘If you are unfaithful to me, I will scatter you among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, please, the word which You commanded Your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples;
verses.textEn: "Remember the instruction you gave your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,

verses.textZh: 但如果你们回心转意归向我，谨守遵行我的诫命，即使在你们被赶逐的天边，我也必从那里把他们招聚回来，带他们到我选择给我的名居住的地方那里去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果你们回心转意归向我，谨守遵行我的诫命，即使在你们被赶逐的天边，我也必从那里把他们招聚回来，带他们到我选择给我的名居住的地方那里去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们若归向我，谨守遵行我的诫命，你们被赶散的人虽在天涯，我也必从那里将他们招聚回来，带到我所选择立为我名的居所。』
verses.textEnNiv: but if you return to me and obey my commands, then even if your exiled people are at the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for my Name.’
verses.textEnEsv: but if you return to me and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of heaven, from there I will gather them and bring them to the place that I have chosen, to make my name dwell there.’
verses.textEnNkjv: but if you return to Me, and keep My commandments and do them, though some of you were cast out to the farthest part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and bring them to the place which I have chosen as a dwelling for My name.’
verses.textEnNlt: But if you return to me and obey my commands and live by them, then even if you are exiled to the ends of the earth, I will bring you back to the place I have chosen for my name to be honored.’
verses.textEnNasb: but if you return to Me and keep My commandments and do them, though those of you who have been scattered were in the most remote part of the heavens, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place where I have chosen to have My name dwell.’
verses.textEn: but if you return to me and obey my commands, then even if your exiled people are at the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for my Name.’

verses.textZh: 这些都是你的仆人，你的子民，是你用你的大能和你强而有力的手所救赎的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些都是你的仆人，你的子民，是你用你的大能和你强而有力的手所救赎的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是你的仆人、你的百姓，就是你用大力和大能的手所救赎的。
verses.textEnNiv: "They are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great strength and your mighty hand.
verses.textEnEsv: They are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are Your servants and Your people, whom You have redeemed by Your great power, and by Your strong hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people you rescued by your great power and strong hand are your servants.
verses.textEnNasb: They are Your servants and Your people whom You redeemed by Your great power and by Your strong hand.
verses.textEn: "They are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great strength and your mighty hand.

verses.textZh: 主啊，求你留意听你仆人的祷告，也听那些喜爱敬畏你名的仆人的祷告；求你使你的仆人今天顺利，使他在这人面前蒙怜悯。"那时我是王的酒政。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊，求你留意听你仆人的祷告，也听那些喜爱敬畏你名的仆人的祷告；求你使你的仆人今天顺利，使他在这人面前蒙怜悯。"那时我是王的酒政。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你侧耳听你仆人的祈祷，和喜爱敬畏你名众仆人的祈祷，使你仆人现今亨通，在王面前蒙恩。」 我是作王酒政的。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of this your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight in revering your name. Give your servant success today by granting him favor in the presence of this man." I was cupbearer to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name, and give success to your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man." Now I was cupbearer to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, I pray, please let Your ear be attentive to the prayer of Your servant, and to the prayer of Your servants who desire to fear Your name; and let Your servant prosper this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man." For I was the king’s cupbearer.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord, please hear my prayer! Listen to the prayers of those of us who delight in honoring you. Please grant me success today by making the king favorable to me. Put it into his heart to be kind to me." In those days I was the king’s cup-bearer.
verses.textEnNasb: Please, Lord, may Your ear be attentive to the prayer of Your servant and the prayer of Your servants who delight to revere Your name, and please make Your servant successful today and grant him mercy before this man." Now I was the cupbearer to the king.
verses.textEn: Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of this your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight in revering your name. Give your servant success today by granting him favor in the presence of this man." I was cupbearer to the king.

verses.textZh: 亚达薛西王二十年尼散月，王面前摆上了酒席，我拿酒来奉给王。我在他面前素来没有露出愁容。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚达薛西王二十年尼散月，王面前摆上了酒席，我拿酒来奉给王。我在他面前素来没有露出愁容。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚达薛西王二十年尼散月，在王面前摆酒，我拿起酒来奉给王。我素来在王面前没有愁容。
verses.textEnNiv: In the month of Nisan in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was brought for him, I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had not been sad in his presence before,
verses.textEnEsv: In the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was before him, I took up the wine and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad in his presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was before him, that I took the wine and gave it to the king. Now I had never been sad in his presence before.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the following spring, in the month of Nisan, during the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes’ reign, I was serving the king his wine. I had never before appeared sad in his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, that wine was before him, and I picked up the wine and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad in his presence.
verses.textEn: In the month of Nisan in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was brought for him, I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had not been sad in his presence before,

verses.textZh: 王却问我："你既然没有病，为甚么面带愁容呢？这没有别的可能，必是心中愁烦。"我就非常惧怕，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王却问我："你既然没有病，为甚么面带愁容呢？这没有别的可能，必是心中愁烦。"我就非常惧怕，
verses.textZhCuv: 王对我说：「你既没有病，为什么面带愁容呢？这不是别的，必是你心中愁烦。」于是我甚惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: so the king asked me, "Why does your face look so sad when you are not ill? This can be nothing but sadness of heart." I was very much afraid,
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to me, "Why is your face sad, seeing you are not sick? This is nothing but sadness of the heart." Then I was very much afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the king said to me, "Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing but sorrow of heart." So I became dreadfully afraid,
verses.textEnNlt: So the king asked me, "Why are you looking so sad? You don’t look sick to me. You must be deeply troubled." Then I was terrified,
verses.textEnNasb: So the king said to me, "Why is your face sad, though you are not ill? This is nothing but sadness of heart." Then I was very much afraid.
verses.textEn: so the king asked me, "Why does your face look so sad when you are not ill? This can be nothing but sadness of heart." I was very much afraid,

verses.textZh: 对王说："愿王万岁，我列祖坟墓所在的城成了荒芜之地，城门被火焚毁，我怎能不面带愁容呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对王说："愿王万岁，我列祖坟墓所在的城成了荒芜之地，城门被火焚毁，我怎能不面带愁容呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我对王说：「愿王万岁！我列祖坟墓所在的那城荒凉，城门被火焚烧，我岂能面无愁容吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: but I said to the king, "May the king live forever! Why should my face not look sad when the city where my ancestors are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?"
verses.textEnEsv: I said to the king, "Let the king live forever! Why should not my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ graves, lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to the king, "May the king live forever! Why should my face not be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire?"
verses.textEnNlt: but I replied, "Long live the king! How can I not be sad? For the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and the gates have been destroyed by fire."
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to the king, "May the king live forever. Why should my face not be sad when the city, the site of my fathers’ tombs, is desolate and its gates have been consumed by fire?"
verses.textEn: but I said to the king, "May the king live forever! Why should my face not look sad when the city where my ancestors are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?"

verses.textZh: 王问我："你想要甚么呢？"我就向天上的神祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王问我："你想要甚么呢？"我就向天上的神祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 王问我说：「你要求什么？」于是我默祷天上的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The king said to me, "What is it you want?" Then I prayed to the God of heaven,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king said to me, "What are you requesting?" So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to me, "What do you request?" So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: The king asked, "Well, how can I help you?" With a prayer to the God of heaven,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to me, " What would you request?" So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.textEn: The king said to me, "What is it you want?" Then I prayed to the God of heaven,

verses.textZh: 然后对王说："如果王认为好，仆人能在你面前蒙恩宠，就请你差派我往犹大，到我列祖坟墓所在的城去，让我重建那城。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对王说："如果王认为好，仆人能在你面前蒙恩宠，就请你差派我往犹大，到我列祖坟墓所在的城去，让我重建那城。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我对王说：「仆人若在王眼前蒙恩，王若喜欢，求王差遣我往犹大，到我列祖坟墓所在的那城去，我好重新建造。」
verses.textEnNiv: and I answered the king, "If it pleases the king and if your servant has found favor in his sight, let him send me to the city in Judah where my ancestors are buried so that I can rebuild it."
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, that you send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ graves, that I may rebuild it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may rebuild it."
verses.textEnNlt: I replied, "If it please the king, and if you are pleased with me, your servant, send me to Judah to rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor before you, I request that you send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may rebuild it."
verses.textEn: and I answered the king, "If it pleases the king and if your servant has found favor in his sight, let him send me to the city in Judah where my ancestors are buried so that I can rebuild it."

verses.textZh: 那时，王后坐在王的旁边。王问我："你的行程需时多久？你甚么时候回来？"王既然认为好，就差派我去，我也定了一个归期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，王后坐在王的旁边。王问我："你的行程需时多久？你甚么时候回来？"王既然认为好，就差派我去，我也定了一个归期。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时王后坐在王的旁边。王问我说：「你去要多少日子？几时回来？」我就定了日期。于是王喜欢差遣我去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king, with the queen sitting beside him, asked me, "How long will your journey take, and when will you get back?" It pleased the king to send me; so I set a time.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to me ( the queen sitting beside him), "How long will you be gone, and when will you return?" So it pleased the king to send me when I had given him a time.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to me (the queen also sitting beside him), "How long will your journey be? And when will you return?" So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.textEnNlt: The king, with the queen sitting beside him, asked, "How long will you be gone? When will you return?" After I told him how long I would be gone, the king agreed to my request.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to me, with the queen sitting beside him, "How long will your journey be, and when will you return?" So it pleased the king to send me, and I gave him a definite time.
verses.textEn: Then the king, with the queen sitting beside him, asked me, "How long will your journey take, and when will you get back?" It pleased the king to send me; so I set a time.

verses.textZh: 我又问王："王若是认为好，请赐给我诏书，通知河西那边的省长准我经过，直至我到达犹大；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又问王："王若是认为好，请赐给我诏书，通知河西那边的省长准我经过，直至我到达犹大；
verses.textZhCuv: 我又对王说：「王若喜欢，求王赐我诏书，通知大河西的省长准我经过，直到犹大；
verses.textEnNiv: I also said to him, "If it pleases the king, may I have letters to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, so that they will provide me safe-conduct until I arrive in Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors of the province Beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, let letters be given to me for the governors oftheregion beyond the River, that they must permit me to pass through till I come to Judah,
verses.textEnNlt: I also said to the king, "If it please the king, let me have letters addressed to the governors of the province west of the Euphrates River, instructing them to let me travel safely through their territories on my way to Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to the king, "If it pleases the king, let letters be given me for the governors of the provinces beyond the River, so that they will allow me to pass through until I come to Judah,
verses.textEn: I also said to him, "If it pleases the king, may I have letters to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, so that they will provide me safe-conduct until I arrive in Judah?

verses.textZh: 又赐诏书，给看守王的园林的亚萨，吩咐他给我木材，建造圣殿的营楼大门的横梁，以及建造城墙和我要入住的房屋。"因为我的神施恩的手帮助我，王就赐给我这一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又赐诏书，给看守王的园林的亚萨，吩咐他给我木材，建造圣殿的营楼大门的横梁，以及建造城墙和我要入住的房屋。"因为我的神施恩的手帮助我，王就赐给我这一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 又赐诏书，通知管理王园林的亚萨，使他给我木料，做属殿营楼之门的横梁和城墙，与我自己房屋使用的。」王就允准我，因我神施恩的手帮助我。
verses.textEnNiv: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the royal park, so he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple and for the city wall and for the residence I will occupy?" And because the gracious hand of my God was on me, the king granted my requests.
verses.textEnEsv: and a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the fortress of the temple, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall occupy." And the king granted me what I asked, for the good hand of my God was upon me.
verses.textEnNkjv: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he must give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel which pertains to the temple, for the city wall, and for the house that I will occupy." And the king granted them to me according to the good hand of my God upon me.
verses.textEnNlt: And please give me a letter addressed to Asaph, the manager of the king’s forest, instructing him to give me timber. I will need it to make beams for the gates of the Temple fortress, for the city walls, and for a house for myself." And the king granted these requests, because the gracious hand of God was on me.
verses.textEnNasb: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, so that he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel which is by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house to which I will go." And the king granted them to me because the good hand of my God was on me.
verses.textEn: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the royal park, so he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple and for the city wall and for the residence I will occupy?" And because the gracious hand of my God was on me, the king granted my requests.

verses.textZh: 于是我到了河西那边的省长那里去，把王的诏书交给他们；王又派了军长和马兵护送我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我到了河西那边的省长那里去，把王的诏书交给他们；王又派了军长和马兵护送我。
verses.textZhCuv: 王派了军长和马兵护送我。我到了河西的省长那里，将王的诏书交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So I went to the governors of Trans-Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I came to the governors of the province Beyond the River and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent with me officers of the army and horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I went to the governors intheregion beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
verses.textEnNlt: When I came to the governors of the province west of the Euphrates River, I delivered the king’s letters to them. The king, I should add, had sent along army officers and horsemen to protect me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I came to the governors of the provinces beyond the Euphrates River and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent with me officers of the army and horsemen.
verses.textEn: So I went to the governors of Trans-Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.

verses.textZh: 和伦人参巴拉和作臣仆的亚扪人多比雅听见有人来到，要为以色列求利益，他们就非常恼怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和伦人参巴拉和作臣仆的亚扪人多比雅听见有人来到，要为以色列求利益，他们就非常恼怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 和伦人参巴拉，并为奴的亚扪人多比雅，听见有人来为以色列人求好处，就甚恼怒。
verses.textEnNiv: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were very much disturbed that someone had come to promote the welfare of the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard this, it displeased them greatly that someone had come to seek the welfare of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard ofit, they were deeply disturbed that a man had come to seek the well-being of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard of my arrival, they were very displeased that someone had come to help the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about it, it was very displeasing to them that someone had come to seek the welfare of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were very much disturbed that someone had come to promote the welfare of the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那里停留了三天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那里停留了三天。
verses.textZhCuv: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三日。
verses.textEnNiv: I went to Jerusalem, and after staying there three days
verses.textEnEsv: So I went to Jerusalem and was there three days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I came to Jerusalem and was there three days.
verses.textEnNlt: So I arrived in Jerusalem. Three days later,
verses.textEnNasb: So I came to Jerusalem and was there for three days.
verses.textEn: I went to Jerusalem, and after staying there three days

verses.textZh: 我在夜间起来，和几个人一起出去，我没有告诉任何人我的神使我定意要为耶路撒冷作的事，除了我所骑的一头牲口以外，没有带着别的牲口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在夜间起来，和几个人一起出去，我没有告诉任何人我的神使我定意要为耶路撒冷作的事，除了我所骑的一头牲口以外，没有带着别的牲口。
verses.textZhCuv: 我夜间起来，有几个人也一同起来；但神使我心里要为耶路撒冷做什么事，我并没有告诉人。除了我骑的牲口以外，也没有别的牲口在我那里。
verses.textEnNiv: I set out during the night with a few others. I had not told anyone what my God had put in my heart to do for Jerusalem. There were no mounts with me except the one I was riding on.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. And I told no one what my God had put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There was no animal with me but the one on which I rode.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I arose in the night, I and a few men with me; I told no one what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem; nor was there any animal with me, except the one on which I rode.
verses.textEnNlt: I slipped out during the night, taking only a few others with me. I had not told anyone about the plans God had put in my heart for Jerusalem. We took no pack animals with us except the donkey I was riding.
verses.textEnNasb: And I got up in the night, I and a few men with me. I did not tell anyone what my God was putting into my mind to do for Jerusalem, and there was no animal with me except the animal on which I was riding.
verses.textEn: I set out during the night with a few others. I had not told anyone what my God had put in my heart to do for Jerusalem. There were no mounts with me except the one I was riding on.

verses.textZh: 我夜间出了谷门，向着龙泉走去，到了粪门，视察耶路撒冷破坏了的城墙和被火焚毁的城门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我夜间出了谷门，向着龙泉走去，到了粪门，视察耶路撒冷破坏了的城墙和被火焚毁的城门。
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜我出了谷门，往野狗井去 ，到了粪厂门，察看耶路撒冷的城墙，见城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: By night I went out through the Valley Gate toward the Jackal Well and the Dung Gate, examining the walls of Jerusalem, which had been broken down, and its gates, which had been destroyed by fire.
verses.textEnEsv: I went out by night by the Valley Gate to the Dragon Spring and to the Dung Gate, and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem that were broken down and its gates that had been destroyed by fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I went out by night through the Valley Gate to the Serpent Well and the Refuse Gate, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem which were broken down and its gates which were burned with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: After dark I went out through the Valley Gate, past the Jackal’s Well, and over to the Dung Gate to inspect the broken walls and burned gates.
verses.textEnNasb: So I went out at night by the Valley Gate in the direction of the Dragon’s Spring and on to the Dung Gate, and I was inspecting the walls of Jerusalem which were broken down and its gates which had been consumed by fire.
verses.textEn: By night I went out through the Valley Gate toward the Jackal Well and the Dung Gate, examining the walls of Jerusalem, which had been broken down, and its gates, which had been destroyed by fire.

verses.textZh: 我又往前走，到了泉门和王池，因为地方不够让我骑着牲口过去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又往前走，到了泉门和王池，因为地方不够让我骑着牲口过去，
verses.textZhCuv: 我又往前，到了泉门和王池，但所骑的牲口没有地方过去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I moved on toward the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was not enough room for my mount to get through;
verses.textEnEsv: Then I went on to the Fountain Gate and to the King’s Pool, but there was no room for the animal that was under me to pass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I went on to the Fountain Gate and to the King’s Pool, but therewas no room for the animal under me to pass.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I went to the Fountain Gate and to the King’s Pool, but my donkey couldn’t get through the rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I passed on to the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was no place for my mount to pass.
verses.textEn: Then I moved on toward the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was not enough room for my mount to get through;

verses.textZh: 我只得在夜间沿溪而上，视察城墙，然后转回，经过谷门，回到城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我只得在夜间沿溪而上，视察城墙，然后转回，经过谷门，回到城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是夜间沿溪而上，察看城墙，又转身进入谷门，就回来了。
verses.textEnNiv: so I went up the valley by night, examining the wall. Finally, I turned back and reentered through the Valley Gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I went up in the night by the valley and inspected the wall, and I turned back and entered by the Valley Gate, and so returned.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I went up in the night by the valley, and viewed the wall; then I turned back and entered by the Valley Gate, and so returned.
verses.textEnNlt: So, though it was still dark, I went up the Kidron Valley instead, inspecting the wall before I turned back and entered again at the Valley Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: So I was going up at night by the ravine and inspecting the wall. Then I entered the Valley Gate again and returned.
verses.textEn: so I went up the valley by night, examining the wall. Finally, I turned back and reentered through the Valley Gate.

verses.textZh: 没有一个官长知道我去过甚么地方，作了甚么事。我也一直没有告诉犹大人、或祭司、或贵胄、或官长，或其余作工的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有一个官长知道我去过甚么地方，作了甚么事。我也一直没有告诉犹大人、或祭司、或贵胄、或官长，或其余作工的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我往哪里去，我做什么事，官长都不知道。我还没有告诉犹大平民、祭司、贵胄、官长，和其余做工的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, because as yet I had said nothing to the Jews or the priests or nobles or officials or any others who would be doing the work.
verses.textEnEsv: And the officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, and I had not yet told the Jews, the priests, the nobles, the officials, and the rest who were to do the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the officials did not know where I had gone or what I had done; I had not yet told the Jews, the priests, the nobles, the officials, or the others who did the work.
verses.textEnNlt: The city officials did not know I had been out there or what I was doing, for I had not yet said anything to anyone about my plans. I had not yet spoken to the Jewish leaders—the priests, the nobles, the officials, or anyone else in the administration.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing; nor had I as yet told the Jews, the priests, the nobles, the officials, or the rest who were doing the work.
verses.textEn: The officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, because as yet I had said nothing to the Jews or the priests or nobles or officials or any others who would be doing the work.

verses.textZh: 后来我对他们说："你们都看见我们遭遇的患难：耶路撒冷成了荒芜之地，城门被火焚毁，你们都来吧！让我们重建耶路撒冷的城墙，免得我们再受凌辱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来我对他们说："你们都看见我们遭遇的患难：耶路撒冷成了荒芜之地，城门被火焚毁，你们都来吧！让我们重建耶路撒冷的城墙，免得我们再受凌辱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以后，我对他们说：「我们所遭的难，耶路撒冷怎样荒凉，城门被火焚烧，你们都看见了。来吧，我们重建耶路撒冷的城墙，免得再受凌辱！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said to them, "You see the trouble we are in: Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be in disgrace."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said to them, "You see the trouble we are in, how Jerusalem lies in ruins with its gates burned. Come, let us build the wall of Jerusalem, that we may no longer suffer derision."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said to them, "You see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come and let us build the wall of Jerusalem, that we may no longer be a reproach."
verses.textEnNlt: But now I said to them, "You know very well what trouble we are in. Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire. Let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem and end this disgrace!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to them, "You see the bad situation we are in, that Jerusalem is desolate and its gates have been burned by fire. Come, let’s rebuild the wall of Jerusalem so that we will no longer be a disgrace."
verses.textEn: Then I said to them, "You see the trouble we are in: Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be in disgrace."

verses.textZh: 我告诉他们，我的神施恩的手怎样帮助我，以及王对我所说的话；他们就说："我们要起来建造！"于是他们奋勇着手作这善工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我告诉他们，我的神施恩的手怎样帮助我，以及王对我所说的话；他们就说："我们要起来建造！"于是他们奋勇着手作这善工。
verses.textZhCuv: 我告诉他们我神施恩的手怎样帮助我，并王对我所说的话。他们就说：「我们起来建造吧！」于是他们奋勇做这善工。
verses.textEnNiv: I also told them about the gracious hand of my God on me and what the king had said to me. They replied, "Let us start rebuilding." So they began this good work.
verses.textEnEsv: And I told them of the hand of my God that had been upon me for good, and also of the words that the king had spoken to me. And they said, "Let us rise up and build." So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I told them of the hand of my God which had been good upon me, and also of the king’s words that he had spoken to me. So they said, "Let us rise up and build." Then they set their hands to this good work.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I told them about how the gracious hand of God had been on me, and about my conversation with the king. They replied at once, "Yes, let’s rebuild the wall!" So they began the good work.
verses.textEnNasb: And I told them how the hand of my God had been favorable to me and also about the king’s words which he had spoken to me. Then they said, "Let’s arise and build." So they put their hands to the good work.
verses.textEn: I also told them about the gracious hand of my God on me and what the king had said to me. They replied, "Let us start rebuilding." So they began this good work.

verses.textZh: 但和伦人参巴拉和作臣仆的亚扪人多比雅，以及阿拉伯人基善听见了，就讥笑我们，藐视我们，说："你们在干甚么？你们要背叛王吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但和伦人参巴拉和作臣仆的亚扪人多比雅，以及阿拉伯人基善听见了，就讥笑我们，藐视我们，说："你们在干甚么？你们要背叛王吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 但和伦人参巴拉，并为奴的亚扪人多比雅和阿拉伯人基善听见就嗤笑我们，藐视我们，说：「你们做什么呢？要背叛王吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked and ridiculed us. "What is this you are doing?" they asked. "Are you rebelling against the king?"
verses.textEnEsv: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant and Geshem the Arab heard of it, they jeered at us and despised us and said, "What is this thing that you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official, and Geshem the Arab heard ofit, they laughed at us and despised us, and said, "What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?"
verses.textEnNlt: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard of our plan, they scoffed contemptuously. "What are you doing? Are you rebelling against the king?" they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official, and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked us and despised us, and said, "What is this thing that you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?"
verses.textEn: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked and ridiculed us. "What is this you are doing?" they asked. "Are you rebelling against the king?"

verses.textZh: 我回答他们说："天上的神必使我们成功；我们是他的仆人，我们要起来建造，但你们在耶路撒冷无分、无权，无人记念。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回答他们说："天上的神必使我们成功；我们是他的仆人，我们要起来建造，但你们在耶路撒冷无分、无权，无人记念。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我回答他们说：「天上的神必使我们亨通。我们作他仆人的，要起来建造；你们却在耶路撒冷无分、无权、无纪念。」
verses.textEnNiv: I answered them by saying, "The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I replied to them, "The God of heaven will make us prosper, and we his servants will arise and build, but you have no portion or right or claim in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I answered them, and said to them, "The God of heaven Himself will prosper us; therefore we His servants will arise and build, but you have no heritage or right or memorial in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNlt: I replied, "The God of heaven will help us succeed. We, his servants, will start rebuilding this wall. But you have no share, legal right, or historic claim in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNasb: So I answered them and said to them, "The God of heaven will make us successful; therefore we His servants will arise and build, but you have no part, right, or memorial in Jerusalem."
verses.textEn: I answered them by saying, "The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it."

verses.textZh: 那时，大祭司以利亚实起来，和他一起作祭司的众兄弟都起来，重建了羊门；他们装上门扇，就把它分别为圣，又建造城墙，直到哈米亚城楼和哈楠业城楼，把城分别为圣；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，大祭司以利亚实起来，和他一起作祭司的众兄弟都起来，重建了羊门；他们装上门扇，就把它分别为圣，又建造城墙，直到哈米亚城楼和哈楠业城楼，把城分别为圣；
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，大祭司以利亚实和他的弟兄众祭司起来建立羊门，分别为圣，安立门扇，又筑城墙到哈米亚楼，直到哈楠业楼，分别为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests went to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set its doors in place, building as far as the Tower of the Hundred, which they dedicated, and as far as the Tower of Hananel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the Sheep Gate. They consecrated it and set its doors. They consecrated it as far as the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Tower of Hananel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests and built the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and hung its doors. They built as far as the Tower of the Hundred, and consecrated it, then as far as the Tower of Hananel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eliashib the high priest and the other priests started to rebuild at the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set up its doors, building the wall as far as the Tower of the Hundred, which they dedicated, and the Tower of Hananel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eliashib the high priest arose with his brothers the priests and built the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and installed its doors. They consecrated the wall to the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel.
verses.textEn: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests went to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set its doors in place, building as far as the Tower of the Hundred, which they dedicated, and as far as the Tower of Hananel.

verses.textZh: 接着的一段由耶利哥人建造；再接着的一段由音利的儿子撒刻建造。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着的一段由耶利哥人建造；再接着的一段由音利的儿子撒刻建造。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是耶利哥人建造。其次是音利的儿子撒刻建造。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Jericho built the adjoining section, and Zakkur son of Imri built next to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And next to him the men of Jericho built. And next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
verses.textEnNkjv: Next to Eliashib the men of Jericho built. And next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
verses.textEnNlt: People from the town of Jericho worked next to them, and beyond them was Zaccur son of Imri.
verses.textEnNasb: And next to him the men of Jericho built, and next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.
verses.textEn: The men of Jericho built the adjoining section, and Zakkur son of Imri built next to them.

verses.textZh: 哈西拿的子孙建造鱼门，他们安置横梁，装上门扇、门插和门闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈西拿的子孙建造鱼门，他们安置横梁，装上门扇、门插和门闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈西拿的子孙建立鱼门，架横梁、安门扇，和闩锁。
verses.textEnNiv: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They laid its beams and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate; they laid its beams and hung its doors with its bolts and bars.
verses.textEnNlt: The Fish Gate was built by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid the beams, set up its doors, and installed its bolts and bars.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate; they laid its beams and installed its doors with its bolts and bars.
verses.textEn: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.

verses.textZh: 接着的一段由哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修筑；再接着的一段由米示萨别的孙子、比利迦的儿子米书兰修筑；再接着的一段由巴拿的儿子撒督修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着的一段由哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修筑；再接着的一段由米示萨别的孙子、比利迦的儿子米书兰修筑；再接着的一段由巴拿的儿子撒督修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修造。其次是米示萨别的孙子、比利迦的儿子米书兰修造。其次是巴拿的儿子撒督修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired the next section. Next to him Meshullam son of Berekiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs, and next to him Zadok son of Baana also made repairs.
verses.textEnEsv: And next to them Meremoth the son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz repaired. And next to them Meshullam the son of Berechiah, son of Meshezabel repaired. And next to them Zadok the son of Baana repaired.
verses.textEnNkjv: And next to them Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz, made repairs. Next to them Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs. Next to them Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Meremoth son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz repaired the next section of wall. Beside him were Meshullam son of Berekiah and grandson of Meshezabel, and then Zadok son of Baana.
verses.textEnNasb: Next to them Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz made repairs. And next to him Meshullam the son of Berechiah the son of Meshezabel made repairs. And next to him Zadok the son of Baana also made repairs.
verses.textEn: Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired the next section. Next to him Meshullam son of Berekiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs, and next to him Zadok son of Baana also made repairs.

verses.textZh: 接着这一段的是由提哥亚人修筑；但是他们的贵族不愿肩负他们的主的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着这一段的是由提哥亚人修筑；但是他们的贵族不愿肩负他们的主的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是提哥亚人修造；但是他们的贵胄不用肩 担他们主的工作。
verses.textEnNiv: The next section was repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their nobles would not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.
verses.textEnEsv: And next to them the Tekoites repaired, but their nobles would not stoop to serve their Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Next to them the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work of their Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Next were the people from Tekoa, though their leaders refused to work with the construction supervisors.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, next to him the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not support the work of their masters.
verses.textEn: The next section was repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their nobles would not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.

verses.textZh: 巴西亚的儿子耶何耶大和比所玳的儿子米书兰修筑古门；他们安置横梁，装上门扇、门插和门闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴西亚的儿子耶何耶大和比所玳的儿子米书兰修筑古门；他们安置横梁，装上门扇、门插和门闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴西亚的儿子耶何耶大与比所玳的儿子米书兰修造古门，架横梁，安门扇和闩锁。
verses.textEnNiv: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.
verses.textEnEsv: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the Gate of Yeshanah. They laid its beams and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Jehoiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the Old Gate; they laid its beams and hung its doors, with its bolts and bars.
verses.textEnNlt: The Old City Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid the beams, set up its doors, and installed its bolts and bars.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the Ancient Gate; they laid its beams and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars.
verses.textEn: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.

verses.textZh: 接着的一段由基遍人米拉提、米仑人雅顿、基遍人和河西那边省长所管辖的米斯巴人修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着的一段由基遍人米拉提、米仑人雅顿、基遍人和河西那边省长所管辖的米斯巴人修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是基遍人米拉提，米伦人雅顿与基遍人，并属河西总督所管的米斯巴人修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to them, repairs were made by men from Gibeon and Mizpah—Melatiah of Gibeon and Jadon of Meronoth—places under the authority of the governor of Trans-Euphrates.
verses.textEnEsv: And next to them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, the seat of the governor of the province Beyond the River.
verses.textEnNkjv: And next to them Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor oftheregion beyond the River.
verses.textEnNlt: Next to them were Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, people from Gibeon, and people from Mizpah, the headquarters of the governor of the province west of the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: Next to them Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, also made repairs for the official seat of the governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River.
verses.textEn: Next to them, repairs were made by men from Gibeon and Mizpah—Melatiah of Gibeon and Jadon of Meronoth—places under the authority of the governor of Trans-Euphrates.

verses.textZh: 再接着的一段由金匠哈海雅的儿子乌薛修筑。接着这一段的是由作香料的哈拿尼雅修筑。他们修葺耶路撒冷的城墙，直到宽墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再接着的一段由金匠哈海雅的儿子乌薛修筑。接着这一段的是由作香料的哈拿尼雅修筑。他们修葺耶路撒冷的城墙，直到宽墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是银匠哈海雅的儿子乌薛修造。其次是做香的哈拿尼雅修造。这些人修坚耶路撒冷，直到宽墙。
verses.textEnNiv: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired the next section; and Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, made repairs next to that. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
verses.textEnEsv: Next to them Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, repaired. Next to him Hananiah, one of the perfumers, repaired, and they restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Next to him Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs. Also next to him Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs; and they fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
verses.textEnNlt: Next was Uzziel son of Harhaiah, a goldsmith by trade, who also worked on the wall. Beyond him was Hananiah, a manufacturer of perfumes. They left out a section of Jerusalem as they built the Broad Wall.
verses.textEnNasb: Next to him Uzziel the son of Harhaiah of the goldsmiths made repairs. And next to him Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
verses.textEn: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired the next section; and Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, made repairs next to that. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

verses.textZh: 接着的一段由管理半个耶路撒冷的区长，户珥的儿子利法雅修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着的一段由管理半个耶路撒冷的区长，户珥的儿子利法雅修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是管理耶路撒冷一半、户珥的儿子利法雅修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section.
verses.textEnEsv: Next to them Rephaiah the son of Hur, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired.
verses.textEnNkjv: And next to them Rephaiah the son of Hur, leader of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Rephaiah son of Hur, the leader of half the district of Jerusalem, was next to them on the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: And next to them Rephaiah the son of Hur, the official of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
verses.textEn: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section.

verses.textZh: 再接着的一段由哈路抹的儿子耶大雅修筑，就是他自己房屋对面的那段。接着这一段的是由哈沙尼的儿子哈突修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再接着的一段由哈路抹的儿子耶大雅修筑，就是他自己房屋对面的那段。接着这一段的是由哈沙尼的儿子哈突修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是哈路抹的儿子耶大雅对着自己的房屋修造。其次是哈沙尼的儿子哈突修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Adjoining this, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house, and Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs next to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Next to them Jedaiah the son of Harumaph repaired opposite his house. And next to him Hattush the son of Hashabneiah repaired.
verses.textEnNkjv: Next to them Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs in front of his house. And next to him Hattush the son of Hashabniah made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Jedaiah son of Harumaph repaired the wall across from his own house, and next to him was Hattush son of Hashabneiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Next to them Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house. And next to him Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
verses.textEn: Adjoining this, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house, and Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs next to him.

verses.textZh: 哈琳的儿子玛基雅和巴哈．摩押的儿子哈述修筑另一段城墙和炉楼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈琳的儿子玛基雅和巴哈．摩押的儿子哈述修筑另一段城墙和炉楼。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈琳的儿子玛基雅和巴哈‧摩押的儿子哈述修造一段，并修造炉楼。
verses.textEnNiv: Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.
verses.textEnEsv: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahath-moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.
verses.textEnNkjv: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hashub the son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section, as well as the Tower of the Ovens.
verses.textEnNlt: Then came Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab, who repaired another section of the wall and the Tower of the Ovens.
verses.textEnNasb: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahath-moab repaired another section and the Tower of Furnaces.
verses.textEn: Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.

verses.textZh: 接着的一段由管理半个耶路撒冷的区长哈罗黑的儿子沙龙和他的女儿们修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着的一段由管理半个耶路撒冷的区长哈罗黑的儿子沙龙和他的女儿们修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是管理耶路撒冷那一半、哈罗黑的儿子沙龙和他的女儿们修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section with the help of his daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Next to him Shallum the son of Hallohesh, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired, he and his daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And next to him was Shallum the son of Hallohesh, leader of half the district of Jerusalem; he and his daughters made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Shallum son of Hallohesh and his daughters repaired the next section. He was the leader of the other half of the district of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Next to him Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the official of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs, he and his daughters.
verses.textEn: Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section with the help of his daughters.

verses.textZh: 哈嫩和撒挪亚城的居民修筑谷门。他们重建那门，装上门扇、门插和门闩；又修筑城墙四百四十公尺，直至粪门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈嫩和撒挪亚城的居民修筑谷门。他们重建那门，装上门扇、门插和门闩；又修筑城墙四百四十公尺，直至粪门。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈嫩和撒挪亚的居民修造谷门，立门，安门扇和闩锁，又建筑城墙一千肘，直到粪厂门。
verses.textEnNiv: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place. They also repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate. They rebuilt it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and repaired a thousand cubits of the wall, as far as the Dung Gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate. They built it, hung its doors with its bolts and bars, and repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Refuse Gate.
verses.textEnNlt: The Valley Gate was repaired by the people from Zanoah, led by Hanun. They set up its doors and installed its bolts and bars. They also repaired the 1,500 feet of wall to the Dung Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate. They built it and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars, and a thousand cubits of the wall to the Dung Gate.
verses.textEn: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place. They also repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.

verses.textZh: 粪门是由管理伯．哈基琳的区长，利甲的儿子玛基雅修筑；他重建那门，装上门扇、门插和门闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 粪门是由管理伯．哈基琳的区长，利甲的儿子玛基雅修筑；他重建那门，装上门扇、门插和门闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 管理伯‧哈基琳、利甲的儿子玛基雅修造粪厂门，立门，安门扇和闩锁。
verses.textEnNiv: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malkijah son of Rekab, ruler of the district of Beth Hakkerem. He rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.
verses.textEnEsv: Malchijah the son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem, repaired the Dung Gate. He rebuilt it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Malchijah the son of Rechab, leader of the district of Beth Haccerem, repaired the Refuse Gate; he built it and hung its doors with its bolts and bars.
verses.textEnNlt: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malkijah son of Recab, the leader of the Beth-hakkerem district. He rebuilt it, set up its doors, and installed its bolts and bars.
verses.textEnNasb: And Malchijah the son of Rechab, the official of the district of Beth-haccherem repaired the Dung Gate. He built it and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars.
verses.textEn: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malkijah son of Rekab, ruler of the district of Beth Hakkerem. He rebuilt it and put its doors with their bolts and bars in place.

verses.textZh: 管理米斯巴的区长各荷西的儿子沙仑修筑泉门。他重建那门，加盖门顶，装上门扇、门插和门闩；又重建靠近王园的西罗亚池的城墙，直到从大卫城下来的台阶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理米斯巴的区长各荷西的儿子沙仑修筑泉门。他重建那门，加盖门顶，装上门扇、门插和门闩；又重建靠近王园的西罗亚池的城墙，直到从大卫城下来的台阶。
verses.textZhCuv: 管理米斯巴、各荷西的儿子沙仑修造泉门，立门，盖门顶，安门扇和闩锁，又修造靠近王园西罗亚池的墙垣，直到那从大卫城下来的台阶。
verses.textEnNiv: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Kol-Hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofing it over and putting its doors and bolts and bars in place. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Siloam, by the King’s Garden, as far as the steps going down from the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shallum the son of Col-hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate. He rebuilt it and covered it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars. And he built the wall of the Pool of Shelah of the king’s garden, as far as the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shallun the son of Col-Hozeh, leader of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate; he built it, covered it, hung its doors with its bolts and bars, and repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah by the King’s Garden, as far as the stairs that go down from the City of David.
verses.textEnNlt: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallum son of Col-hozeh, the leader of the Mizpah district. He rebuilt it, roofed it, set up its doors, and installed its bolts and bars. Then he repaired the wall of the pool of Siloam near the king’s garden, and he rebuilt the wall as far as the stairs that descend from the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Shallum the son of Col-hozeh, the official of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate. He built it, made a roof for it, and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars, and the wall of the Pool of Shelah at the king’s garden as far as the steps that descend from the city of David.
verses.textEn: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Kol-Hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofing it over and putting its doors and bolts and bars in place. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Siloam, by the King’s Garden, as far as the steps going down from the City of David.

verses.textZh: 下一段由管理半个伯．夙的区长，押卜的儿子尼希米修筑，直到大卫墓地的对面，又到人工池和勇士之家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下一段由管理半个伯．夙的区长，押卜的儿子尼希米修筑，直到大卫墓地的对面，又到人工池和勇士之家。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是管理伯‧夙一半、押卜的儿子尼希米修造，直到大卫坟地的对面，又到挖成的池子，并勇士的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth Zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Heroes.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, ruler of half the district of Beth-zur, repaired to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool, and as far as the house of the mighty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, leader of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs as far as theplace in front of the tombs of David, to the man-made pool, and as far as the House of the Mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: Next to him was Nehemiah son of Azbuk, the leader of half the district of Beth-zur. He rebuilt the wall from a place across from the tombs of David’s family as far as the water reservoir and the House of the Warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: After him Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, official of half the district of Beth-zur, made repairs as far as a point opposite the tombs of David, and as far as the artificial pool and the house of the mighty men.
verses.textEn: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth Zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Heroes.

verses.textZh: 再下一段由利未人巴尼的儿子利宏修筑；接着的一段由管理半个基伊拉的区长哈沙比雅为他本区修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再下一段由利未人巴尼的儿子利宏修筑；接着的一段由管理半个基伊拉的区长哈沙比雅为他本区修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是利未人巴尼的儿子利宏修造。其次是管理基伊拉一半、哈沙比雅为他所管的本境修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, the repairs were made by the Levites under Rehum son of Bani. Beside him, Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.
verses.textEnEsv: After him the Levites repaired: Rehum the son of Bani. Next to him Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, repaired for his district.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him the Levites, under Rehum the son of Bani, made repairs. Next to him Hashabiah, leader of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
verses.textEnNlt: Next to him, repairs were made by a group of Levites working under the supervision of Rehum son of Bani. Then came Hashabiah, the leader of half the district of Keilah, who supervised the building of the wall on behalf of his own district.
verses.textEnNasb: After him the Levites carried out repairs under Rehum the son of Bani. Next to him Hashabiah, the official of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.
verses.textEn: Next to him, the repairs were made by the Levites under Rehum son of Bani. Beside him, Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.

verses.textZh: 下一段由他们的兄弟，管理另一半基伊拉的区长，希拿达的儿子宾内 修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下一段由他们的兄弟，管理另一半基伊拉的区长，希拿达的儿子宾内 修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是利未人弟兄中管理基伊拉那一半、希拿达的儿子巴瓦伊修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, the repairs were made by their fellow Levites under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.
verses.textEnEsv: After him their brothers repaired: Bavvai the son of Henadad, ruler of half the district of Keilah.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him their brethren, under Bavai the son of Henadad, leader of the other half of the district of Keilah, made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Next down the line were his countrymen led by Binnui son of Henadad, the leader of the other half of the district of Keilah.
verses.textEnNasb: After him their brothers carried out repairs under Bavvai the son of Henadad, official of the other half of the district of Keilah.
verses.textEn: Next to him, the repairs were made by their fellow Levites under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.

verses.textZh: 管理米斯巴的区长耶书亚的儿子以谢修筑接着的一段，对着军械库的斜坡、城墙转角的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管理米斯巴的区长耶书亚的儿子以谢修筑接着的一段，对着军械库的斜坡、城墙转角的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是管理米斯巴、耶书亚的儿子以谢修造一段，对着武库的上坡、城墙转弯之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section, from a point facing the ascent to the armory as far as the angle of the wall.
verses.textEnEsv: Next to him Ezer the son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section opposite the ascent to the armory at the buttress.
verses.textEnNkjv: And next to him Ezer the son of Jeshua, the leader of Mizpah, repaired another section in front of the Ascent to the Armory at the buttress.
verses.textEnNlt: Next to them, Ezer son of Jeshua, the leader of Mizpah, repaired another section of wall across from the ascent to the armory near the angle in the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: And next to him Ezer the son of Jeshua, the official of Mizpah, repaired another section in front of the ascent of the armory at the Angle.
verses.textEn: Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section, from a point facing the ascent to the armory as far as the angle of the wall.

verses.textZh: 下一段，就是萨拜的儿子巴录竭力修筑的另一段，从城墙转角的地方，直到大祭司以利亚实住宅的门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下一段，就是萨拜的儿子巴录竭力修筑的另一段，从城墙转角的地方，直到大祭司以利亚实住宅的门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是萨拜的儿子巴录竭力修造一段，从城墙转弯，直到大祭司以利亚实的府门。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the angle to the entrance of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai repaired another section from the buttress to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai carefully repaired the other section, from the buttress to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Next to him was Baruch son of Zabbai, who zealously repaired an additional section from the angle to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.textEnNasb: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the Angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.textEn: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the angle to the entrance of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

verses.textZh: 再下一段，就是哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修筑的另一段，从以利亚实住宅的门口，直到以利亚实住宅的尽头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再下一段，就是哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修筑的另一段，从以利亚实住宅的门口，直到以利亚实住宅的尽头。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修造一段，从以利亚实的府门，直到以利亚实府的尽头。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the entrance of Eliashib’s house to the end of it.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Meremoth the son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz repaired another section from the door of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz, repaired another section, from the door of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.textEnNlt: Meremoth son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz rebuilt another section of the wall extending from the door of Eliashib’s house to the end of the house.
verses.textEnNasb: After him Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another section, from the doorway of Eliashib’s house even as far as the end of his house.
verses.textEn: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the entrance of Eliashib’s house to the end of it.

verses.textZh: 这一段之后是由住在约旦河平原的祭司修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一段之后是由住在约旦河平原的祭司修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是住平原的祭司修造。
verses.textEnNiv: The repairs next to him were made by the priests from the surrounding region.
verses.textEnEsv: After him the priests, the men of the surrounding area, repaired.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after him the priests, the men of the plain, made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: The next repairs were made by the priests from the surrounding region.
verses.textEnNasb: And after him the priests, the men of the vicinity, carried out repairs.
verses.textEn: The repairs next to him were made by the priests from the surrounding region.

verses.textZh: 下一段是由便雅悯和哈述，修筑他们自己房屋对面的那段。再下一段由亚难尼的孙子、玛西雅的儿子亚撒利雅，修筑他自己的房屋旁边的那段。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下一段是由便雅悯和哈述，修筑他们自己房屋对面的那段。再下一段由亚难尼的孙子、玛西雅的儿子亚撒利雅，修筑他自己的房屋旁边的那段。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是便雅悯与哈述对着自己的房屋修造。其次是亚难尼的孙子、玛西雅的儿子亚撒利雅在靠近自己的房屋修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house; and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.
verses.textEnEsv: After them Benjamin and Hasshub repaired opposite their house. After them Azariah the son of Maaseiah, son of Ananiah repaired beside his own house.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs opposite their house. After them Azariah the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs by his house.
verses.textEnNlt: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub repaired the section across from their house, and Azariah son of Maaseiah and grandson of Ananiah repaired the section across from his house.
verses.textEnNasb: After them Benjamin and Hasshub carried out repairs in front of their house. After them Azariah the son of Maaseiah, son of Ananiah, carried out repairs beside his house.
verses.textEn: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house; and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.

verses.textZh: 这一段之后是希拿达的儿子宾内修筑的另一段，从亚撒利雅的房屋，直到城墙的转角，就是城角的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一段之后是希拿达的儿子宾内修筑的另一段，从亚撒利雅的房屋，直到城墙的转角，就是城角的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是希拿达的儿子宾内修造一段，从亚撒利雅的房屋直到城墙转弯，又到城角。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from Azariah’s house to the angle and the corner,
verses.textEnEsv: After him Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the buttress and to the corner.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the buttress, even as far as the corner.
verses.textEnNlt: Next was Binnui son of Henadad, who rebuilt another section of the wall from Azariah’s house to the angle and the corner.
verses.textEnNasb: After him Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah as far as the Angle and as far as the corner.
verses.textEn: Next to him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from Azariah’s house to the angle and the corner,

verses.textZh: 乌赛的儿子巴拉修筑对着城墙的转角的地方，以及王宫突出高耸的城楼靠近护卫院的一段。下一段由巴录的儿子毘大雅修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌赛的儿子巴拉修筑对着城墙的转角的地方，以及王宫突出高耸的城楼靠近护卫院的一段。下一段由巴录的儿子毘大雅修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌赛的儿子巴拉修造对着城墙的转弯和王上宫凸出来的城楼，靠近护卫院的那一段。其次是巴录的儿子毗大雅修造。（
verses.textEnNiv: and Palal son of Uzai worked opposite the angle and the tower projecting from the upper palace near the court of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh
verses.textEnEsv: Palal the son of Uzai repaired opposite the buttress and the tower projecting from the upper house of the king at the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh
verses.textEnNkjv: Palal the son of Uzai maderepairs opposite the buttress, and on the tower which projects from the king’s upper house that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh maderepairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Palal son of Uzai carried on the work from a point opposite the angle and the tower that projects up from the king’s upper house beside the court of the guard. Next to him were Pedaiah son of Parosh,
verses.textEnNasb: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs in front of the Angle and the tower projecting from the upper house of the king, which is by the courtyard of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.
verses.textEn: and Palal son of Uzai worked opposite the angle and the tower projecting from the upper palace near the court of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh

verses.textZh: 居住在俄斐勒的殿役，修筑直到东面水门对面和突出的城楼那一段墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 居住在俄斐勒的殿役，修筑直到东面水门对面和突出的城楼那一段墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼提宁住在俄斐勒，直到朝东水门的对面和凸出来的城楼。）
verses.textEnNiv: and the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel made repairs up to a point opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the projecting tower.
verses.textEnEsv: and the temple servants living on Ophel repaired to a point opposite the Water Gate on the east and the projecting tower.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Nethinim who dwelt in Ophel maderepairs as far as theplace in front of the Water Gate toward the east, and on the projecting tower.
verses.textEnNlt: with the Temple servants living on the hill of Ophel, who repaired the wall as far as a point across from the Water Gate to the east and the projecting tower.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the temple servants living in Ophel made repairs as far as the front of the Water Gate toward the east and the projecting tower.
verses.textEn: and the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel made repairs up to a point opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the projecting tower.

verses.textZh: 再下一段，就是由提哥亚人修筑的另一段，从那突出来的大城楼对面，直到俄斐勒的城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再下一段，就是由提哥亚人修筑的另一段，从那突出来的大城楼对面，直到俄斐勒的城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是提哥亚人又修一段，对着那凸出来的大楼，直到俄斐勒的墙。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to them, the men of Tekoa repaired another section, from the great projecting tower to the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEnEsv: After him the Tekoites repaired another section opposite the great projecting tower as far as the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEnNkjv: After them the Tekoites repaired another section, next to the great projecting tower, and as far as the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then came the people of Tekoa, who repaired another section across from the great projecting tower and over to the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEnNasb: After them the Tekoites repaired another section in front of the great projecting tower and as far as the wall of Ophel.
verses.textEn: Next to them, the men of Tekoa repaired another section, from the great projecting tower to the wall of Ophel.

verses.textZh: 从马门往上的一段，祭司们各人修筑自己房屋对面的城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从马门往上的一段，祭司们各人修筑自己房屋对面的城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 从马门往上，众祭司各对自己的房屋修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Above the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each in front of his own house.
verses.textEnEsv: Above the Horse Gate the priests repaired, each one opposite his own house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beyond the Horse Gate the priests made repairs, each in front of his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: Above the Horse Gate, the priests repaired the wall. Each one repaired the section immediately across from his own house.
verses.textEnNasb: Above the Horse Gate the priests carried out repairs, each in front of his house.
verses.textEn: Above the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each in front of his own house.

verses.textZh: 下一段由音麦的儿子撒督修筑自己房屋对面的那段。再下一段由看守东门示迦尼的儿子示玛雅修筑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下一段由音麦的儿子撒督修筑自己房屋对面的那段。再下一段由看守东门示迦尼的儿子示玛雅修筑。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是音麦的儿子撒督对着自己的房屋修造。其次是守东门、示迦尼的儿子示玛雅修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house. Next to him, Shemaiah son of Shekaniah, the guard at the East Gate, made repairs.
verses.textEnEsv: After them Zadok the son of Immer repaired opposite his own house. After him Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the East Gate, repaired.
verses.textEnNkjv: After them Zadok the son of Immer made repairs in front of his own house. After him Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the East Gate, made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Zadok son of Immer also rebuilt the wall across from his own house, and beyond him was Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the gatekeeper of the East Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: After them Zadok the son of Immer carried out repairs in front of his house. And after him Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the East Gate, carried out repairs.
verses.textEn: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house. Next to him, Shemaiah son of Shekaniah, the guard at the East Gate, made repairs.

verses.textZh: 这一段之后是由示利米雅的儿子哈拿尼雅和萨拉的第六子哈嫩修筑的另一段，下一段就是比利迦的儿子米书兰修筑自己住宅对面的那一段。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一段之后是由示利米雅的儿子哈拿尼雅和萨拉的第六子哈嫩修筑的另一段，下一段就是比利迦的儿子米书兰修筑自己住宅对面的那一段。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是示利米雅的儿子哈拿尼雅和萨拉的第六子哈嫩又修一段。其次是比利迦的儿子米书兰对着自己的房屋修造。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berekiah made repairs opposite his living quarters.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Hananiah the son of Shelemiah and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph repaired another section. After him Meshullam the son of Berechiah repaired opposite his chamber.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. After him Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs in front of his dwelling.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section, while Meshullam son of Berekiah rebuilt the wall across from where he lived.
verses.textEnNasb: After him Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. After him Meshullam the son of Berechiah carried out repairs in front of his own quarters.
verses.textEn: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berekiah made repairs opposite his living quarters.

verses.textZh: 再下一段由金匠玛基雅修筑，直到殿役和商人的房屋，对着哈米弗甲门，直到城的角楼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再下一段由金匠玛基雅修筑，直到殿役和商人的房屋，对着哈米弗甲门，直到城的角楼。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是银匠玛基雅修造到尼提宁和商人的房屋，对着哈米弗甲门，直到城的角楼。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him, Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner;
verses.textEnEsv: After him Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired as far as the house of the temple servants and of the merchants, opposite the Muster Gate, and to the upper chamber of the corner.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the Nethinim and of the merchants, in front of the Miphkad Gate, and as far as the upper room at the corner.
verses.textEnNlt: Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired the wall as far as the housing for the Temple servants and merchants, across from the Inspection Gate. Then he continued as far as the upper room at the corner.
verses.textEnNasb: After him Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, carried out repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and of the merchants, in front of the Inspection Gate and as far as the upper room of the corner.
verses.textEn: Next to him, Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner;

verses.textZh: 金匠和商人修筑城的角楼和羊门之间的那一段。
verses.textZhCnvs: 金匠和商人修筑城的角楼和羊门之间的那一段。
verses.textZhCuv: 银匠与商人在城的角楼和羊门中间修造。
verses.textEnNiv: and between the room above the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.
verses.textEnEsv: And between the upper chamber of the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and the merchants repaired.
verses.textEnNkjv: And between the upper room at the corner, as far as the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.
verses.textEnNlt: The other goldsmiths and merchants repaired the wall from that corner to the Sheep Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: And between the upper room of the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and the merchants carried out repairs.
verses.textEn: and between the room above the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.

verses.textZh: 当参巴拉听见我们正在重建城墙，就很忿怒，非常恼恨，并且讥讽犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当参巴拉听见我们正在重建城墙，就很忿怒，非常恼恨，并且讥讽犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 参巴拉听见我们修造城墙就发怒，大大恼恨，嗤笑犹大人，
verses.textEnNiv: When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became angry and was greatly incensed. He ridiculed the Jews,
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry and greatly enraged, and he jeered at the Jews.
