verses.textEnNkjv: But it so happened, when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, that he was furious and very indignant, and mocked the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: Sanballat was very angry when he learned that we were rebuilding the wall. He flew into a rage and mocked the Jews,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about that when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became furious and very angry, and he mocked the Jews.
verses.textEn: When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became angry and was greatly incensed. He ridiculed the Jews,

verses.textZh: 在他的兄弟和撒玛利亚的军队面前，说："这些软弱的犹大人在作甚么呢？想自己修筑城墙吗？想要献祭吗？想要在一天之内完成吗？想要使废土堆中被火烧过的石头复活吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他的兄弟和撒玛利亚的军队面前，说："这些软弱的犹大人在作甚么呢？想自己修筑城墙吗？想要献祭吗？想要在一天之内完成吗？想要使废土堆中被火烧过的石头复活吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他弟兄和撒马利亚的军兵说：「这些软弱的犹大人做什么呢？要保护自己吗？要献祭吗？要一日成功吗？要从土堆里拿出火烧的石头再立墙吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: and in the presence of his associates and the army of Samaria, he said, "What are those feeble Jews doing? Will they restore their wall? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish in a day? Can they bring the stones back to life from those heaps of rubble—burned as they are?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said in the presence of his brothers and of the army of Samaria, "What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they restore it for themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish up in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, and burned ones at that?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he spoke before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, "What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they complete it in a day? Will they revive the stones from the heaps of rubbish—stones that are burned?"
verses.textEnNlt: saying in front of his friends and the Samarian army officers, "What does this bunch of poor, feeble Jews think they’re doing? Do they think they can build the wall in a single day by just offering a few sacrifices? Do they actually think they can make something of stones from a rubbish heap—and charred ones at that?"
verses.textEnNasb: And he spoke in the presence of his brothers and the wealthy people of Samaria and said, "What are these feeble Jews doing? Are they going to restore the temple for themselves? Can they offer sacrifices? Can they finish it in a day? Can they revive the stones from the heaps of rubble, even the burned ones?"
verses.textEn: and in the presence of his associates and the army of Samaria, he said, "What are those feeble Jews doing? Will they restore their wall? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish in a day? Can they bring the stones back to life from those heaps of rubble—burned as they are?"

verses.textZh: 亚扪人多比雅在参巴拉旁边说："这些人建造的，只要一只狐狸走上去，石墙就崩塌。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人多比雅在参巴拉旁边说："这些人建造的，只要一只狐狸走上去，石墙就崩塌。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人多比雅站在旁边，说：「他们所修造的石墙，就是狐狸上去也必跐倒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was at his side, said, "What they are building—even a fox climbing up on it would break down their wall of stones!"
verses.textEnEsv: Tobiah the Ammonite was beside him, and he said, "Yes, what they are building— if a fox goes up on it he will break down their stone wall!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was beside him, and he said, "Whatever they build, if even a fox goes up onit, he will break down their stone wall."
verses.textEnNlt: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was standing beside him, remarked, "That stone wall would collapse if even a fox walked along the top of it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was near him, and he said, "Even what they are building—if a fox were to jump on it, it would break their stone wall down!"
verses.textEn: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was at his side, said, "What they are building—even a fox climbing up on it would break down their wall of stones!"

verses.textZh: "我们的神啊，求你垂听，我们被藐视，求你使他们的毁谤归到他们头上，使他们在被掳之地成为掠物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们的神啊，求你垂听，我们被藐视，求你使他们的毁谤归到他们头上，使他们在被掳之地成为掠物。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的神啊，求你垂听，因为我们被藐视。求你使他们的毁谤归于他们的头上，使他们在掳到之地作为掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear us, our God, for we are despised. Turn their insults back on their own heads. Give them over as plunder in a land of captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O our God, for we are despised. Turn back their taunt on their own heads and give them up to be plundered in a land where they are captives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, O our God, for we are despised; turn their reproach on their own heads, and give them as plunder to a land of captivity!
verses.textEnNlt: Then I prayed, "Hear us, our God, for we are being mocked. May their scoffing fall back on their own heads, and may they themselves become captives in a foreign land!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear, O our God, how we are an object of contempt! Return their taunting on their own heads, and turn them into plunder in a land of captivity.
verses.textEn: Hear us, our God, for we are despised. Turn their insults back on their own heads. Give them over as plunder in a land of captivity.

verses.textZh: 不要遮蔽他们的罪孽，也不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪恶，因为他们在这些建造的人面前惹你发怒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要遮蔽他们的罪孽，也不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪恶，因为他们在这些建造的人面前惹你发怒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不要遮掩他们的罪孽，不要使他们的罪恶从你面前涂抹，因为他们在修造的人眼前惹动你的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not cover up their guilt or blot out their sins from your sight, for they have thrown insults in the face of the builders.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not cover their guilt, and let not their sin be blotted out from your sight, for they have provoked you to anger in the presence of the builders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not cover their iniquity, and do not let their sin be blotted out from before You; for they have provoked You to anger before the builders.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not ignore their guilt. Do not blot out their sins, for they have provoked you to anger here in front of the builders."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not forgive their guilt and do not let their sin be wiped out before You, for they have demoralized the builders.
verses.textEn: Do not cover up their guilt or blot out their sins from your sight, for they have thrown insults in the face of the builders.

verses.textZh: 这样，我们重建城墙，把全部城墙连接起来，城墙达到一半的高度，因为众人都全心作工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们重建城墙，把全部城墙连接起来，城墙达到一半的高度，因为众人都全心作工。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们修造城墙，城墙就都连络，高至一半，因为百姓专心做工。
verses.textEnNiv: So we rebuilt the wall till all of it reached half its height, for the people worked with all their heart.
verses.textEnEsv: So we built the wall. And all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we built the wall, and the entire wall was joined together up to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
verses.textEnNlt: At last the wall was completed to half its height around the entire city, for the people had worked with enthusiasm.
verses.textEnNasb: So we built the wall, and the entire wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
verses.textEn: So we rebuilt the wall till all of it reached half its height, for the people worked with all their heart.

verses.textZh: 当参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人、亚扪人、亚实突人听见耶路撒冷城墙重修工程仍然进行，已经堵塞城墙的缺口，就非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人、亚扪人、亚实突人听见耶路撒冷城墙重修工程仍然进行，已经堵塞城墙的缺口，就非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人、亚扪人、亚实突人听见修造耶路撒冷城墙，着手进行堵塞破裂的地方，就甚发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites and the people of Ashdod heard that the repairs to Jerusalem’s walls had gone ahead and that the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabs and the Ammonites and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem was going forward and that the breaches were beginning to be closed, they were very angry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the walls of Jerusalem were being restored and the gaps were beginning to be closed, that they became very angry,
verses.textEnNlt: But when Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabs, Ammonites, and Ashdodites heard that the work was going ahead and that the gaps in the wall of Jerusalem were being repaired, they were furious.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repair of the walls of Jerusalem went on, and that the breaches began to be closed, they were very angry.
verses.textEn: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites and the people of Ashdod heard that the repairs to Jerusalem’s walls had gone ahead and that the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.

verses.textZh: 他们就一同计划阴谋要来攻击耶路撒冷，制造混乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就一同计划阴谋要来攻击耶路撒冷，制造混乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 大家同谋要来攻击耶路撒冷，使城内扰乱。
verses.textEnNiv: They all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and stir up trouble against it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and to cause confusion in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all of them conspired together to come and attack Jerusalem and create confusion.
verses.textEnNlt: They all made plans to come and fight against Jerusalem and throw us into confusion.
verses.textEnNasb: So all of them conspired together to come to fight against Jerusalem and to cause confusion in it.
verses.textEn: They all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and stir up trouble against it.

verses.textZh: 所以我们向我们的神祷告，又因他们的缘故，设立守卫，日夜防备他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们向我们的神祷告，又因他们的缘故，设立守卫，日夜防备他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我们祷告我们的神，又因他们的缘故，就派人看守，昼夜防备。
verses.textEnNiv: But we prayed to our God and posted a guard day and night to meet this threat.
verses.textEnEsv: And we prayed to our God and set a guard as a protection against them day and night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless we made our prayer to our God, and because of them we set a watch against them day and night.
verses.textEnNlt: But we prayed to our God and guarded the city day and night to protect ourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: But we prayed to our God, and because of them we set up a guard against them day and night.
verses.textEn: But we prayed to our God and posted a guard day and night to meet this threat.

verses.textZh: 犹大人说："搬运的人气力已经衰弱，但瓦砾仍多，我们不能再建城墙了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人说："搬运的人气力已经衰弱，但瓦砾仍多，我们不能再建城墙了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人说：「灰土尚多，扛抬的人力气已经衰败，所以我们不能建造城墙。」
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the people in Judah said, "The strength of the laborers is giving out, and there is so much rubble that we cannot rebuild the wall."
verses.textEnEsv: In Judah it was said, "The strength of those who bear the burdens is failing. There is too much rubble. By ourselves we will not be able to rebuild the wall."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah said, "The strength of the laborers is failing, and thereis so much rubbish that we are not able to build the wall."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Judah began to complain, "The workers are getting tired, and there is so much rubble to be moved. We will never be able to build the wall by ourselves."
verses.textEnNasb: And so in Judah it was said: "The strength of the burden bearers is failing, Yet there is much rubble; And we ourselves are unable To rebuild the wall."
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the people in Judah said, "The strength of the laborers is giving out, and there is so much rubble that we cannot rebuild the wall."

verses.textZh: 同时我们的敌人说："趁着他们不知道，还未看见之前，我们就进入他们中间，杀死他们，使那工程停止。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 同时我们的敌人说："趁着他们不知道，还未看见之前，我们就进入他们中间，杀死他们，使那工程停止。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的敌人且说：「趁他们不知不见，我们进入他们中间，杀他们，使工作止住。」
verses.textEnNiv: Also our enemies said, "Before they know it or see us, we will be right there among them and will kill them and put an end to the work."
verses.textEnEsv: And our enemies said, "They will not know or see till we come among them and kill them and stop the work."
verses.textEnNkjv: And our adversaries said, "They will neither know nor see anything, till we come into their midst and kill them and cause the work to cease."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, our enemies were saying, "Before they know what’s happening, we will swoop down on them and kill them and end their work."
verses.textEnNasb: And our enemies said, "They will not know or see until we come among them, kill them, and put a stop to the work."
verses.textEn: Also our enemies said, "Before they know it or see us, we will be right there among them and will kill them and put an end to the work."

verses.textZh: 住在他们附近的一些犹大人，也曾十次前来通知我们说："他们将从各方上来攻击你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在他们附近的一些犹大人，也曾十次前来通知我们说："他们将从各方上来攻击你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那靠近敌人居住的犹大人十次从各处来见我们，说：「你们必要回到我们那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times over, "Wherever you turn, they will attack us."
verses.textEnEsv: At that time the Jews who lived near them came from all directions and said to us ten times, "You must return to us."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the Jews who dwelt near them came, that they told us ten times, "From whatever place you turn, theywillbe upon us."
verses.textEnNlt: The Jews who lived near the enemy came and told us again and again, "They will come from all directions and attack us!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times, " They will come up against us from every place where you may turn,"
verses.textEn: Then the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times over, "Wherever you turn, they will attack us."

verses.textZh: 所以我分派众人站岗，在低洼或高处，在城墙后隐蔽处或空旷的地方，叫他们按着家族，带着刀、枪和弓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我分派众人站岗，在低洼或高处，在城墙后隐蔽处或空旷的地方，叫他们按着家族，带着刀、枪和弓。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我使百姓各按宗族拿刀、拿枪、拿弓站在城墙后边低洼的空处。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I stationed some of the people behind the lowest points of the wall at the exposed places, posting them by families, with their swords, spears and bows.
verses.textEnEsv: So in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in open places, I stationed the people by their clans, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I positioned men behind the lower parts of the wall, at the openings; and I set the people according to their families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.textEnNlt: So I placed armed guards behind the lowest parts of the wall in the exposed areas. I stationed the people to stand guard by families, armed with swords, spears, and bows.
verses.textEnNasb: then I stationed men in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, the exposed places, and I stationed the people in families with their swords, spears, and bows.
verses.textEn: Therefore I stationed some of the people behind the lowest points of the wall at the exposed places, posting them by families, with their swords, spears and bows.

verses.textZh: 我巡视之后，就起来，对贵族、官长和其余的人民说："不要怕他们，要记得主是伟大可畏的，要为你们的兄弟、儿女、妻子和你们的家争战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我巡视之后，就起来，对贵族、官长和其余的人民说："不要怕他们，要记得主是伟大可畏的，要为你们的兄弟、儿女、妻子和你们的家争战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我察看了，就起来对贵胄、官长，和其余的人说：「不要怕他们！当记念主是大而可畏的。你们要为弟兄、儿女、妻子、家产争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: After I looked things over, I stood up and said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "Don’t be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your families, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes."
verses.textEnEsv: And I looked and arose and said to the nobles and to the officials and to the rest of the people, "Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your homes."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I looked, and arose and said to the nobles, to the leaders, and to the rest of the people, "Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, great and awesome, and fight for your brethren, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses."
verses.textEnNlt: Then as I looked over the situation, I called together the nobles and the rest of the people and said to them, "Don’t be afraid of the enemy! Remember the Lord, who is great and glorious, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your homes!"
verses.textEnNasb: When I saw their fear, I stood and said to the nobles, the officials, and the rest of the people: "Do not be afraid of them; remember the Lord who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses."
verses.textEn: After I looked things over, I stood up and said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "Don’t be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your families, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes."

verses.textZh: 我们的仇敌既然听见我们知道了这阴谋，神也破坏了他们的计谋，就不敢来了。我们全都回到城墙那里，各人回到原来的工作岗位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的仇敌既然听见我们知道了这阴谋，神也破坏了他们的计谋，就不敢来了。我们全都回到城墙那里，各人回到原来的工作岗位。
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌听见我们知道他们的心意，见神也破坏他们的计谋，就不来了。我们都回到城墙那里，各做各的工。
verses.textEnNiv: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their plot and that God had frustrated it, we all returned to the wall, each to our own work.
verses.textEnEsv: When our enemies heard that it was known to us and that God had frustrated their plan, we all returned to the wall, each to his work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and that God had brought their plot to nothing, that all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.
verses.textEnNlt: When our enemies heard that we knew of their plans and that God had frustrated them, we all returned to our work on the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and that God had frustrated their plan, then all of us returned to the wall, each one to his work.
verses.textEn: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their plot and that God had frustrated it, we all returned to the wall, each to our own work.

verses.textZh: 从那天起，我的仆人一半工作，一半紧握着枪、盾牌、弓和盔甲。众领袖都站在犹大全家的后面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那天起，我的仆人一半工作，一半紧握着枪、盾牌、弓和盔甲。众领袖都站在犹大全家的后面。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那日起，我的仆人一半做工，一半拿枪、拿盾牌、拿弓、穿 铠甲，官长都站在犹大众人的后边。
verses.textEnNiv: From that day on, half of my men did the work, while the other half were equipped with spears, shields, bows and armor. The officers posted themselves behind all the people of Judah
verses.textEnEsv: From that day on, half of my servants worked on construction, and half held the spears, shields, bows, and coats of mail. And the leaders stood behind the whole house of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, from that time on, that half of my servants worked at construction, while the other half held the spears, the shields, the bows, and wore armor; and the leaders were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: But from then on, only half my men worked while the other half stood guard with spears, shields, bows, and coats of mail. The leaders stationed themselves behind the people of Judah
verses.textEnNasb: And from that day on, half of my servants carried on the work while half of them kept hold of the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the captains were behind all the house of Judah.
verses.textEn: From that day on, half of my men did the work, while the other half were equipped with spears, shields, bows and armor. The officers posted themselves behind all the people of Judah

verses.textZh: 那些建造城墙，搬运重物的，都是一只手作工，一只手紧握兵器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些建造城墙，搬运重物的，都是一只手作工，一只手紧握兵器。
verses.textZhCuv: 修造城墙的，扛抬材料的，都一手做工一手拿兵器。
verses.textEnNiv: who were building the wall. Those who carried materials did their work with one hand and held a weapon in the other,
verses.textEnEsv: who were building on the wall. Those who carried burdens were loaded in such a way that each labored on the work with one hand and held his weapon with the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who built on the wall, and those who carried burdens, loaded themselves so that with one hand they worked at construction, and with the other held a weapon.
verses.textEnNlt: who were building the wall. The laborers carried on their work with one hand supporting their load and one hand holding a weapon.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who were rebuilding the wall and those who carried burdens carried with one hand doing the work, and the other keeping hold of a weapon.
verses.textEn: who were building the wall. Those who carried materials did their work with one hand and held a weapon in the other,

verses.textZh: 建造的人，都腰间佩着刀来建造；吹号角的人在我旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 建造的人，都腰间佩着刀来建造；吹号角的人在我旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 修造的人都腰间佩刀修造，吹角的人在我旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: and each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. But the man who sounded the trumpet stayed with me.
verses.textEnEsv: And each of the builders had his sword strapped at his side while he built. The man who sounded the trumpet was beside me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every one of the builders had his sword girded at his side as he built. And the one who sounded the trumpet was beside me.
verses.textEnNlt: All the builders had a sword belted to their side. The trumpeter stayed with me to sound the alarm.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the builders, each wore his sword strapped to his waist as he built, while the trumpeter stood near me.
verses.textEn: and each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. But the man who sounded the trumpet stayed with me.

verses.textZh: 我对贵族、官长和其余的人民说："这工程浩大，范围广阔；我们在城墙上彼此相隔很远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对贵族、官长和其余的人民说："这工程浩大，范围广阔；我们在城墙上彼此相隔很远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对贵胄、官长，和其余的人说：「这工程浩大，我们在城墙上相离甚远；
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "The work is extensive and spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to the nobles and to the officials and to the rest of the people, "The work is great and widely spread, and we are separated on the wall, far from one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said to the nobles, the rulers, and the rest of the people, "The work is great and extensive, and we are separated far from one another on the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I explained to the nobles and officials and all the people, "The work is very spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to the nobles, the officials, and the rest of the people, "The work is great and extensive, and we are separated on the wall far from one another.
verses.textEn: Then I said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "The work is extensive and spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.

verses.textZh: 所以你们无论在甚么地方，一听见号角声，就要集合到我们那里来。我们的神必为我们争战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们无论在甚么地方，一听见号角声，就要集合到我们那里来。我们的神必为我们争战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们听见角声在哪里，就聚集到我们那里去。我们的神必为我们争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, join us there. Our God will fight for us!"
verses.textEnEsv: In the place where you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally to us there. Our God will fight for us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally to us there. Our God will fight for us."
verses.textEnNlt: When you hear the blast of the trumpet, rush to wherever it is sounding. Then our God will fight for us!"
verses.textEnNasb: At whatever place you hear the sound of the trumpet, assemble to us there. Our God will fight for us."
verses.textEn: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, join us there. Our God will fight for us!"

verses.textZh: 我们就这样作工；一半人紧握着枪，从黎明直到星宿出现的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们就这样作工；一半人紧握着枪，从黎明直到星宿出现的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，我们做工，一半拿兵器，从天亮直到星宿出现的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: So we continued the work with half the men holding spears, from the first light of dawn till the stars came out.
verses.textEnEsv: So we labored at the work, and half of them held the spears from the break of dawn until the stars came out.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we labored in the work, and half of themen held the spears from daybreak until the stars appeared.
verses.textEnNlt: We worked early and late, from sunrise to sunset. And half the men were always on guard.
verses.textEnNasb: So we carried on the work with half of them holding spears from dawn until the stars appeared.
verses.textEn: So we continued the work with half the men holding spears, from the first light of dawn till the stars came out.

verses.textZh: 那时，我又对众人说："各人和他的仆人都要在耶路撒冷城中过夜，这样他们可以在夜间作我们的守卫，日间工作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我又对众人说："各人和他的仆人都要在耶路撒冷城中过夜，这样他们可以在夜间作我们的守卫，日间工作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我又对百姓说：「各人和他的仆人当在耶路撒冷住宿，好在夜间保守我们，白昼做工。」
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I also said to the people, "Have every man and his helper stay inside Jerusalem at night, so they can serve us as guards by night and as workers by day."
verses.textEnEsv: I also said to the people at that time, "Let every man and his servant pass the night within Jerusalem, that they may be a guard for us by night and may labor by day."
verses.textEnNkjv: At the same time I also said to the people, "Let each man and his servant stay at night in Jerusalem, that they may be our guard by night and a working party by day."
verses.textEnNlt: I also told everyone living outside the walls to stay in Jerusalem. That way they and their servants could help with guard duty at night and work during the day.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time I also said to the people, "Each man with his servant shall spend the night within Jerusalem, so that they may be a guard for us by night and a laborer by day."
verses.textEn: At that time I also said to the people, "Have every man and his helper stay inside Jerusalem at night, so they can serve us as guards by night and as workers by day."

verses.textZh: 这样，我与我的兄弟、我的仆人和跟随我的人，都不脱衣服，各人带自己的兵器去打水 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我与我的兄弟、我的仆人和跟随我的人，都不脱衣服，各人带自己的兵器去打水 。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我和弟兄仆人，并跟从我的护兵都不脱衣服，出去打水也带兵器。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither I nor my brothers nor my men nor the guards with me took off our clothes; each had his weapon, even when he went for water.
verses.textEnEsv: So neither I nor my brothers nor my servants nor the men of the guard who followed me, none of us took off our clothes; each kept his weapon at his right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So neither I, my brethren, my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes, except that everyone took them off for washing.
verses.textEnNlt: During this time, none of us—not I, nor my relatives, nor my servants, nor the guards who were with me—ever took off our clothes. We carried our weapons with us at all times, even when we went for water.
verses.textEnNasb: So neither I, my brothers, my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me—none of us removed our clothes; each took his weapon even to the water.
verses.textEn: Neither I nor my brothers nor my men nor the guards with me took off our clothes; each had his weapon, even when he went for water.

verses.textZh: 那时，民众和他们的妻子大声呼冤，控告自己的同胞犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，民众和他们的妻子大声呼冤，控告自己的同胞犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓和他们的妻大大呼号，埋怨他们的弟兄犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the men and their wives raised a great outcry against their fellow Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there arose a great outcry of the people and of their wives against their Jewish brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was a great outcry of the people and their wives against their Jewish brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time some of the men and their wives raised a cry of protest against their fellow Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a great outcry of the people and of their wives against their Jewish brothers.
verses.textEn: Now the men and their wives raised a great outcry against their fellow Jews.

verses.textZh: 有些人说："我们和儿女人口众多，给我们五谷餬口，可以存活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人说："我们和儿女人口众多，给我们五谷餬口，可以存活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有的说：「我们和儿女人口众多，要去得粮食度命」；
verses.textEnNiv: Some were saying, "We and our sons and daughters are numerous; in order for us to eat and stay alive, we must get grain."
verses.textEnEsv: For there were those who said, "With our sons and our daughters, we are many. So let us get grain, that we may eat and keep alive."
verses.textEnNkjv: For there were those who said, "We, our sons, and our daughters are many; therefore let us get grain, that we may eat and live."
verses.textEnNlt: They were saying, "We have such large families. We need more food to survive."
verses.textEnNasb: For there were those who said, "We, our sons, and our daughters are many; therefore let’s get grain so that we may eat and live."
verses.textEn: Some were saying, "We and our sons and daughters are numerous; in order for us to eat and stay alive, we must get grain."

verses.textZh: 有些人说："我们抵押了自己的田地、葡萄园和房屋，为要在饥荒中买到五谷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人说："我们抵押了自己的田地、葡萄园和房屋，为要在饥荒中买到五谷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有的说：「我们典了田地、葡萄园、房屋，要得粮食充饥」；
verses.textEnNiv: Others were saying, "We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards and our homes to get grain during the famine."
verses.textEnEsv: There were also those who said, "We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses to get grain because of the famine."
verses.textEnNkjv: There were also some who said, "We have mortgaged our lands and vineyards and houses, that we might buy grain because of the famine."
verses.textEnNlt: Others said, "We have mortgaged our fields, vineyards, and homes to get food during the famine."
verses.textEnNasb: And there were others who said, "We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses so that we might get grain because of the famine."
verses.textEn: Others were saying, "We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards and our homes to get grain during the famine."

verses.textZh: 有些人说："我们为了要借钱向王纳税，只好抵押了我们的田地和葡萄园。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些人说："我们为了要借钱向王纳税，只好抵押了我们的田地和葡萄园。
verses.textZhCuv: 有的说：「我们已经指着田地、葡萄园，借了钱给王纳税。
verses.textEnNiv: Still others were saying, "We have had to borrow money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were those who said, "We have borrowed money for the king’s tax on our fields and our vineyards.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were also those who said, "We have borrowed money for the king’s tax on our lands and vineyards.
verses.textEnNlt: And others said, "We have had to borrow money on our fields and vineyards to pay our taxes.
verses.textEnNasb: There also were those who said, "We have borrowed money for the king’s tax on our fields and our vineyards.
verses.textEn: Still others were saying, "We have had to borrow money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.

verses.textZh: 虽然我们的身体与我们同胞的身体一样，我们的儿女与他们的儿女也相同，可是我们却要强迫自己的儿女去作仆婢，而且我们的女儿有些已经作了奴婢，我们却无能为力，因为我们的田地和葡萄园已经属于别人了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我们的身体与我们同胞的身体一样，我们的儿女与他们的儿女也相同，可是我们却要强迫自己的儿女去作仆婢，而且我们的女儿有些已经作了奴婢，我们却无能为力，因为我们的田地和葡萄园已经属于别人了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的身体与我们弟兄的身体一样；我们的儿女与他们的儿女一般。现在我们将要使儿女作人的仆婢，我们的女儿已有为婢的；我们并无力拯救，因为我们的田地、葡萄园已经归了别人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Although we are of the same flesh and blood as our fellow Jews and though our children are as good as theirs, yet we have to subject our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters have already been enslaved, but we are powerless, because our fields and our vineyards belong to others."
verses.textEnEsv: Now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children are as their children. Yet we are forcing our sons and our daughters to be slaves, and some of our daughters have already been enslaved, but it is not in our power to help it, for other men have our fields and our vineyards."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children; and indeed we are forcing our sons and our daughters to be slaves, and some of our daughters have been brought into slavery. Itis not in our power toredeemthem, for other men have our lands and vineyards."
verses.textEnNlt: We belong to the same family as those who are wealthy, and our children are just like theirs. Yet we must sell our children into slavery just to get enough money to live. We have already sold some of our daughters, and we are helpless to do anything about it, for our fields and vineyards are already mortgaged to others."
verses.textEnNasb: And now our flesh is like the flesh of our brothers, our children like their children. Yet behold, we are forcing our sons and our daughters to be slaves, and some of our daughters are forced into bondage already, and we are helpless because our fields and vineyards belong to others."
verses.textEn: Although we are of the same flesh and blood as our fellow Jews and though our children are as good as theirs, yet we have to subject our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters have already been enslaved, but we are powerless, because our fields and our vineyards belong to others."

verses.textZh: 我听见他们的哀叫和所讲的这些事，就十分忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见他们的哀叫和所讲的这些事，就十分忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见他们呼号说这些话，便甚发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: When I heard their outcry and these charges, I was very angry.
verses.textEnEsv: I was very angry when I heard their outcry and these words.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I became very angry when I heard their outcry and these words.
verses.textEnNlt: When I heard their complaints, I was very angry.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I was very angry when I heard their outcry and these words.
verses.textEn: When I heard their outcry and these charges, I was very angry.

verses.textZh: 我心中筹算一番以后，就谴责贵族和官长，对他们说："你们各人向自己的同胞贷款，竟然索取高利！"于是我召开大会攻击他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心中筹算一番以后，就谴责贵族和官长，对他们说："你们各人向自己的同胞贷款，竟然索取高利！"于是我召开大会攻击他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里筹划，就斥责贵胄和官长说：「你们各人向弟兄取利！」于是我招聚大会攻击他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I pondered them in my mind and then accused the nobles and officials. I told them, "You are charging your own people interest!" So I called together a large meeting to deal with them
verses.textEnEsv: I took counsel with myself, and I brought charges against the nobles and the officials. I said to them, "You are exacting interest, each from his brother." And I held a great assembly against them
verses.textEnNkjv: After serious thought, I rebuked the nobles and rulers, and said to them, "Each of you is exacting usury from his brother." So I called a great assembly against them.
verses.textEnNlt: After thinking it over, I spoke out against these nobles and officials. I told them, "You are hurting your own relatives by charging interest when they borrow money!" Then I called a public meeting to deal with the problem.
verses.textEnNasb: So I thought it over and contended with the nobles and the leading people, and said to them, "You are lending at interest, each to his brother!" Therefore, I held a great assembly against them.
verses.textEn: I pondered them in my mind and then accused the nobles and officials. I told them, "You are charging your own people interest!" So I called together a large meeting to deal with them

verses.textZh: 我对他们说："我们已尽了我们的能力，把那些卖了给外族人的同胞犹大人买赎回来，而你们还想要出卖你们的同胞，好让我们再把他们买回来吗？"他们都默不作声，无话可说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对他们说："我们已尽了我们的能力，把那些卖了给外族人的同胞犹大人买赎回来，而你们还想要出卖你们的同胞，好让我们再把他们买回来吗？"他们都默不作声，无话可说。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对他们说：「我们尽力赎回我们弟兄，就是卖与外邦的犹大人；你们还要卖弟兄，使我们赎回来吗？」他们就静默不语，无话可答。
verses.textEnNiv: and said: "As far as possible, we have bought back our fellow Jews who were sold to the Gentiles. Now you are selling your own people, only for them to be sold back to us!" They kept quiet, because they could find nothing to say.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "We, as far as we are able, have bought back our Jewish brothers who have been sold to the nations, but you even sell your brothers that they may be sold to us!" They were silent and could not find a word to say.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to them, "According to our ability we have redeemed our Jewish brethren who were sold to the nations. Now indeed, will you even sell your brethren? Or should they be sold to us?" Then they were silenced and found nothing tosay.
verses.textEnNlt: At the meeting I said to them, "We are doing all we can to redeem our Jewish relatives who have had to sell themselves to pagan foreigners, but you are selling them back into slavery again. How often must we redeem them?" And they had nothing to say in their defense.
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to them, "We, according to our ability, have redeemed our Jewish brothers who were sold to the nations; now would you even sell your brothers that they may be sold to us?" Then they were silent and could not find a word to say.
verses.textEn: and said: "As far as possible, we have bought back our fellow Jews who were sold to the Gentiles. Now you are selling your own people, only for them to be sold back to us!" They kept quiet, because they could find nothing to say.

verses.textZh: 我又说："你们这事作得不对。你们岂不应怀着敬畏我们神的心行事为人，免遭我们的仇敌外族人的毁谤吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又说："你们这事作得不对。你们岂不应怀着敬畏我们神的心行事为人，免遭我们的仇敌外族人的毁谤吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我又说：「你们所行的不善！你们行事不当敬畏我们的神吗？不然，难免我们的仇敌外邦人毁谤我们。
verses.textEnNiv: So I continued, "What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our Gentile enemies?
verses.textEnEsv: So I said, "The thing that you are doing is not good. Ought you not to walk in the fear of our God to prevent the taunts of the nations our enemies?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "What you are doing is not good. Should you not walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?
verses.textEnNlt: Then I pressed further, "What you are doing is not right! Should you not walk in the fear of our God in order to avoid being mocked by enemy nations?
verses.textEnNasb: So I said, "The thing which you are doing is not good; should you not walk in the fear of our God because of the taunting of the nations, our enemies?
verses.textEn: So I continued, "What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our Gentile enemies?

verses.textZh: 现在我和我的兄弟，以及我的仆人要把银钱和五谷借给他们。让我们大家都放弃放债取利吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我和我的兄弟，以及我的仆人要把银钱和五谷借给他们。让我们大家都放弃放债取利吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 我和我的弟兄与仆人也将银钱粮食借给百姓；我们大家都当免去利息。
verses.textEnNiv: I and my brothers and my men are also lending the people money and grain. But let us stop charging interest!
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I and my brothers and my servants are lending them money and grain. Let us abandon this exacting of interest.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also, with my brethren and my servants, am lending them money and grain. Please, let us stop this usury!
verses.textEnNlt: I myself, as well as my brothers and my workers, have been lending the people money and grain, but now let us stop this business of charging interest.
verses.textEnNasb: And likewise I, my brothers, and my servants are lending them money and grain. Please, let’s do without this interest.
verses.textEn: I and my brothers and my men are also lending the people money and grain. But let us stop charging interest!

verses.textZh: 请你们今天就把他们的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园、房屋，以及你们向他们索取的利息：百分之一的利钱、五谷、新酒和新油，都归还给他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们今天就把他们的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园、房屋，以及你们向他们索取的利息：百分之一的利钱、五谷、新酒和新油，都归还给他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我劝你们将他们的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园、房屋，并向他们所取的银钱、粮食、新酒，和油，百分之一的利息都归还他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Give back to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves and houses, and also the interest you are charging them—one percent of the money, grain, new wine and olive oil."
verses.textEnEsv: Return to them this very day their fields, their vineyards, their olive orchards, and their houses, and the percentage of money, grain, wine, and oil that you have been exacting from them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Restore now to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also a hundredth of the money and the grain, the new wine and the oil, that you have charged them."
verses.textEnNlt: You must restore their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and homes to them this very day. And repay the interest you charged when you lent them money, grain, new wine, and olive oil."
verses.textEnNasb: Please, give back to them this very day their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, as well as the hundredth part of the money and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil that you are charging as interest from them."
verses.textEn: Give back to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves and houses, and also the interest you are charging them—one percent of the money, grain, new wine and olive oil."

verses.textZh: 他们就说："我们必定归还，不再向他们要求利息了，你怎么说，我们愿意照着你说的去行。"我就把祭司们召了来，叫众人起誓必照着这话去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就说："我们必定归还，不再向他们要求利息了，你怎么说，我们愿意照着你说的去行。"我就把祭司们召了来，叫众人起誓必照着这话去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人说：「我们必归还，不再向他们索要，必照你的话行。」我就召了祭司来，叫众人起誓，必照着所应许的而行。
verses.textEnNiv: "We will give it back," they said. "And we will not demand anything more from them. We will do as you say." Then I summoned the priests and made the nobles and officials take an oath to do what they had promised.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said, "We will restore these and require nothing from them. We will do as you say." And I called the priests and made them swear to do as they had promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "We will restore it, and will require nothing from them; we will do as you say." Then I called the priests, and required an oath from them that they would do according to this promise.
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "We will give back everything and demand nothing more from the people. We will do as you say." Then I called the priests and made the nobles and officials swear to do what they had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said, "We will give it back and will require nothing from them; we will do exactly as you say." So I called the priests and made them take an oath to act in accordance with this promise.
verses.textEn: "We will give it back," they said. "And we will not demand anything more from them. We will do as you say." Then I summoned the priests and made the nobles and officials take an oath to do what they had promised.

verses.textZh: 我抖着胸前的衣襟说："不履行这话的，愿神也是这样抖他离开他的家和产业，直到抖空。"全体会众都说："阿们！"又赞美耶和华。众人都照着这话去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我抖着胸前的衣襟说："不履行这话的，愿神也是这样抖他离开他的家和产业，直到抖空。"全体会众都说："阿们！"又赞美耶和华。众人都照着这话去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也抖着胸前的衣襟，说：「凡不成就这应许的，愿神照样抖他离开家产和他劳碌得来的，直到抖空了。」会众都说：「阿们！」又赞美耶和华。百姓就照着所应许的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, "In this way may God shake out of their house and possessions anyone who does not keep this promise. So may such a person be shaken out and emptied!" At this the whole assembly said, "Amen," and praised the Lord . And the people did as they had promised.
verses.textEnEsv: I also shook out the fold of my garment and said, "So may God shake out every man from his house and from his labor who does not keep this promise. So may he be shaken out and emptied." And all the assembly said "Amen" and praised the Lord . And the people did as they had promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I shook out the fold of my garment and said, "So may God shake out each man from his house, and from his property, who does not perform this promise. Even thus may he be shaken out and emptied." And all the assembly said, "Amen!" and praised the Lord. Then the people did according to this promise.
verses.textEnNlt: I shook out the folds of my robe and said, "If you fail to keep your promise, may God shake you like this from your homes and from your property!" The whole assembly responded, "Amen," and they praised the Lord . And the people did as they had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: I also shook out the front of my garment and said, "So may God shake out every person from his house and from his possessions who does not keep this promise; just so may he be shaken out and emptied." And all the assembly said, "Amen!" And they praised the Lord. Then the people acted in accordance with this promise.
verses.textEn: I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, "In this way may God shake out of their house and possessions anyone who does not keep this promise. So may such a person be shaken out and emptied!" At this the whole assembly said, "Amen," and praised the Lord . And the people did as they had promised.

verses.textZh: 自从我奉命在犹大地作他们省长的日子以来，就是从亚达薛西王二十年，直到三十二年，共十二年，我和我的兄弟都没有吃过省长的俸禄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从我奉命在犹大地作他们省长的日子以来，就是从亚达薛西王二十年，直到三十二年，共十二年，我和我的兄弟都没有吃过省长的俸禄。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我奉派作犹大地的省长，就是从亚达薛西王二十年直到三十二年，共十二年之久，我与我弟兄都没有吃省长的俸禄。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, from the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, until his thirty-second year—twelve years—neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, twelve years, neither I nor my brothers ate the food allowance of the governor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year until the thirty-second year of King Artaxerxes, twelve years, neither I nor my brothers ate the governor’s provisions.
verses.textEnNlt: For the entire twelve years that I was governor of Judah—from the twentieth year to the thirty-second year of the reign of King Artaxerxes —neither I nor my officials drew on our official food allowance.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, since the day that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year to the thirty-second year of King Artaxerxes, for twelve years, neither I nor my kinsmen have eaten the governor’s food allowance.
verses.textEn: Moreover, from the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, until his thirty-second year—twelve years—neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.

verses.textZh: 在我们以先的前任省长，重压人民，每日都向他们索取粮食和酒，以及四百五十六克银子。连他们的仆人也辖制人民，但我因为敬畏神，就不这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我们以先的前任省长，重压人民，每日都向他们索取粮食和酒，以及四百五十六克银子。连他们的仆人也辖制人民，但我因为敬畏神，就不这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 在我以前的省长加重百姓的担子，每日索要粮食和酒，并银子四十舍客勒，就是他们的仆人也辖制百姓；但我因敬畏神不这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: But the earlier governors—those preceding me—placed a heavy burden on the people and took forty shekels of silver from them in addition to food and wine. Their assistants also lorded it over the people. But out of reverence for God I did not act like that.
verses.textEnEsv: The former governors who were before me laid heavy burdens on the people and took from them for their daily ration forty shekels of silver. Even their servants lorded it over the people. But I did not do so, because of the fear of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the former governors who were before me laid burdens on the people, and took from them bread and wine, besides forty shekels of silver. Yes, even their servants bore rule over the people, but I did not do so, because of the fear of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The former governors, in contrast, had laid heavy burdens on the people, demanding a daily ration of food and wine, besides forty pieces of silver. Even their assistants took advantage of the people. But because I feared God, I did not act that way.
verses.textEnNasb: But the previous governors who were before me laid burdens on the people and took from them bread and wine besides forty shekels of silver; even their servants domineered the people. But I did not do so because of my fear of God.
verses.textEn: But the earlier governors—those preceding me—placed a heavy burden on the people and took forty shekels of silver from them in addition to food and wine. Their assistants also lorded it over the people. But out of reverence for God I did not act like that.

verses.textZh: 我坚持只重修城墙的工程；所以我们不购置田产，我所有的仆人也都聚集在那里工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我坚持只重修城墙的工程；所以我们不购置田产，我所有的仆人也都聚集在那里工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我恒心修造城墙，并没有置买田地；我的仆人也都聚集在那里做工。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, I devoted myself to the work on this wall. All my men were assembled there for the work; we did not acquire any land.
verses.textEnEsv: I also persevered in the work on this wall, and we acquired no land, and all my servants were gathered there for the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, I also continued the work on this wall, and we did not buy any land. All my servants were gathered there for the work.
verses.textEnNlt: I also devoted myself to working on the wall and refused to acquire any land. And I required all my servants to spend time working on the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: I also applied myself to the work on this wall; we did not buy any land, and all my servants were gathered there for the work.
verses.textEn: Instead, I devoted myself to the work on this wall. All my men were assembled there for the work; we did not acquire any land.

verses.textZh: 在我桌上吃饭的，有一百五十个犹大人和官长，还有那些从我们四围外族来到我们这里的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我桌上吃饭的，有一百五十个犹大人和官长，还有那些从我们四围外族来到我们这里的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 除了从四围外邦中来的犹大人以外，有犹大平民和官长一百五十人在我席上吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, a hundred and fifty Jews and officials ate at my table, as well as those who came to us from the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, there were at my table 150 men, Jews and officials, besides those who came to us from the nations that were around us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at my table were one hundred and fifty Jews and rulers, besides those who came to us from the nations around us.
verses.textEnNlt: I asked for nothing, even though I regularly fed 150 Jewish officials at my table, besides all the visitors from other lands!
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, there were at my table 150 Jews and officials, besides those who came to us from the nations that were around us.
verses.textEn: Furthermore, a hundred and fifty Jews and officials ate at my table, as well as those who came to us from the surrounding nations.

verses.textZh: 每天预备牛一头、肥羊六只，又为我预备一些飞禽；每十天供应大量各类的酒。虽然这样，我仍然没有索取省长的俸禄，因为这些人服役已经负担沉重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每天预备牛一头、肥羊六只，又为我预备一些飞禽；每十天供应大量各类的酒。虽然这样，我仍然没有索取省长的俸禄，因为这些人服役已经负担沉重。
verses.textZhCuv: 每日预备一只公牛，六只肥羊，又预备些飞禽；每十日一次，多预备各样的酒。虽然如此，我并不要省长的俸禄，因为百姓服役甚重。
verses.textEnNiv: Each day one ox, six choice sheep and some poultry were prepared for me, and every ten days an abundant supply of wine of all kinds. In spite of all this, I never demanded the food allotted to the governor, because the demands were heavy on these people.
verses.textEnEsv: Now what was prepared at my expense for each day was one ox and six choice sheep and birds, and every ten days all kinds of wine in abundance. Yet for all this I did not demand the food allowance of the governor, because the service was too heavy on this people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now that which was prepared daily was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowl were prepared for me, and once every ten days an abundance of all kinds of wine. Yet in spite of this I did not demand the governor’s provisions, because the bondage was heavy on this people.
verses.textEnNlt: The provisions I paid for each day included one ox, six choice sheep or goats, and a large number of poultry. And every ten days we needed a large supply of all kinds of wine. Yet I refused to claim the governor’s food allowance because the people already carried a heavy burden.
verses.textEnNasb: Now that which was prepared for each day was one ox and six choice sheep; also birds were prepared for me, and every ten days all sorts of wine were provided in abundance. Yet for all this I did not request the governor’s food allowance, because the forced labor was heavy on this people.
verses.textEn: Each day one ox, six choice sheep and some poultry were prepared for me, and every ten days an abundant supply of wine of all kinds. In spite of all this, I never demanded the food allotted to the governor, because the demands were heavy on these people.

verses.textZh: "我的神啊，求你记念我，记念我为这人民所作的一切事，施恩给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的神啊，求你记念我，记念我为这人民所作的一切事，施恩给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你记念我为这百姓所行的一切事，施恩与我。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember me with favor, my God, for all I have done for these people.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember for my good, O my God, all that I have done for this people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember me, my God, for good, accordingto all that I have done for this people.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, O my God, all that I have done for these people, and bless me for it.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember me, my God, for good, in return for all that I have done for this people.
verses.textEn: Remember me with favor, my God, for all I have done for these people.

verses.textZh: 参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人基善和我们其余的仇敌听见我重建好了城墙，城墙再没有破口。不过那时我还没有在城门上装上门扇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人基善和我们其余的仇敌听见我重建好了城墙，城墙再没有破口。不过那时我还没有在城门上装上门扇。
verses.textZhCuv: 参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人基善和我们其余的仇敌听见我已经修完了城墙，其中没有破裂之处（那时我还没有安门扇），
verses.textEnNiv: When word came to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left in it—though up to that time I had not set the doors in the gates—
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Sanballat and Tobiah and Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies heard that I had built the wall and that there was no breach left in it ( although up to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened when Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had rebuilt the wall, and that there were no breaks left in it (though at that time I had not hung the doors in the gates),
verses.textEnNlt: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest of our enemies found out that I had finished rebuilding the wall and that no gaps remained—though we had not yet set up the doors in the gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and to the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall, and that no breach was left in it, although at that time I had not installed the doors in the gates,
verses.textEn: When word came to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left in it—though up to that time I had not set the doors in the gates—

verses.textZh: 参巴拉和基善就差派人来见我说："请你来，我们在阿那平原上的一个村庄会面吧！"其实他们想要谋害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参巴拉和基善就差派人来见我说："请你来，我们在阿那平原上的一个村庄会面吧！"其实他们想要谋害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 参巴拉和基善就打发人来见我，说：「请你来，我们在阿挪平原的一个村庄相会。」他们却想害我。
verses.textEnNiv: Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: "Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono." But they were scheming to harm me;
verses.textEnEsv: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, "Come and let us meet together at Hakkephirim in the plain of Ono." But they intended to do me harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, "Come, let us meet together among the villages in the plain of Ono." But they thought to do me harm.
verses.textEnNlt: So Sanballat and Geshem sent a message asking me to meet them at one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But I realized they were plotting to harm me,
verses.textEnNasb: Sanballat and Geshem sent a message to me, saying, "Come, let’s meet together at Chephirim in the plain of Ono." But they were plotting to harm me.
verses.textEn: Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: "Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono." But they were scheming to harm me;

verses.textZh: 于是我差派使者去见他们说："我正在进行大工程，不能去。我怎能放下这工程，去见你们，使这工程停顿呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我差派使者去见他们说："我正在进行大工程，不能去。我怎能放下这工程，去见你们，使这工程停顿呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我差遣人去见他们，说：「我现在办理大工，不能下去。焉能停工下去见你们呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: so I sent messengers to them with this reply: "I am carrying on a great project and cannot go down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and go down to you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And I sent messengers to them, saying, "I am doing a great work and I cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and come down to you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So I sent messengers to them, saying, "I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and go down to you?"
verses.textEnNlt: so I replied by sending this message to them: "I am engaged in a great work, so I can’t come. Why should I stop working to come and meet with you?"
verses.textEnNasb: So I sent messengers to them, saying, "I am doing a great work and am unable to come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and come down to you?"
verses.textEn: so I sent messengers to them with this reply: "I am carrying on a great project and cannot go down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and go down to you?"

verses.textZh: 他们连续四次这样差派人来见我，我都这样回复他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们连续四次这样差派人来见我，我都这样回复他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们这样四次打发人来见我，我都如此回答他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave them the same answer.
verses.textEnEsv: And they sent to me four times in this way, and I answered them in the same manner.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they sent me this message four times, and I answered them in the same manner.
verses.textEnNlt: Four times they sent the same message, and each time I gave the same reply.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they sent messages to me four times worded in this way, and I answered them with the same wording.
verses.textEn: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave them the same answer.

verses.textZh: 参巴拉第五次这样差派他的仆人来见我，手里拿着一封没有封口的信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参巴拉第五次这样差派他的仆人来见我，手里拿着一封没有封口的信。
verses.textZhCuv: 参巴拉第五次打发仆人来见我，手里拿着未封的信，
verses.textEnNiv: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his aide to me with the same message, and in his hand was an unsealed letter
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way Sanballat for the fifth time sent his servant to me with an open letter in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me as before, the fifth time, with an open letter in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The fifth time, Sanballat’s servant came with an open letter in his hand,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me in the same way a fifth time with an open letter in his hand.
verses.textEn: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his aide to me with the same message, and in his hand was an unsealed letter

verses.textZh: 信上写着："在各民族中有这样的传说，善基 也说：‘你和犹大人阴谋造反，所以你才重建城墙，据说，你还想要作他们的王。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 信上写着："在各民族中有这样的传说，善基 也说：‘你和犹大人阴谋造反，所以你才重建城墙，据说，你还想要作他们的王。’
verses.textZhCuv: 信上写着说：「外邦人中有风声，迦施慕 也说，你和犹大人谋反，修造城墙，你要作他们的王；
verses.textEnNiv: in which was written: "It is reported among the nations—and Geshem says it is true—that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and therefore you are building the wall. Moreover, according to these reports you are about to become their king
verses.textEnEsv: In it was written, "It is reported among the nations, and Geshem also says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel; that is why you are building the wall. And according to these reports you wish to become their king.
verses.textEnNkjv: In it was written: It is reported among the nations, and Geshem says, that you and the Jews plan to rebel; therefore, according to these rumors, you are rebuilding the wall, that you may be their king.
verses.textEnNlt: and this is what it said: "There is a rumor among the surrounding nations, and Geshem tells me it is true, that you and the Jews are planning to rebel and that is why you are building the wall. According to his reports, you plan to be their king.
verses.textEnNasb: In it was written: "It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says, that you and the Jews intend to rebel; for that reason you are rebuilding the wall. And you are to be their king, according to these reports.
verses.textEn: in which was written: "It is reported among the nations—and Geshem says it is true—that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and therefore you are building the wall. Moreover, according to these reports you are about to become their king

verses.textZh: 你又设立先知在耶路撒冷指着你宣讲，说：‘犹大有王了。’现在这些话必会传到王那里。所以请你来，我们一起商量商量吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又设立先知在耶路撒冷指着你宣讲，说：‘犹大有王了。’现在这些话必会传到王那里。所以请你来，我们一起商量商量吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你又派先知在耶路撒冷指着你宣讲，说在犹大有王。现在这话必传与王知；所以请你来，与我们彼此商议。」
verses.textEnNiv: and have even appointed prophets to make this proclamation about you in Jerusalem: ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now this report will get back to the king; so come, let us meet together."
verses.textEnEsv: And you have also set up prophets to proclaim concerning you in Jerusalem, ‘There is a king in Judah.’ And now the king will hear of these reports. So now come and let us take counsel together."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you have also appointed prophets to proclaim concerning you at Jerusalem, saying, "Thereis a king in Judah!" Now these matters will be reported to the king. So come, therefore, and let us consult together.
verses.textEnNlt: He also reports that you have appointed prophets in Jerusalem to proclaim about you, ‘Look! There is a king in Judah!’ "You can be very sure that this report will get back to the king, so I suggest that you come and talk it over with me."
verses.textEnNasb: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim in Jerusalem concerning you, ‘A king is in Judah!’ And now it will be reported to the king according to these reports. So come now, let’s consult together."
verses.textEn: and have even appointed prophets to make this proclamation about you in Jerusalem: ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now this report will get back to the king; so come, let us meet together."

verses.textZh: 我就回复他，说："你说的这些事不是事实，都是你从心里捏造出来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就回复他，说："你说的这些事不是事实，都是你从心里捏造出来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就差遣人去见他，说：「你所说的这事，一概没有，是你心里捏造的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I sent him this reply: "Nothing like what you are saying is happening; you are just making it up out of your head."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I sent to him, saying, "No such things as you say have been done, for you are inventing them out of your own mind."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I sent to him, saying, "No such things as you say are being done, but you invent them in your own heart."
verses.textEnNlt: I replied, "There is no truth in any part of your story. You are making up the whole thing."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I sent a message to him saying, "Nothing like these things that you are saying has been done, but you are inventing them in your own mind."
verses.textEn: I sent him this reply: "Nothing like what you are saying is happening; you are just making it up out of your head."

verses.textZh: 其实他们众人是在恐吓我们，心里说："他们的手必软弱，不能再作这工程，不会完工了！"现在，坚固我的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实他们众人是在恐吓我们，心里说："他们的手必软弱，不能再作这工程，不会完工了！"现在，坚固我的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都要使我们惧怕，意思说，他们的手必软弱，以致工作不能成就。神啊，求你坚固我的手。
verses.textEnNiv: They were all trying to frighten us, thinking, "Their hands will get too weak for the work, and it will not be completed." But I prayed, "Now strengthen my hands."
verses.textEnEsv: For they all wanted to frighten us, thinking, "Their hands will drop from the work, and it will not be done." But now, O God, strengthen my hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they all weretryingto make us afraid, saying, "Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done." Now therefore, OGod, strengthen my hands.
verses.textEnNlt: They were just trying to intimidate us, imagining that they could discourage us and stop the work. So I continued the work with even greater determination.
verses.textEnNasb: For all of them were trying to frighten us, thinking, " They will become discouraged with the work and it will not be done." But now, God, strengthen my hands.
verses.textEn: They were all trying to frighten us, thinking, "Their hands will get too weak for the work, and it will not be completed." But I prayed, "Now strengthen my hands."

verses.textZh: 我来到米希大别的孙子、第来雅的儿子示玛雅的家里；那时，他闭门不出，他说："我们在神的殿里，在殿的大堂中会面吧！我们要把殿门关起来，因为他们要来杀你，在夜间来杀你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我来到米希大别的孙子、第来雅的儿子示玛雅的家里；那时，他闭门不出，他说："我们在神的殿里，在殿的大堂中会面吧！我们要把殿门关起来，因为他们要来杀你，在夜间来杀你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我到了米希大别的孙子、第来雅的儿子示玛雅家里；那时，他闭门不出。他说：「我们不如在神的殿里会面，将殿门关锁；因为他们要来杀你，就是夜里来杀你。」
verses.textEnNiv: One day I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home. He said, "Let us meet in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the temple doors, because men are coming to kill you—by night they are coming to kill you."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when I went into the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabel, who was confined to his home, he said, "Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple. Let us close the doors of the temple, for they are coming to kill you. They are coming to kill you by night."
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward I came to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was a secret informer; and he said, "Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us close the doors of the temple, for they are coming to kill you; indeed, at night they will come to kill you."
verses.textEnNlt: Later I went to visit Shemaiah son of Delaiah and grandson of Mehetabel, who was confined to his home. He said, "Let us meet together inside the Temple of God and bolt the doors shut. Your enemies are coming to kill you tonight."
verses.textEnNasb: When I entered the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabel, who was confined at home, he said, "Let’s meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let’s close the doors of the temple, for they are coming to kill you, and they are coming to kill you at night."
verses.textEn: One day I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home. He said, "Let us meet in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the temple doors, because men are coming to kill you—by night they are coming to kill you."

verses.textZh: 我回答："像我这样的人，怎可以逃跑呢？哪有像我这样的人，进入圣殿里去保全自己的性命呢？我决不进去！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回答："像我这样的人，怎可以逃跑呢？哪有像我这样的人，进入圣殿里去保全自己的性命呢？我决不进去！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：「像我这样的人岂要逃跑呢？像我这样的人岂能进入殿里保全生命呢？我不进去！」
verses.textEnNiv: But I said, "Should a man like me run away? Or should someone like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go!"
verses.textEnEsv: But I said, "Should such a man as I run away? And what man such as I could go into the temple and live? I will not go in."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said, "Should such a man as I flee? And who isthere such as I who would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in!"
verses.textEnNlt: But I replied, "Should someone in my position run from danger? Should someone in my position enter the Temple to save his life? No, I won’t do it!"
verses.textEnNasb: But I said, "Should a man like me flee? And who is there like me who would go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go in."
verses.textEn: But I said, "Should a man like me run away? Or should someone like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go!"

verses.textZh: 我看出神并没有差派他，是他自己宣讲这话攻击我，因为多比雅和参巴拉收买了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看出神并没有差派他，是他自己宣讲这话攻击我，因为多比雅和参巴拉收买了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看明神没有差遣他，是他自己说这话攻击我，是多比雅和参巴拉贿买了他。
verses.textEnNiv: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had prophesied against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.textEnEsv: And I understood and saw that God had not sent him, but he had pronounced the prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I perceived that God had not sent him at all, but that he pronounced this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.textEnNlt: I realized that God had not spoken to him, but that he had uttered this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I realized that God certainly had not sent him, but he uttered his prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.textEn: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had prophesied against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

verses.textZh: 他被收买，是要使我惧怕，照着他说的去作，以致犯罪，他们就破坏我的名声来毁谤我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被收买，是要使我惧怕，照着他说的去作，以致犯罪，他们就破坏我的名声来毁谤我。
verses.textZhCuv: 贿买他的缘故，是要叫我惧怕，依从他犯罪，他们好传扬恶言毁谤我。
verses.textEnNiv: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would commit a sin by doing this, and then they would give me a bad name to discredit me.
verses.textEnEsv: For this purpose he was hired, that I should be afraid and act in this way and sin, and so they could give me a bad name in order to taunt me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason he was hired, that I should be afraid and act that way and sin, so that they might have cause for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
verses.textEnNlt: They were hoping to intimidate me and make me sin. Then they would be able to accuse and discredit me.
verses.textEnNasb: He was hired for this reason, that I would become frightened and act accordingly and sin, so that they might have an evil report in order that they could taunt me.
verses.textEn: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would commit a sin by doing this, and then they would give me a bad name to discredit me.

verses.textZh: "我的神啊，求你记住多比雅和参巴拉，按着他们所行的报应他们；也要报应女先知挪亚底和其余的先知，因为他们恐吓我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的神啊，求你记住多比雅和参巴拉，按着他们所行的报应他们；也要报应女先知挪亚底和其余的先知，因为他们恐吓我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，多比雅、参巴拉、女先知挪亚底，和其余的先知要叫我惧怕，求你记念他们所行的这些事。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, my God, because of what they have done; remember also the prophet Noadiah and how she and the rest of the prophets have been trying to intimidate me.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, O my God, according to these things that they did, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets who wanted to make me afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: My God, remember Tobiah and Sanballat, according to these their works, and the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets who would have made me afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, O my God, all the evil things that Tobiah and Sanballat have done. And remember Noadiah the prophet and all the prophets like her who have tried to intimidate me.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat in accordance with these works of theirs, and also Noadiah the prophetess and the rest of the prophets, who were trying to frighten me.
verses.textEn: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, my God, because of what they have done; remember also the prophet Noadiah and how she and the rest of the prophets have been trying to intimidate me.

verses.textZh: 以禄月二十五日，城墙建成，整个工程共用了五十二天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以禄月二十五日，城墙建成，整个工程共用了五十二天。
verses.textZhCuv: 以禄月二十五日，城墙修完了，共修了五十二天。
verses.textEnNiv: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.
verses.textEnEsv: So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.
verses.textEnNlt: So on October 2 the wall was finished—just fifty-two days after we had begun.
verses.textEnNasb: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.
verses.textEn: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.

verses.textZh: 我们所有的仇敌听见了，我们四围所有的民族都惧怕，敌人的声势一落千丈，他们都承认这工程是靠着我们神的帮助完成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所有的仇敌听见了，我们四围所有的民族都惧怕，敌人的声势一落千丈，他们都承认这工程是靠着我们神的帮助完成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们一切仇敌、四围的外邦人听见了便惧怕，愁眉不展；因为见这工作完成是出乎我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and lost their self-confidence, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all our enemies heard of it, all the nations around us were afraid and fell greatly in their own esteem, for they perceived that this work had been accomplished with the help of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when all our enemies heard ofit, and all the nations around us saw thesethings, that they were very disheartened in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.
verses.textEnNlt: When our enemies and the surrounding nations heard about it, they were frightened and humiliated. They realized this work had been done with the help of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: When all our enemies heard about it, and all the nations surrounding us saw it, they lost their confidence; for they realized that this work had been accomplished with the help of our God.
verses.textEn: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and lost their self-confidence, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.

verses.textZh: 在这段日子，犹大人的贵族写了许多信给多比雅，多比雅也常常回信给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这段日子，犹大人的贵族写了许多信给多比雅，多比雅也常常回信给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些日子，犹大的贵胄屡次寄信与多比雅，多比雅也来信与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, in those days the nobles of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and replies from Tobiah kept coming to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and thelettersof Tobiah came to them.
verses.textEnNlt: During those fifty-two days, many letters went back and forth between Tobiah and the nobles of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Also in those days many letters went from the nobles of Judah to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.
verses.textEn: Also, in those days the nobles of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and replies from Tobiah kept coming to them.

verses.textZh: 在犹大有许多人与多比雅结盟；因为他是亚拉的儿子、示迦尼的女婿，并且他的儿子约哈难娶了比利迦的儿子米书兰的女儿为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在犹大有许多人与多比雅结盟；因为他是亚拉的儿子、示迦尼的女婿，并且他的儿子约哈难娶了比利迦的儿子米书兰的女儿为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 在犹大有许多人与多比雅结盟；因他是亚拉的儿子，示迦尼的女婿，并且他的儿子约哈难娶了比利迦儿子米书兰的女儿为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: For many in Judah were under oath to him, since he was son-in-law to Shekaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.
verses.textEnEsv: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah: and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: For many in Judah were pledged to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shechaniah the son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
verses.textEnNlt: For many in Judah had sworn allegiance to him because his father-in-law was Shecaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan was married to the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
verses.textEn: For many in Judah were under oath to him, since he was son-in-law to Shekaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.

verses.textZh: 不但这样，他们也常常在我面前提起多比雅的善行，又把我说的话传给他；多比雅又常常寄信来恐吓我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但这样，他们也常常在我面前提起多比雅的善行，又把我说的话传给他；多比雅又常常寄信来恐吓我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们常在我面前说多比雅的善行，也将我的话传与他。多比雅又常寄信来，要叫我惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, they kept reporting to me his good deeds and then telling him what I said. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.
verses.textEnEsv: Also they spoke of his good deeds in my presence and reported my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to make me afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to frighten me.
verses.textEnNlt: They kept telling me about Tobiah’s good deeds, and then they told him everything I said. And Tobiah kept sending threatening letters to intimidate me.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they were speaking about his good deeds in my presence, and were reporting my words to him. Then Tobiah sent letters to frighten me.
verses.textEn: Moreover, they kept reporting to me his good deeds and then telling him what I said. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.

verses.textZh: 城墙建成后，我就装上门扇，委派了守门的、歌唱者和利未人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 城墙建成后，我就装上门扇，委派了守门的、歌唱者和利未人，
verses.textZhCuv: 城墙修完，我安了门扇，守门的、歌唱的，和利未人都已派定。
verses.textEnNiv: After the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the Levites were appointed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the wall had been built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers, the singers, and the Levites had been appointed,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it was, when the wall was built and I had hung the doors, when the gatekeepers, the singers, and the Levites had been appointed,
verses.textEnNlt: After the wall was finished and I had set up the doors in the gates, the gatekeepers, singers, and Levites were appointed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the wall was rebuilt and I had installed the doors, and the gatekeepers, the singers, and the Levites were appointed,
verses.textEn: After the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the Levites were appointed.

verses.textZh: 我委任我的兄弟哈拿尼和营楼长哈拿尼雅，管理耶路撒冷，因为哈拿尼雅是个可信靠的人，敬畏神胜过许多人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我委任我的兄弟哈拿尼和营楼长哈拿尼雅，管理耶路撒冷，因为哈拿尼雅是个可信靠的人，敬畏神胜过许多人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就派我的弟兄哈拿尼和营楼的宰官哈拿尼雅管理耶路撒冷；因为哈拿尼雅是忠信的，又敬畏神过于众人。
verses.textEnNiv: I put in charge of Jerusalem my brother Hanani, along with Hananiah the commander of the citadel, because he was a man of integrity and feared God more than most people do.
verses.textEnEsv: I gave my brother Hanani and Hananiah the governor of the castle charge over Jerusalem, for he was a more faithful and God-fearing man than many.
verses.textEnNkjv: that I gave the charge of Jerusalem to my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the leader of the citadel, for he was a faithful man and feared God more than many.
verses.textEnNlt: I gave the responsibility of governing Jerusalem to my brother Hanani, along with Hananiah, the commander of the fortress, for he was a faithful man who feared God more than most.
verses.textEnNasb: then I put Hanani my brother, and Hananiah the commander of the citadel, in charge of Jerusalem, for he was a faithful man and feared God more than many.
verses.textEn: I put in charge of Jerusalem my brother Hanani, along with Hananiah the commander of the citadel, because he was a man of integrity and feared God more than most people do.

verses.textZh: 我吩咐他们说："日上中天时，耶路撒冷的城门也不可长久敞开；太阳还停着未落，守门的人站岗的时候，也要关好门、上好闩，要派耶路撒冷的居民站岗，一些人在哨岗，另一些人在自己的屋前瞭望。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我吩咐他们说："日上中天时，耶路撒冷的城门也不可长久敞开；太阳还停着未落，守门的人站岗的时候，也要关好门、上好闩，要派耶路撒冷的居民站岗，一些人在哨岗，另一些人在自己的屋前瞭望。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我吩咐他们说：「等到太阳上升才可开耶路撒冷的城门；人尚看守的时候就要关门上闩；也当派耶路撒冷的居民各按班次看守自己房屋对面之处。」
verses.textEnNiv: I said to them, "The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot. While the gatekeepers are still on duty, have them shut the doors and bar them. Also appoint residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some near their own houses."
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to them, "Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot. And while they are still standing guard, let them shut and bar the doors. Appoint guards from among the inhabitants of Jerusalem, some at their guard posts and some in front of their own homes."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to them, "Do not let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut and bar the doors; and appoint guards from among the inhabitants of Jerusalem, one at his watch station and another in front of his own house."
verses.textEnNlt: I said to them, "Do not leave the gates open during the hottest part of the day. And even while the gatekeepers are on duty, have them shut and bar the doors. Appoint the residents of Jerusalem to act as guards, everyone on a regular watch. Some will serve at sentry posts and some in front of their own homes."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to them, "The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot, and while they are standing guard, the gatekeepers are to keep the doors shut and bolted. Also appoint guards from the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each at his post, and each in front of his own house."
verses.textEn: I said to them, "The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot. While the gatekeepers are still on duty, have them shut the doors and bar them. Also appoint residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some near their own houses."

verses.textZh: 城既宽阔又广大，但城中的居民稀少；房屋还没有建造起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城既宽阔又广大，但城中的居民稀少；房屋还没有建造起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 城是广大，其中的民却稀少，房屋还没有建造。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the city was large and spacious, but there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.
