verses.textEnEsv: The city was wide and large, but the people within it were few, and no houses had been rebuilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the city was large and spacious, but the people in it were few, and the houses were not rebuilt.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the city was large and spacious, but the population was small, and none of the houses had been rebuilt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the city was large and spacious, but the people in it were few and the houses were not built.
verses.textEn: Now the city was large and spacious, but there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.

verses.textZh: 我的神使我的心定意，召集贵族、官长和人民，要照家谱登记。我找到头一次上来的人的家谱，我找到的家谱上面写着：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神使我的心定意，召集贵族、官长和人民，要照家谱登记。我找到头一次上来的人的家谱，我找到的家谱上面写着：
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神感动我心，招聚贵胄、官长，和百姓，要照家谱计算。我找着第一次上来之人的家谱，其上写着：
verses.textEnNiv: So my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials and the common people for registration by families. I found the genealogical record of those who had been the first to return. This is what I found written there:
verses.textEnEsv: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles and the officials and the people to be enrolled by genealogy. And I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found written in it:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then my God put it into my heart to gather the nobles, the rulers, and the people, that they might be registered by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of those who had come up in the first return, and found written in it:
verses.textEnNlt: So my God gave me the idea to call together all the nobles and leaders of the city, along with the ordinary citizens, for registration. I had found the genealogical record of those who had first returned to Judah. This is what was written there:
verses.textEnNasb: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials, and the other people to be enrolled by genealogies. Then I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up first, in which I found the following record:
verses.textEn: So my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials and the common people for registration by families. I found the genealogical record of those who had been the first to return. This is what I found written there:

verses.textEnNkjv: the sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, the sons of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two;
verses.textEnNlt: This group included the families of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda—a total of 642 people.
verses.textEnNasb: the sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, the sons of Nekoda, 642.
verses.textEn: the descendants ofDelaiah, Tobiah and Nekoda642

verses.textZh: 祭司中，有哈巴雅的子孙、哈哥斯的子孙和巴西莱的子孙；巴西莱娶了基列人巴西莱的一个女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司中，有哈巴雅的子孙、哈哥斯的子孙和巴西莱的子孙；巴西莱娶了基列人巴西莱的一个女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孙、哈哥斯的子孙、巴西莱的子孙；因为他们的先祖娶了基列人巴西莱的女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。
verses.textEnNiv: And from among the priests: the descendants ofHobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).
verses.textEnEsv: Also, of the priests: the sons of Hobaiah, the sons of Hakkoz, the sons of Barzillai (who had taken a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).
verses.textEnNkjv: and of the priests: the sons of Habaiah, the sons of Koz, the sons of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called by their name.
verses.textEnNlt: Three families of priests—Hobaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai—also returned. (This Barzillai had married a woman who was a descendant of Barzillai of Gilead, and he had taken her family name.)
verses.textEnNasb: And of the priests: the sons of Hobaiah, the sons of Hakkoz, the sons of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai, the Gileadite, and was named after them.
verses.textEn: And from among the priests: the descendants ofHobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).

verses.textZh: 这些人查考族谱的记录，却找不着，因此他们算为不洁净，不能作祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人查考族谱的记录，却找不着，因此他们算为不洁净，不能作祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 这三家的人在族谱之中寻查自己的谱系，却寻不着，因此算为不洁，不准供祭司的职任。
verses.textEnNiv: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: These sought their registration among those enrolled in the genealogies, but it was not found there, so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: These sought their listing among those who were registered by genealogy, but it was not found; therefore they were excluded from the priesthood as defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: They searched for their names in the genealogical records, but they were not found, so they were disqualified from serving as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: These searched among their ancestral registration, but it could not be located; therefore they were considered unclean and disqualified from the priesthood.
verses.textEn: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

verses.textZh: 省长告诉他们不可吃至圣之物，直等到有能用乌陵和土明来决疑的祭司兴起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 省长告诉他们不可吃至圣之物，直等到有能用乌陵和土明来决疑的祭司兴起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 省长对他们说：「不可吃至圣的物，直到有用乌陵和土明决疑的祭司兴起来。」
verses.textEnNiv: The governor, therefore, ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there should be a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.
verses.textEnEsv: The governor told them that they were not to partake of the most holy food until a priest with Urim and Thummim should arise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the governor said to them that they should not eat of the most holy things till a priest could consult with the Urim and Thummim.
verses.textEnNlt: The governor told them not to eat the priests’ share of food from the sacrifices until a priest could consult the Lord about the matter by using the Urim and Thummim—the sacred lots.
verses.textEnNasb: And the governor said to them that they were not to eat from the most holy things until a priest arose with Urim and Thummim.
verses.textEn: The governor, therefore, ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there should be a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.

verses.textZh: 全体会众共有四万二千三百六十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众共有四万二千三百六十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众共有四万二千三百六十名。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole company numbered 42,360,
verses.textEnEsv: The whole assembly together was 42,360,
verses.textEnNkjv: Altogether the whole assembly was forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,
verses.textEnNlt: So a total of 42,360 people returned to Judah,
verses.textEnNasb: The whole assembly together totaled 42,360,
verses.textEn: The whole company numbered 42,360,

verses.textZh: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七人；又有男女歌唱者二百四十五人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七人；又有男女歌唱者二百四十五人。
verses.textZhCuv: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百四十五名。
verses.textEnNiv: besides their 7,337 male and female slaves; and they also had 245 male and female singers.
verses.textEnEsv: besides their male and female servants, of whom there were 7,337. And they had 245 singers, male and female.
verses.textEnNkjv: besides their male and female servants, of whom therewere seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred and forty-five men and women singers.
verses.textEnNlt: in addition to 7,337 servants and 245 singers, both men and women.
verses.textEnNasb: besides their male slaves and their female slaves, of whom there were 7,337; and they had 245 male and female singers.
verses.textEn: besides their 7,337 male and female slaves; and they also had 245 male and female singers.

verses.textZh: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹，
verses.textEnNiv: There were 736 horses, 245 mules,
verses.textEnEsv: Their horses were 736, their mules 245,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six, their mules two hundred and forty-five,
verses.textEnNlt: They took with them 736 horses, 245 mules,
verses.textEnNasb: Their horses were 736; their mules, 245;
verses.textEn: There were 736 horses, 245 mules,

verses.textZh: 骆驼四百三十五匹和驴子六千七百二十头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骆驼四百三十五匹和驴子六千七百二十头。
verses.textZhCuv: 骆驼四百三十五只，驴六千七百二十匹。
verses.textEnNiv: 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: their camels 435, and their donkeys 6,720.
verses.textEnNkjv: their camels four hundred and thirty-five, and donkeys six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.textEnNlt: 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: their camels, 435; their donkeys, 6,720.
verses.textEn: 435 camels and 6,720 donkeys.

verses.textZh: 有些族长为了这工程而捐献；省长捐给库房金子八公斤、碗五十个和祭司的礼服五百三十件；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些族长为了这工程而捐献；省长捐给库房金子八公斤、碗五十个和祭司的礼服五百三十件；
verses.textZhCuv: 有些族长为工程捐助。省长捐入库中的金子一千达利克，碗五十个，祭司的礼服五百三十件。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls and 530 garments for priests.
verses.textEnEsv: Now some of the heads of fathers’ houses gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 basins, 30 priests’ garments and 500 minas of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of the heads of the fathers’ houses gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand gold drachmas, fifty basins, and five hundred and thirty priestly garments.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the family leaders gave gifts for the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 gold coins, 50 gold basins, and 530 robes for the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury a thousand gold drachmas, fifty basins, and 530 priests’ garments.
verses.textEn: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls and 530 garments for priests.

verses.textZh: 族长捐给这工程的库房金子一百六十八公斤、银子一千二百五十公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 族长捐给这工程的库房金子一百六十八公斤、银子一千二百五十公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有族长捐入工程库的金子二万达利克，银子二千二百弥拿。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the heads of fathers’ houses gave into the treasury of the work 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some of the heads of the fathers’ houses gave to the treasury of the work twenty thousand gold drachmas, and two thousand two hundred silver minas.
verses.textEnNlt: The other leaders gave to the treasury a total of 20,000 gold coins and some 2,750 pounds of silver for the work.
verses.textEnNasb: And some of the heads of fathers’ households gave to the treasury for the work twenty thousand gold drachmas and 2,200 silver minas.
verses.textEn: Some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.

verses.textZh: 其余的人民捐献金子一百六十八公斤，银子一千一百四十公斤、祭司的礼服六十七件。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的人民捐献金子一百六十八公斤，银子一千一百四十公斤、祭司的礼服六十七件。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余百姓所捐的金子二万达利克，银子二千弥拿，祭司的礼服六十七件。
verses.textEnNiv: The total given by the rest of the people was 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver and 67 garments for priests.
verses.textEnEsv: And what the rest of the people gave was 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver, and 67 priests’ garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand gold drachmas, two thousand silver minas, and sixty-seven priestly garments.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the people gave 20,000 gold coins, about 2,500 pounds of silver, and 67 robes for the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: What the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand gold drachmas, two thousand silver minas, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.
verses.textEn: The total given by the rest of the people was 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver and 67 garments for priests.

verses.textZh: 于是祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱者、一部分人民、作殿役的，和以色列众人都住在自己的城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱者、一部分人民、作殿役的，和以色列众人都住在自己的城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱的、民中的一些人、尼提宁，并以色列众人，各住在自己的城里。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the temple servants, along with certain of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns,
verses.textEnEsv: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel, lived in their towns. And when the seventh month had come, the people of Israel were in their towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the Nethinim, and all Israel dwelt in their cities. When the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
verses.textEnNlt: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the Temple servants, and some of the common people settled near Jerusalem. The rest of the people returned to their own towns throughout Israel. In October when the Israelites had settled in their towns,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. And when the seventh month came, the sons of Israel were in their cities.
verses.textEn: The priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the musicians and the temple servants, along with certain of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns,

verses.textZh: 到了七月，以色列人都住在自己的城里。 那时众民如同一人，在水门前的广场聚集，请经学家以斯拉把耶和华藉摩西命令以色列人遵守的律法书带来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了七月，以色列人都住在自己的城里。 那时众民如同一人，在水门前的广场聚集，请经学家以斯拉把耶和华藉摩西命令以色列人遵守的律法书带来。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了七月，以色列人住在自己的城里。那时，他们如同一人聚集在水门前的宽阔处，请文士以斯拉将耶和华藉摩西传给以色列人的律法书带来。
verses.textEnNiv: all the people came together as one in the square before the Water Gate. They told Ezra the teacher of the Law to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people gathered as one man into the square before the Water Gate. And they told Ezra the scribe to bring the Book of the Law of Moses that the Lord had commanded Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the people gathered together as one man in the open square that was in front of the Water Gate; and they told Ezra the scribe to bring the Book of the Law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: all the people assembled with a unified purpose at the square just inside the Water Gate. They asked Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the Lord had given for Israel to obey.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people gathered as one person at the public square which was in front of the Water Gate, and they asked Ezra the scribe to bring the Book of the Law of Moses which the Lord had given to Israel.
verses.textEn: all the people came together as one in the square before the Water Gate. They told Ezra the teacher of the Law to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded for Israel.

verses.textZh: 七月初一日，以斯拉祭司把律法书带到所有听了能明白的男女会众面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七月初一日，以斯拉祭司把律法书带到所有听了能明白的男女会众面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 七月初一日，祭司以斯拉将律法书带到听了能明白的男女会众面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So on the first day of the seventh month Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly, which was made up of men and women and all who were able to understand.
verses.textEnEsv: So Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly, both men and women and all who could understand what they heard, on the first day of the seventh month.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly of men and women and all who could hear with understanding on the first day of the seventh month.
verses.textEnNlt: So on October 8 Ezra the priest brought the Book of the Law before the assembly, which included the men and women and all the children old enough to understand.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly of men, women, and all who could listen with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
verses.textEn: So on the first day of the seventh month Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly, which was made up of men and women and all who were able to understand.

verses.textZh: 在水门前面的广场，从清早到中午，向众男女和听了能明白的人宣读出来。众民都侧耳倾听这律法书的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在水门前面的广场，从清早到中午，向众男女和听了能明白的人宣读出来。众民都侧耳倾听这律法书的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 在水门前的宽阔处，从清早到晌午，在众男女、一切听了能明白的人面前读这律法书。众民侧耳而听。
verses.textEnNiv: He read it aloud from daybreak till noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate in the presence of the men, women and others who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: And he read from it facing the square before the Water Gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women and those who could understand. And the ears of all the people were attentive to the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he read from it in the open square that was in front of the Water Gate from morning until midday, before the men and women and those who could understand; and the ears of all the people wereattentive to the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnNlt: He faced the square just inside the Water Gate from early morning until noon and read aloud to everyone who could understand. All the people listened closely to the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnNasb: And he read from it before the public square which was in front of the Water Gate, from early morning until midday, in the presence of men and women, those who could understand; and all the people were attentive to the Book of the Law.
verses.textEn: He read it aloud from daybreak till noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate in the presence of the men, women and others who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.

verses.textZh: 经学家以斯拉站在为这事特制的木台上；站在他右边的，有玛他提雅、示玛、亚奈雅、乌利亚、希勒家和玛西雅；站在他左边的，有毘大雅、米沙利、玛基雅、哈顺、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亚和米书兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家以斯拉站在为这事特制的木台上；站在他右边的，有玛他提雅、示玛、亚奈雅、乌利亚、希勒家和玛西雅；站在他左边的，有毘大雅、米沙利、玛基雅、哈顺、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亚和米书兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 文士以斯拉站在为这事特备的木台上。玛他提雅、示玛、亚奈雅、乌利亚、希勒家，和玛西雅站在他的右边；毗大雅、米沙利、玛基雅、哈顺、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亚，和米书兰站在他的左边。
verses.textEnNiv: Ezra the teacher of the Law stood on a high wooden platform built for the occasion. Beside him on his right stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah and Maaseiah; and on his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ezra the scribe stood on a wooden platform that they had made for the purpose. And beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah on his right hand, and Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam on his left hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ezra the scribe stood on a platform of wood which they had made for the purpose; and beside him, at his right hand, stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Urijah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah; and at his left hand Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.textEnNlt: Ezra the scribe stood on a high wooden platform that had been made for the occasion. To his right stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah. To his left stood Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.textEnNasb: Ezra the scribe stood at a wooden podium which they had made for the purpose. And beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah on his right; and Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam on his left.
verses.textEn: Ezra the teacher of the Law stood on a high wooden platform built for the occasion. Beside him on his right stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah and Maaseiah; and on his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.

verses.textZh: 以斯拉在众人眼前展开那书卷；他高高地站在众民以上，他把书卷展开，众民就站起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉在众人眼前展开那书卷；他高高地站在众民以上，他把书卷展开，众民就站起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉站在众民以上，在众民眼前展开这书。他一展开，众民就都站起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Ezra opened the book. All the people could see him because he was standing above them; and as he opened it, the people all stood up.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was above all the people, and as he opened it all the people stood.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was standing above all the people; and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
verses.textEnNlt: Ezra stood on the platform in full view of all the people. When they saw him open the book, they all rose to their feet.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was standing above all the people; and when he opened it, all the people stood up.
verses.textEn: Ezra opened the book. All the people could see him because he was standing above them; and as he opened it, the people all stood up.

verses.textZh: 以斯拉称颂耶和华至大的神，众民举手应声说："阿们！阿们！"然后跪下，脸伏在地，敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉称颂耶和华至大的神，众民举手应声说："阿们！阿们！"然后跪下，脸伏在地，敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉称颂耶和华至大的神；众民都举手应声说：「阿们！阿们！」就低头，面伏于地，敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Ezra praised the Lord , the great God; and all the people lifted their hands and responded, "Amen! Amen!" Then they bowed down and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ezra blessed the Lord , the great God, and all the people answered, "Amen, Amen," lifting up their hands. And they bowed their heads and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. Then all the people answered, "Amen, Amen!" while lifting up their hands. And they bowed their heads and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ezra praised the Lord , the great God, and all the people chanted, "Amen! Amen!" as they lifted their hands. Then they bowed down and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, "Amen, Amen!" with the raising of their hands; then they kneeled down and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEn: Ezra praised the Lord , the great God; and all the people lifted their hands and responded, "Amen! Amen!" Then they bowed down and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.

verses.textZh: 然后利未人耶书亚、巴尼、示利比、雅悯、亚谷、沙比太、荷第雅、玛西雅、基利他、亚撒利雅、约撒拔、哈难和毘莱雅就教导他们明白律法。众人一直站在原处聆听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后利未人耶书亚、巴尼、示利比、雅悯、亚谷、沙比太、荷第雅、玛西雅、基利他、亚撒利雅、约撒拔、哈难和毘莱雅就教导他们明白律法。众人一直站在原处聆听。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶书亚、巴尼、示利比、雅悯、亚谷、沙比太、荷第雅、玛西雅、基利他、亚撒利雅、约撒拔、哈难、毗莱雅，和利未人使百姓明白律法；百姓都站在自己的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan and Pelaiah—instructed the people in the Law while the people were standing there.
verses.textEnEsv: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, the Levites, helped the people to understand the Law, while the people remained in their places.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, helped the people to understand the Law; and the people stood in their place.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah—then instructed the people in the Law while everyone remained in their places.
verses.textEnNasb: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites explained the Law to the people while the people remained in their place.
verses.textEn: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan and Pelaiah—instructed the people in the Law while the people were standing there.

verses.textZh: 他们宣读神的律法，把意义清楚翻译出来，使众民明白所宣读的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们宣读神的律法，把意义清楚翻译出来，使众民明白所宣读的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们清清楚楚地念神的律法书，讲明意思，使百姓明白所念的。
verses.textEnNiv: They read from the Book of the Law of God, making it clear and giving the meaning so that the people understood what was being read.
verses.textEnEsv: They read from the book, from the Law of God, clearly, and they gave the sense, so that the people understood the reading.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they read distinctly from the book, in the Law of God; and they gave the sense, and helped them to understand the reading.
verses.textEnNlt: They read from the Book of the Law of God and clearly explained the meaning of what was being read, helping the people understand each passage.
verses.textEnNasb: They read from the book, from the Law of God, translating to give the sense so that they understood the reading.
verses.textEn: They read from the Book of the Law of God, making it clear and giving the meaning so that the people understood what was being read.

verses.textZh: 省长尼希米和祭司兼经学家以斯拉，以及教导人民明白律法的利未人对众民说："今天是耶和华你们的神的圣日，你们不要悲哀哭泣。"因为众人听见律法书上的话，都哭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 省长尼希米和祭司兼经学家以斯拉，以及教导人民明白律法的利未人对众民说："今天是耶和华你们的神的圣日，你们不要悲哀哭泣。"因为众人听见律法书上的话，都哭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 省长尼希米和作祭司的文士以斯拉，并教训百姓的利未人，对众民说：「今日是耶和华－你们神的圣日，不要悲哀哭泣。」这是因为众民听见律法书上的话都哭了；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher of the Law, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to them all, "This day is holy to the Lord your God. Do not mourn or weep." For all the people had been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nehemiah, who was the governor, and Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, "This day is holy to the Lord your God; do not mourn or weep." For all the people wept as they heard the words of the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, "This day is holy to the Lord your God; do not mourn nor weep." For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the Law.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were interpreting for the people said to them, "Don’t mourn or weep on such a day as this! For today is a sacred day before the Lord your God." For the people had all been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nehemiah, who was the governor, and Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, "This day is holy to the Lord your God; do not mourn or weep." For all the people were weeping when they heard the words of the Law.
verses.textEn: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher of the Law, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to them all, "This day is holy to the Lord your God. Do not mourn or weep." For all the people had been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.

verses.textZh: 尼希米又对他们说："你们应当去吃肥美的肉，喝甘甜的酒，把部分饮食分给没有能力预备的人，因为今天是我们的主的圣日；你们不要忧愁，因为靠耶和华而得的喜乐是你们的力量。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼希米又对他们说："你们应当去吃肥美的肉，喝甘甜的酒，把部分饮食分给没有能力预备的人，因为今天是我们的主的圣日；你们不要忧愁，因为靠耶和华而得的喜乐是你们的力量。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对他们说：「你们去吃肥美的，喝甘甜的，有不能预备的就分给他，因为今日是我们主的圣日。你们不要忧愁，因靠耶和华而得的喜乐是你们的力量。」
verses.textEnNiv: Nehemiah said, "Go and enjoy choice food and sweet drinks, and send some to those who have nothing prepared. This day is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the Lord is your strength."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to them, "Go your way. Eat the fat and drink sweet wine and send portions to anyone who has nothing ready, for this day is holy to our Lord. And do not be grieved, for the joy of the Lord is your strength."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "Go your way, eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to those for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy to our Lord. Do not sorrow, for the joy of the Lord is your strength."
verses.textEnNlt: And Nehemiah continued, "Go and celebrate with a feast of rich foods and sweet drinks, and share gifts of food with people who have nothing prepared. This is a sacred day before our Lord. Don’t be dejected and sad, for the joy of the Lord is your strength!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to them, "Go, eat the festival foods, drink the sweet drinks, and send portions to him who has nothing prepared; for this day is holy to our Lord. Do not be grieved, for the joy of the Lord is your refuge."
verses.textEn: Nehemiah said, "Go and enjoy choice food and sweet drinks, and send some to those who have nothing prepared. This day is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the Lord is your strength."

verses.textZh: 于是利未人使众民安静下来，说："你们安静吧，因为今天是圣日，也不要再忧愁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是利未人使众民安静下来，说："你们安静吧，因为今天是圣日，也不要再忧愁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是利未人使众民静默，说：「今日是圣日；不要作声，也不要忧愁。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites calmed all the people, saying, "Be still, for this is a holy day. Do not grieve."
verses.textEnEsv: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, "Be quiet, for this day is holy; do not be grieved."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Levites quieted all the people, saying, "Be still, for the day is holy; do not be grieved."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Levites, too, quieted the people, telling them, "Hush! Don’t weep! For this is a sacred day."
verses.textEnNasb: So the Levites silenced all the people, saying, "Be still, for the day is holy; do not be grieved."
verses.textEn: The Levites calmed all the people, saying, "Be still, for this is a holy day. Do not grieve."

verses.textZh: 众民就去吃喝，也把部分饮食与人分享，大大欢乐。因为他们明白教训他们的话。 守住棚节
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民就去吃喝，也把部分饮食与人分享，大大欢乐。因为他们明白教训他们的话。 守住棚节
verses.textZhCuv: 众民都去吃喝，也分给人，大大快乐，因为他们明白所教训他们的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the people went away to eat and drink, to send portions of food and to celebrate with great joy, because they now understood the words that had been made known to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people went their way to eat and drink and to send portions and to make great rejoicing, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people went their way to eat and drink, to send portions and rejoice greatly, because they understood the words that were declared to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people went away to eat and drink at a festive meal, to share gifts of food, and to celebrate with great joy because they had heard God’s words and understood them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people went away to eat, drink, to send portions, and to celebrate a great feast, because they understood the words which had been made known to them.
verses.textEn: Then all the people went away to eat and drink, to send portions of food and to celebrate with great joy, because they now understood the words that had been made known to them.

verses.textZh: 第二天，众民的族长、祭司和利未人都聚集到经学家以斯拉那里，研究律法的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，众民的族长、祭司和利未人都聚集到经学家以斯拉那里，研究律法的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，众民的族长、祭司，和利未人都聚集到文士以斯拉那里，要留心听律法上的话。
verses.textEnNiv: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered around Ezra the teacher to give attention to the words of the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: On the second day the heads of fathers’ houses of all the people, with the priests and the Levites, came together to Ezra the scribe in order to study the words of the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the second day the heads of the fathers’ houses of all the people, with the priests and Levites, were gathered to Ezra the scribe, in order to understand the words of the Law.
verses.textEnNlt: On October 9 the family leaders of all the people, together with the priests and Levites, met with Ezra the scribe to go over the Law in greater detail.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the second day the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered to Ezra the scribe so that they might gain insight into the words of the Law.
verses.textEn: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered around Ezra the teacher to give attention to the words of the Law.

verses.textZh: 他们发现律法上记载，耶和华曾借着摩西吩咐以色列人，要在七月的节期中，住在棚里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们发现律法上记载，耶和华曾借着摩西吩咐以色列人，要在七月的节期中，住在棚里，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们见律法上写着，耶和华藉摩西吩咐以色列人要在七月节住棚，
verses.textEnNiv: They found written in the Law, which the Lord had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to live in temporary shelters during the festival of the seventh month
verses.textEnEsv: And they found it written in the Law that the Lord had commanded by Moses that the people of Israel should dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they found written in the Law, which the Lord had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month,
verses.textEnNlt: As they studied the Law, they discovered that the Lord had commanded through Moses that the Israelites should live in shelters during the festival to be held that month.
verses.textEnNasb: And they found written in the Law how the Lord had commanded through Moses that the sons of Israel were to live in booths during the feast of the seventh month.
verses.textEn: They found written in the Law, which the Lord had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to live in temporary shelters during the festival of the seventh month

verses.textZh: 并且要在自己的城里和在耶路撒冷宣扬布告说："你们要上到山上，把橄榄树枝、油木树枝、番石榴枝、棕树枝和树叶繁茂大树的枝子带回来，照着律法所写的搭棚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且要在自己的城里和在耶路撒冷宣扬布告说："你们要上到山上，把橄榄树枝、油木树枝、番石榴枝、棕树枝和树叶繁茂大树的枝子带回来，照着律法所写的搭棚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并要在各城和耶路撒冷宣传报告说：「你们当上山，将橄榄树、野橄榄树、番石榴树、棕树，和各样茂密树的枝子取来，照着所写的搭棚。」
verses.textEnNiv: and that they should proclaim this word and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem: "Go out into the hill country and bring back branches from olive and wild olive trees, and from myrtles, palms and shade trees, to make temporary shelters"—as it is written.
verses.textEnEsv: and that they should proclaim it and publish it in all their towns and in Jerusalem, "Go out to the hills and bring branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees to make booths, as it is written."
verses.textEnNkjv: and that they should announce and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, "Go out to the mountain, and bring olive branches, branches of oil trees, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of leafy trees, to make booths, as itis written."
verses.textEnNlt: He had said that a proclamation should be made throughout their towns and in Jerusalem, telling the people to go to the hills to get branches from olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees. They were to use these branches to make shelters in which they would live during the festival, as prescribed in the Law.
verses.textEnNasb: And that they were to proclaim and circulate a proclamation in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, "Go out to the hills, and bring olive branches and wild olive branches, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of other trees with thick branches, to make booths, as it is written."
verses.textEn: and that they should proclaim this word and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem: "Go out into the hill country and bring back branches from olive and wild olive trees, and from myrtles, palms and shade trees, to make temporary shelters"—as it is written.

verses.textZh: 于是众民出去，把树枝带回来，各人在自己的房顶上，在院子里，神的院中，水门的广场，或是在以法莲门的广场搭棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众民出去，把树枝带回来，各人在自己的房顶上，在院子里，神的院中，水门的广场，或是在以法莲门的广场搭棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是百姓出去，取了树枝来，各人在自己的房顶上，或院内，或神殿的院内，或水门的宽阔处，或以法莲门的宽阔处搭棚。
verses.textEnNiv: So the people went out and brought back branches and built themselves temporary shelters on their own roofs, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God and in the square by the Water Gate and the one by the Gate of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people went out and brought them and made booths for themselves, each on his roof, and in their courts and in the courts of the house of God, and in the square at the Water Gate and in the square at the Gate of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people went out and brought them and made themselves booths, each one on the roof of his house, or in their courtyards or the courts of the house of God, and in the open square of the Water Gate and in the open square of the Gate of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people went out and cut branches and used them to build shelters on the roofs of their houses, in their courtyards, in the courtyards of God’s Temple, or in the squares just inside the Water Gate and the Ephraim Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people went out and brought them and made booths for themselves, each on his roof, and in their courtyards and in the courtyards of the house of God, and in the public square at the Water Gate, and in the square at the Gate of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: So the people went out and brought back branches and built themselves temporary shelters on their own roofs, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God and in the square by the Water Gate and the one by the Gate of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 从被掳归回的全体会众都搭了棚，并且住在棚里；从嫩的儿子约书亚的时候，直到那日，以色列人都没有这样行过。大家都非常快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从被掳归回的全体会众都搭了棚，并且住在棚里；从嫩的儿子约书亚的时候，直到那日，以色列人都没有这样行过。大家都非常快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 从掳到之地归回的全会众就搭棚，住在棚里。从嫩的儿子约书亚的时候直到这日，以色列人没有这样行。于是众人大大喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole company that had returned from exile built temporary shelters and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated it like this. And their joy was very great.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the assembly of those who had returned from the captivity made booths and lived in the booths, for from the days of Jeshua the son of Nun to that day the people of Israel had not done so. And there was very great rejoicing.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the whole assembly of those who had returned from the captivity made booths and sat under the booths; for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun until that day the children of Israel had not done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.textEnNlt: So everyone who had returned from captivity lived in these shelters during the festival, and they were all filled with great joy! The Israelites had not celebrated like this since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnNasb: The entire assembly of those who had returned from the captivity made booths and lived in the booths. Indeed, the sons of Israel had not done so since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day. And there was very great rejoicing.
verses.textEn: The whole company that had returned from exile built temporary shelters and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated it like this. And their joy was very great.

verses.textZh: 从头一天直到最后一天，每天都宣读神的律法书。他们守节七天，第八天照典章有严肃会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从头一天直到最后一天，每天都宣读神的律法书。他们守节七天，第八天照典章有严肃会。
verses.textZhCuv: 从头一天直到末一天，以斯拉每日念神的律法书。众人守节七日，第八日照例有严肃会。
verses.textEnNiv: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. They celebrated the festival for seven days, and on the eighth day, in accordance with the regulation, there was an assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: And day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read from the Book of the Law of God. They kept the feast seven days, and on the eighth day there was a solemn assembly, according to the rule.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also day by day, from the first day until the last day, he read from the Book of the Law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day therewas a sacred assembly, according to the prescribed manner.
verses.textEnNlt: Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God on each of the seven days of the festival. Then on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, as was required by law.
verses.textEnNasb: He read from the Book of the Law of God daily, from the first day to the last day. And they celebrated the feast seven days, and on the eighth day there was a festive assembly in accordance with the ordinance.
verses.textEn: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. They celebrated the festival for seven days, and on the eighth day, in accordance with the regulation, there was an assembly.

verses.textZh: 这月二十四日，以色列人聚集，一同禁食，身穿麻衣，头上蒙灰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这月二十四日，以色列人聚集，一同禁食，身穿麻衣，头上蒙灰。
verses.textZhCuv: 这月二十四日，以色列人聚集禁食，身穿麻衣，头蒙灰尘。
verses.textEnNiv: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth and putting dust on their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the people of Israel were assembled with fasting and in sackcloth, and with earth on their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, in sackcloth, and with dust on their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: On October 31 the people assembled again, and this time they fasted and dressed in burlap and sprinkled dust on their heads.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the sons of Israel assembled with fasting, in sackcloth and with dirt upon them.
verses.textEn: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth and putting dust on their heads.

verses.textZh: 以色列的后裔跟所有外族人分离，然后站立，承认自己的罪过和他们列祖的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的后裔跟所有外族人分离，然后站立，承认自己的罪过和他们列祖的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人 就与一切外邦人离绝，站着承认自己的罪恶和列祖的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: Those of Israelite descent had separated themselves from all foreigners. They stood in their places and confessed their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Israelites separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those of Israelite lineage separated themselves from all foreigners; and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Those of Israelite descent separated themselves from all foreigners as they confessed their own sins and the sins of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: The descendants of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and they stood and confessed their sins and the wrongdoings of their fathers.
verses.textEn: Those of Israelite descent had separated themselves from all foreigners. They stood in their places and confessed their sins and the sins of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 那天四分之一的时间，他们站在自己的地方，宣读耶和华他们的神的律法书；另外四分之一的时间，他们认罪和敬拜耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天四分之一的时间，他们站在自己的地方，宣读耶和华他们的神的律法书；另外四分之一的时间，他们认罪和敬拜耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日的四分之一站在自己的地方念耶和华－他们神的律法书，又四分之一认罪，敬拜耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the Lord their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter in confession and in worshiping the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And they stood up in their place and read from the Book of the Law of the Lord their God for a quarter of the day; for another quarter of it they made confession and worshiped the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they stood up in their place and read from the Book of the Law of the Lord their God forone–fourth of the day; and foranother fourth they confessed and worshiped the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: They remained standing in place for three hours while the Book of the Law of the Lord their God was read aloud to them. Then for three more hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: While they stood in their place, they read from the Book of the Law of the Lord their God for a fourth of the day; and for another fourth they confessed and worshiped the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the Lord their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter in confession and in worshiping the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 耶书亚、巴尼、甲篾、示巴尼、布尼、示利比、巴尼和基拿尼，站立在利未人的台阶上，向耶和华他们的神大声哀求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶书亚、巴尼、甲篾、示巴尼、布尼、示利比、巴尼和基拿尼，站立在利未人的台阶上，向耶和华他们的神大声哀求。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶书亚、巴尼、甲篾、示巴尼、布尼、示利比、巴尼、基拿尼站在利未人的台上，大声哀求耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Standing on the stairs of the Levites were Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani and Kenani. They cried out with loud voices to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: On the stairs of the Levites stood Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani; and they cried with a loud voice to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the stairs of the Levites and cried out with a loud voice to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Kenani—stood on the stairway of the Levites and cried out to the Lord their God with loud voices.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the Levites’ platform stood Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and they cried out with a loud voice to the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: Standing on the stairs of the Levites were Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani and Kenani. They cried out with loud voices to the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 利未人耶书亚、甲篾、巴尼、哈沙尼、示利比、荷第雅、示巴尼和毘他希雅说："你们要起立，称颂耶和华你们的神，直到永永远远。" "耶和华啊，你荣耀的名是应当称颂的； 愿你的名被尊崇，超过一切称颂和赞美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人耶书亚、甲篾、巴尼、哈沙尼、示利比、荷第雅、示巴尼和毘他希雅说："你们要起立，称颂耶和华你们的神，直到永永远远。" "耶和华啊，你荣耀的名是应当称颂的； 愿你的名被尊崇，超过一切称颂和赞美。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人耶书亚、甲篾、巴尼、哈沙尼、示利比、荷第雅、示巴尼、毗他希雅说：「你们要站起来称颂耶和华－你们的神，永世无尽。耶和华啊，你荣耀之名是应当称颂的！超乎一切称颂和赞美。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah and Pethahiah—said: "Stand up and praise the Lord your God, who is from everlasting to everlasting. " "Blessed be your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, "Stand up and bless the Lord your God from everlasting to everlasting. Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said: "Stand up and bless the Lord your God Forever and ever! "Blessed be Your glorious name, Which is exalted above all blessing and praise!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leaders of the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah—called out to the people: "Stand up and praise the Lord your God, for he lives from everlasting to everlasting!" Then they prayed: "May your glorious name be praised! May it be exalted above all blessing and praise!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said, "Arise, bless the Lord your God forever and ever! May Your glorious name be blessed And exalted above all blessing and praise!
verses.textEn: And the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah and Pethahiah—said: "Stand up and praise the Lord your God, who is from everlasting to everlasting. " "Blessed be your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.

verses.textZh: 你，唯独你是耶和华， 你造了天， 天上的天和天军， 地和地上的万物， 海和海中的万物， 你使这一切生存， 天军也都敬拜你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你，唯独你是耶和华， 你造了天， 天上的天和天军， 地和地上的万物， 海和海中的万物， 你使这一切生存， 天军也都敬拜你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你，惟独你是耶和华！你造了天和天上的天，并天上的万象，地和地上的万物，海和海中所有的；这一切都是你所保存的。天军也都敬拜你。
verses.textEnNiv: You alone are the Lord . You made the heavens, even the highest heavens, and all their starry host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to everything, and the multitudes of heaven worship you.
verses.textEnEsv: "You are the Lord , you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them; and you preserve all of them; and the host of heaven worships you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You alone are the Lord; You have made heaven, The heaven of heavens, with all their host, The earth and everything on it, The seas and all that is in them, And You preserve them all. The host of heaven worships You.
verses.textEnNlt: "You alone are the Lord . You made the skies and the heavens and all the stars. You made the earth and the seas and everything in them. You preserve them all, and the angels of heaven worship you.
verses.textEnNasb: "You alone are the Lord. You have made the heavens, The heaven of heavens with all their lights, The earth and everything that is on it, The seas and everything that is in them. You give life to all of them, And the heavenly lights bow down before You.
verses.textEn: You alone are the Lord . You made the heavens, even the highest heavens, and all their starry host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to everything, and the multitudes of heaven worship you.

verses.textZh: 你是耶和华神， 你拣选亚伯兰， 带领他出了迦勒底的吾珥， 改他的名字为亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是耶和华神， 你拣选亚伯兰， 带领他出了迦勒底的吾珥， 改他的名字为亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是耶和华神，曾拣选亚伯兰，领他出迦勒底的吾珥，给他改名叫亚伯拉罕。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are the Lord God, who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: You are the Lord , the God who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are the Lord God, Who chose Abram, And brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, And gave him the name Abraham;
verses.textEnNlt: "You are the Lord God, who chose Abram and brought him from Ur of the Chaldeans and renamed him Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are the Lord God, Who chose Abram And brought him out from Ur of the Chaldees, And gave him the name Abraham.
verses.textEn: "You are the Lord God, who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham.

verses.textZh: 你见他在你面前心里诚实可靠， 就与他立约， 要把迦南人、 赫人、亚摩利人、 比利洗人、耶布斯人和革迦撒人之地， 赐给他的后裔； 你履行了你的诺言， 因为你是公义的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你见他在你面前心里诚实可靠， 就与他立约， 要把迦南人、 赫人、亚摩利人、 比利洗人、耶布斯人和革迦撒人之地， 赐给他的后裔； 你履行了你的诺言， 因为你是公义的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你见他在你面前心里诚实，就与他立约，应许把迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、革迦撒人之地赐给他的后裔，且应验了你的话，因为你是公义的。
verses.textEnNiv: You found his heart faithful to you, and you made a covenant with him to give to his descendants the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites and Girgashites. You have kept your promise because you are righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: You found his heart faithful before you, and made with him the covenant to give to his offspring the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite. And you have kept your promise, for you are righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: You found his heart faithful before You, And made a covenant with him To give the land of the Canaanites, The Hittites, the Amorites, The Perizzites, the Jebusites, And the Girgashites— To give it to his descendants. You have performed Your words, For You are righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: When he had proved himself faithful, you made a covenant with him to give him and his descendants the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites, and Girgashites. And you have done what you promised, for you are always true to your word.
verses.textEnNasb: "You found his heart faithful before You, And made a covenant with him To give him the land of the Canaanite, Of the Hittite and the Amorite, Of the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite— To give it to his descendants. And You have fulfilled Your promise, Because You are righteous.
verses.textEn: You found his heart faithful to you, and you made a covenant with him to give to his descendants the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites and Girgashites. You have kept your promise because you are righteous.

verses.textZh: 你看见我们的列祖在埃及所受的困苦， 垂听他们在红海的哀求，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见我们的列祖在埃及所受的困苦， 垂听他们在红海的哀求，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你曾看见我们列祖在埃及所受的困苦，垂听他们在红海边的哀求，
verses.textEnNiv: "You saw the suffering of our ancestors in Egypt; you heard their cry at the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt and heard their cry at the Red Sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, And heard their cry by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: "You saw the misery of our ancestors in Egypt, and you heard their cries from beside the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, And heard their cry by the Red Sea.
verses.textEn: "You saw the suffering of our ancestors in Egypt; you heard their cry at the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 因为你知道埃及人怎样狂妄自大地对待他们， 所以就对法老和他的一切臣仆，以及他国中所有的人民， 施行神迹奇事， 为你自己建立了至今仍存的名声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你知道埃及人怎样狂妄自大地对待他们， 所以就对法老和他的一切臣仆，以及他国中所有的人民， 施行神迹奇事， 为你自己建立了至今仍存的名声。
verses.textZhCuv: 就施行神迹奇事在法老和他一切臣仆，并他国中的众民身上。你也得了名声，正如今日一样，因为你知道他们向我们列祖行事狂傲。
verses.textEnNiv: You sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his officials and all the people of his land, for you knew how arrogantly the Egyptians treated them. You made a name for yourself, which remains to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: and performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh and all his servants and all the people of his land, for you knew that they acted arrogantly against our fathers. And you made a name for yourself, as it is to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: You showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, Against all his servants, And against all the people of his land. For You knew that they acted proudly against them. So You made a name for Yourself, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: You displayed miraculous signs and wonders against Pharaoh, his officials, and all his people, for you knew how arrogantly they were treating our ancestors. You have a glorious reputation that has never been forgotten.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, Against all his servants and all the people of his land; For You knew that they acted arrogantly toward them, And You made a name for Yourself as it is this day.
verses.textEn: You sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his officials and all the people of his land, for you knew how arrogantly the Egyptians treated them. You made a name for yourself, which remains to this day.

verses.textZh: 你又在我们的列祖面前把海分开， 使他们在海中的干地上走过去； 把追赶他们的人丢在深处， 好象石头拋进怒海之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又在我们的列祖面前把海分开， 使他们在海中的干地上走过去； 把追赶他们的人丢在深处， 好象石头拋进怒海之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你又在我们列祖面前把海分开，使他们在海中行走干地，将追赶他们的人抛在深海，如石头抛在大水中；
verses.textEnNiv: You divided the sea before them, so that they passed through it on dry ground, but you hurled their pursuers into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.
verses.textEnEsv: And you divided the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on dry land, and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into mighty waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And You divided the sea before them, So that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; And their persecutors You threw into the deep, As a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.textEnNlt: You divided the sea for your people so they could walk through on dry land! And then you hurled their enemies into the depths of the sea. They sank like stones beneath the mighty waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "You divided the sea before them, So they passed through the midst of the sea on dry ground; And You hurled their pursuers into the depths, Like a stone into raging waters.
verses.textEn: You divided the sea before them, so that they passed through it on dry ground, but you hurled their pursuers into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.

verses.textZh: 日间你用云柱引导他们， 夜间用火柱光照他们要行的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日间你用云柱引导他们， 夜间用火柱光照他们要行的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且白昼用云柱引导他们，黑夜用火柱照亮他们当行的路。
verses.textEnNiv: By day you led them with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire to give them light on the way they were to take.
verses.textEnEsv: By a pillar of cloud you led them in the day, and by a pillar of fire in the night to light for them the way in which they should go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover You led them by day with a cloudy pillar, And by night with a pillar of fire, To give them light on the road Which they should travel.
verses.textEnNlt: You led our ancestors by a pillar of cloud during the day and a pillar of fire at night so that they could find their way.
verses.textEnNasb: "And with a pillar of cloud You led them by day, And with a pillar of fire by night To light for them the way In which they were to go.
verses.textEn: By day you led them with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire to give them light on the way they were to take.

verses.textZh: 你降临西奈山上， 从天上与他们说话， 赐给他们正直的典章、真实的律法、 美好的条例与诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你降临西奈山上， 从天上与他们说话， 赐给他们正直的典章、真实的律法、 美好的条例与诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也降临在西奈山，从天上与他们说话，赐给他们正直的典章、真实的律法、美好的条例与诫命，
verses.textEnNiv: "You came down on Mount Sinai; you spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and laws that are just and right, and decrees and commands that are good.
verses.textEnEsv: You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven and gave them right rules and true laws, good statutes and commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You came down also on Mount Sinai, And spoke with them from heaven, And gave them just ordinances and true laws, Good statutes and commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: "You came down at Mount Sinai and spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and instructions that were just, and decrees and commands that were good.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then You came down on Mount Sinai, And spoke with them from heaven; You gave them just ordinances and true laws, Good statutes and commandments.
verses.textEn: "You came down on Mount Sinai; you spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and laws that are just and right, and decrees and commands that are good.

verses.textZh: 你使他们认识你的圣安息， 藉你仆人摩西向他们颁布诫命、条例和律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他们认识你的圣安息， 藉你仆人摩西向他们颁布诫命、条例和律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 又使他们知道你的安息圣日，并藉你仆人摩西传给他们诫命、条例、律法。
verses.textEnNiv: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commands, decrees and laws through your servant Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: and you made known to them your holy Sabbath and commanded them commandments and statutes and a law by Moses your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: You made known to them Your holy Sabbath, And commanded them precepts, statutes and laws, By the hand of Moses Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: You instructed them concerning your holy Sabbath. And you commanded them, through Moses your servant, to obey all your commands, decrees, and instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: "So You made known to them Your holy Sabbath, And gave them commandments, statutes, and law, Through Your servant Moses.
verses.textEn: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commands, decrees and laws through your servant Moses.

verses.textZh: 你从天上赐下粮食，给他们充饥， 吩咐水从盘石流出来给他们解渴； 你又吩咐他们进去占领， 你举手起誓要赐给他们的那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你从天上赐下粮食，给他们充饥， 吩咐水从盘石流出来给他们解渴； 你又吩咐他们进去占领， 你举手起誓要赐给他们的那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 从天上赐下粮食充他们的饥，从磐石使水流出解他们的渴，又吩咐他们进去得你起誓应许赐给他们的地。
verses.textEnNiv: In their hunger you gave them bread from heaven and in their thirst you brought them water from the rock; you told them to go in and take possession of the land you had sworn with uplifted hand to give them.
verses.textEnEsv: You gave them bread from heaven for their hunger and brought water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and you told them to go in to possess the land that you had sworn to give them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You gave them bread from heaven for their hunger, And brought them water out of the rock for their thirst, And told them to go in to possess the land Which You had sworn to give them.
verses.textEnNlt: "You gave them bread from heaven when they were hungry and water from the rock when they were thirsty. You commanded them to go and take possession of the land you had sworn to give them.
verses.textEnNasb: "You provided bread from heaven for them for their hunger, You brought out water from a rock for them for their thirst, And You told them to enter in order to take possession of The land which You swore to give them.
verses.textEn: In their hunger you gave them bread from heaven and in their thirst you brought them water from the rock; you told them to go in and take possession of the land you had sworn with uplifted hand to give them.

verses.textZh: 但是我们的列祖狂妄自大， 硬着颈项，不听从你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我们的列祖狂妄自大， 硬着颈项，不听从你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 「但我们的列祖行事狂傲，硬着颈项不听从你的诫命；
verses.textEnNiv: "But they, our ancestors, became arrogant and stiff-necked, and they did not obey your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: "But they and our fathers acted presumptuously and stiffened their neck and did not obey your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But they and our fathers acted proudly, Hardened their necks, And did not heed Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: "But our ancestors were proud and stubborn, and they paid no attention to your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: "But they, our fathers, acted arrogantly; They became stubborn and would not listen to Your commandments.
verses.textEn: "But they, our ancestors, became arrogant and stiff-necked, and they did not obey your commands.

verses.textZh: 他们拒绝听从， 也不记念你在他们中间所行的奇事， 硬着颈项，存心悖逆，自立首领， 要回到他们为奴之地去。 但你是乐意饶恕的神， 你有恩典，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱， 所以你没有撇弃他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拒绝听从， 也不记念你在他们中间所行的奇事， 硬着颈项，存心悖逆，自立首领， 要回到他们为奴之地去。 但你是乐意饶恕的神， 你有恩典，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱， 所以你没有撇弃他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 不肯顺从，也不记念你在他们中间所行的奇事，竟硬着颈项，居心悖逆，自立首领，要回他们为奴之地。但你是乐意饶恕人，有恩典，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，有丰盛慈爱的神，并不丢弃他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,
verses.textEnEsv: They refused to obey and were not mindful of the wonders that you performed among them, but they stiffened their neck and appointed a leader to return to their slavery in Egypt. But you are a God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, and did not forsake them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They refused to obey, And they were not mindful of Your wonders That You did among them. But they hardened their necks, And in their rebellion They appointed a leader To return to their bondage. But You are God, Ready to pardon, Gracious and merciful, Slow to anger, Abundant in kindness, And did not forsake them.
verses.textEnNlt: They refused to obey and did not remember the miracles you had done for them. Instead, they became stubborn and appointed a leader to take them back to their slavery in Egypt. But you are a God of forgiveness, gracious and merciful, slow to become angry, and rich in unfailing love. You did not abandon them,
verses.textEnNasb: "They refused to listen, And did not remember Your wondrous deeds which You performed among them; So they became stubborn and appointed a leader to return to their slavery in Egypt. But You are a God of forgiveness, Gracious and compassionate, Slow to anger and abounding in mercy; And You did not abandon them.
verses.textEn: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,

verses.textZh: 他们更为自己铸造了一头牛犊的雕像， 说：‘这就是把你们从埃及领上来的神！’ 他们犯了亵渎大罪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们更为自己铸造了一头牛犊的雕像， 说：‘这就是把你们从埃及领上来的神！’ 他们犯了亵渎大罪，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们虽然铸了一只牛犊，彼此说『这是领你出埃及的神』，因而大大惹动你的怒气；
verses.textEnNiv: even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your god, who brought you up out of Egypt,’ or when they committed awful blasphemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Even when they had made for themselves a golden calf and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed great blasphemies,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Even when they made a molded calf for themselves, And said, ‘This is your god That brought you up out of Egypt,’ And worked great provocations,
verses.textEnNlt: even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and said, ‘This is your god who brought you out of Egypt!’ They committed terrible blasphemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even when they made for themselves A calf of cast metal And said, ‘This is your god Who brought you up from Egypt,’ And committed great blasphemies,
verses.textEn: even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your god, who brought you up out of Egypt,’ or when they committed awful blasphemies.

verses.textZh: 你还是因着你丰盛的怜悯， 没有把他们撇弃在旷野； 日间云柱没有离开他们， 仍然在路上引导他们； 夜间火柱也没有离开他们，还是光照他们要行的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你还是因着你丰盛的怜悯， 没有把他们撇弃在旷野； 日间云柱没有离开他们， 仍然在路上引导他们； 夜间火柱也没有离开他们，还是光照他们要行的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 你还是大施怜悯，在旷野不丢弃他们。白昼，云柱不离开他们，仍引导他们行路；黑夜，火柱也不离开他们，仍照亮他们当行的路。
verses.textEnNiv: "Because of your great compassion you did not abandon them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud did not fail to guide them on their path, nor the pillar of fire by night to shine on the way they were to take.
verses.textEnEsv: you in your great mercies did not forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud to lead them in the way did not depart from them by day, nor the pillar of fire by night to light for them the way by which they should go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet in Your manifold mercies You did not forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of the cloud did not depart from them by day, To lead them on the road; Nor the pillar of fire by night, To show them light, And the way they should go.
verses.textEnNlt: "But in your great mercy you did not abandon them to die in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud still led them forward by day, and the pillar of fire showed them the way through the night.
verses.textEnNasb: You, in Your great compassion, Did not abandon them in the wilderness; The pillar of cloud did not leave them by day, To guide them on their way, Nor the pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they were to go.
verses.textEn: "Because of your great compassion you did not abandon them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud did not fail to guide them on their path, nor the pillar of fire by night to shine on the way they were to take.

verses.textZh: 你赐下良善的灵教导他们； 你没有留住吗哪不给他们吃； 你给他们水解渴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你赐下良善的灵教导他们； 你没有留住吗哪不给他们吃； 你给他们水解渴。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也赐下你良善的灵教训他们；未尝不赐吗哪使他们糊口，并赐水解他们的渴。
verses.textEnNiv: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them and did not withhold your manna from their mouth and gave them water for their thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also gave Your good Spirit to instruct them, And did not withhold Your manna from their mouth, And gave them water for their thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: You sent your good Spirit to instruct them, and you did not stop giving them manna from heaven or water for their thirst.
verses.textEnNasb: "Instead, You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them, You did not withhold Your manna from their mouth, And You gave them water for their thirst.
verses.textEn: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.

verses.textZh: 在旷野四十年，你供养他们，他们毫无缺乏， 衣服没有穿破，他们的脚也没有肿痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在旷野四十年，你供养他们，他们毫无缺乏， 衣服没有穿破，他们的脚也没有肿痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 在旷野四十年，你养育他们，他们就一无所缺：衣服没有穿破，脚也没有肿。
verses.textEnNiv: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing, their clothes did not wear out nor did their feet become swollen.
verses.textEnEsv: Forty years you sustained them in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.
verses.textEnNkjv: Forty years You sustained them in the wilderness; They lacked nothing; Their clothes did not wear out And their feet did not swell.
verses.textEnNlt: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out, and their feet did not swell!
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, for forty years You provided for them in the wilderness and they were not lacking; Their clothes did not wear out, nor did their feet swell up.
verses.textEn: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing, their clothes did not wear out nor did their feet become swollen.

verses.textZh: 你把列国和万民赐给他们， 你把列国分给他们作疆界， 他们就获得西宏之地，希实本王之地和巴珊王噩之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把列国和万民赐给他们， 你把列国分给他们作疆界， 他们就获得西宏之地，希实本王之地和巴珊王噩之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你将列国之地照分赐给他们，他们就得了西宏之地、希实本王之地，和巴珊王噩之地。
verses.textEnNiv: "You gave them kingdoms and nations, allotting to them even the remotest frontiers. They took over the country of Sihon king of Heshbon and the country of Og king of Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted to them every corner. So they took possession of the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover You gave them kingdoms and nations, And divided them into districts. So they took possession of the land of Sihon, The land of the king of Heshbon, And the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you helped our ancestors conquer kingdoms and nations, and you placed your people in every corner of the land. They took over the land of King Sihon of Heshbon and the land of King Og of Bashan.
verses.textEnNasb: "You also gave them kingdoms and peoples, And allotted them to them as a boundary. They took possession of the land of Sihon the king of Heshbon And the land of Og the king of Bashan.
verses.textEn: "You gave them kingdoms and nations, allotting to them even the remotest frontiers. They took over the country of Sihon king of Heshbon and the country of Og king of Bashan.

verses.textZh: 你使他们的子孙众多，像天上的星星那么多； 你把他们带进你应许他们的列祖要进去得为业的那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他们的子孙众多，像天上的星星那么多； 你把他们带进你应许他们的列祖要进去得为业的那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也使他们的子孙多如天上的星，带他们到你所应许他们列祖进入得为业之地。
verses.textEnNiv: You made their children as numerous as the stars in the sky, and you brought them into the land that you told their parents to enter and possess.
verses.textEnEsv: You multiplied their children as the stars of heaven, and you brought them into the land that you had told their fathers to enter and possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also multiplied their children as the stars of heaven, And brought them into the land Which You had told their fathers To go in and possess.
verses.textEnNlt: You made their descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and brought them into the land you had promised to their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: "You made their sons as numerous as the stars of heaven, And You brought them into the land Which You had told their fathers to enter and possess.
verses.textEn: You made their children as numerous as the stars in the sky, and you brought them into the land that you told their parents to enter and possess.

verses.textZh: 于是他们的子孙进去，获得那地； 你使那地的迦南居民向他们屈服， 又把迦南众王和那地的各民族，都交在以色列人手里， 以色列人可以随意对待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们的子孙进去，获得那地； 你使那地的迦南居民向他们屈服， 又把迦南众王和那地的各民族，都交在以色列人手里， 以色列人可以随意对待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他们进去得了那地，你在他们面前制伏那地的居民，就是迦南人；将迦南人和其君王，并那地的居民，都交在他们手里，让他们任意而待。
verses.textEnNiv: Their children went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the Canaanites, who lived in the land; you gave the Canaanites into their hands, along with their kings and the peoples of the land, to deal with them as they pleased.
verses.textEnEsv: So the descendants went in and possessed the land, and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hand, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people went in And possessed the land; You subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, The Canaanites, And gave them into their hands, With their kings And the people of the land, That they might do with them as they wished.
verses.textEnNlt: "They went in and took possession of the land. You subdued whole nations before them. Even the Canaanites, who inhabited the land, were powerless! Your people could deal with these nations and their kings as they pleased.
verses.textEnNasb: "So their sons entered and took possession of the land. And You subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, And You handed them over to them, with their kings and the peoples of the land, To do with them as they desired.
verses.textEn: Their children went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the Canaanites, who lived in the land; you gave the Canaanites into their hands, along with their kings and the peoples of the land, to deal with them as they pleased.

verses.textZh: 他们夺取了坚固的城、肥沃的土地， 获得了满载各样财宝的房屋、 挖好的水井、葡萄园、橄榄园和很多果树； 他们吃得饱足，身体发胖， 因你的大恩生活安逸快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们夺取了坚固的城、肥沃的土地， 获得了满载各样财宝的房屋、 挖好的水井、葡萄园、橄榄园和很多果树； 他们吃得饱足，身体发胖， 因你的大恩生活安逸快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们得了坚固的城邑、肥美的地土、充满各样美物的房屋、凿成的水井、葡萄园、橄榄园，并许多果木树。他们就吃而得饱，身体肥胖，因你的大恩，心中快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: They captured fortified cities and fertile land; they took possession of houses filled with all kinds of good things, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves and fruit trees in abundance. They ate to the full and were well-nourished; they reveled in your great goodness.
verses.textEnEsv: And they captured fortified cities and a rich land, and took possession of houses full of all good things, cisterns already hewn, vineyards, olive orchards and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled and became fat and delighted themselves in your great goodness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took strong cities and a rich land, And possessed houses full of all goods, Cisterns already dug, vineyards, olive groves, And fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled and grew fat, And delighted themselves in Your great goodness.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors captured fortified cities and fertile land. They took over houses full of good things, with cisterns already dug and vineyards and olive groves and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate until they were full and grew fat and enjoyed themselves in all your blessings.
verses.textEnNasb: "They captured fortified cities and a fertile land. They took possession of houses full of every good thing, Carved out cisterns, vineyards, olive groves, Fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled and put on fat, And lived luxuriously in Your great goodness.
verses.textEn: They captured fortified cities and fertile land; they took possession of houses filled with all kinds of good things, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves and fruit trees in abundance. They ate to the full and were well-nourished; they reveled in your great goodness.

verses.textZh: "可是他们竟悖逆，背叛你， 把你的律法丢在背后， 杀害那些控告他们， 要他们归向你的先知， 犯了亵渎的大罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "可是他们竟悖逆，背叛你， 把你的律法丢在背后， 杀害那些控告他们， 要他们归向你的先知， 犯了亵渎的大罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「然而，他们不顺从，竟背叛你，将你的律法丢在背后，杀害那劝他们归向你的众先知，大大惹动你的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: "But they were disobedient and rebelled against you; they turned their backs on your law. They killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to turn them back to you; they committed awful blasphemies.
verses.textEnEsv: "Nevertheless, they were disobedient and rebelled against you and cast your law behind their back and killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to turn them back to you, and they committed great blasphemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Nevertheless they were disobedient And rebelled against You, Cast Your law behind their backs And killed Your prophets, who testified against them To turn them to Yourself; And they worked great provocations.
verses.textEnNlt: "But despite all this, they were disobedient and rebelled against you. They turned their backs on your Law, they killed your prophets who warned them to return to you, and they committed terrible blasphemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "But they became rebellious and revolted against You, And threw Your Law behind their backs And killed Your prophets who had admonished them In order to bring them back to You, And they committed great blasphemies.
verses.textEn: "But they were disobedient and rebelled against you; they turned their backs on your law. They killed your prophets, who had warned them in order to turn them back to you; they committed awful blasphemies.

verses.textZh: 所以你把他们交在敌人的手中，好让他们受困苦； 他们受困苦的时候，就向你呼求， 你就从天上垂听，按着你丰盛的怜悯， 赐给他们拯救者，拯救他们脱离敌人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你把他们交在敌人的手中，好让他们受困苦； 他们受困苦的时候，就向你呼求， 你就从天上垂听，按着你丰盛的怜悯， 赐给他们拯救者，拯救他们脱离敌人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你将他们交在敌人的手中，磨难他们。他们遭难的时候哀求你，你就从天上垂听，照你的大怜悯赐给他们拯救者，救他们脱离敌人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: So you delivered them into the hands of their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were oppressed they cried out to you. From heaven you heard them, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you gave them into the hand of their enemies, who made them suffer. And in the time of their suffering they cried out to you and you heard them from heaven, and according to your great mercies you gave them saviors who saved them from the hand of their enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore You delivered them into the hand of their enemies, Who oppressed them; And in the time of their trouble, When they cried to You, You heard from heaven; And according to Your abundant mercies You gave them deliverers who saved them From the hand of their enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: So you handed them over to their enemies, who made them suffer. But in their time of trouble they cried to you, and you heard them from heaven. In your great mercy, you sent them liberators who rescued them from their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore You handed them over to their enemies who oppressed them, But when they cried out to You in the time of their distress, You heard from heaven, and according to Your great compassion You gave them people who saved them from the hand of their enemies.
verses.textEn: So you delivered them into the hands of their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were oppressed they cried out to you. From heaven you heard them, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.

verses.textZh: 但他们得享安宁以后，又在你面前行恶，你就撇弃他们在仇敌的手中，让仇敌管辖他们； 然而他们回转过来，向你哀求，你就从天上垂听， 按着丰盛的怜悯，一次又一次拯救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们得享安宁以后，又在你面前行恶，你就撇弃他们在仇敌的手中，让仇敌管辖他们； 然而他们回转过来，向你哀求，你就从天上垂听， 按着丰盛的怜悯，一次又一次拯救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们得平安之后，又在你面前行恶，所以你丢弃他们在仇敌的手中，使仇敌辖制他们。然而他们转回哀求你，你仍从天上垂听，屡次照你的怜悯拯救他们，
verses.textEnNiv: "But as soon as they were at rest, they again did what was evil in your sight. Then you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies so that they ruled over them. And when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven, and in your compassion you delivered them time after time.
verses.textEnEsv: But after they had rest they did evil again before you, and you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies, so that they had dominion over them. Yet when they turned and cried to you, you heard from heaven, and many times you delivered them according to your mercies.
