verses.textEnNkjv: "But after they had rest, They again did evil before You. Therefore You left them in the hand of their enemies, So that they had dominion over them; Yet when they returned and cried out to You, You heard from heaven; And many times You delivered them according to Your mercies,
verses.textEnNlt: "But as soon as they were at peace, your people again committed evil in your sight, and once more you let their enemies conquer them. Yet whenever your people turned and cried to you again for help, you listened once more from heaven. In your wonderful mercy, you rescued them many times!
verses.textEnNasb: "But as soon as they had rest, they did evil again before You; Therefore You abandoned them to the hand of their enemies, so that they ruled over them. When they cried out again to You, You heard from heaven, And many times You rescued them according to Your compassion,
verses.textEn: "But as soon as they were at rest, they again did what was evil in your sight. Then you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies so that they ruled over them. And when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven, and in your compassion you delivered them time after time.

verses.textZh: 你警告他们，要他们转向你的律法； 但他们狂妄自大，不听从你的诫命， 犯罪干犯你的典章。 人应遵行这些典章，按照它们生活， 他们却固执地扭转肩头，硬着颈项，不肯听从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你警告他们，要他们转向你的律法； 但他们狂妄自大，不听从你的诫命， 犯罪干犯你的典章。 人应遵行这些典章，按照它们生活， 他们却固执地扭转肩头，硬着颈项，不肯听从。
verses.textZhCuv: 又警戒他们，要使他们归服你的律法。他们却行事狂傲，不听从你的诫命，干犯你的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），扭转肩头，硬着颈项，不肯听从。
verses.textEnNiv: "You warned them in order to turn them back to your law, but they became arrogant and disobeyed your commands. They sinned against your ordinances, of which you said, ‘The person who obeys them will live by them.’ Stubbornly they turned their backs on you, became stiff-necked and refused to listen.
verses.textEnEsv: And you warned them in order to turn them back to your law. Yet they acted presumptuously and did not obey your commandments, but sinned against your rules, which if a person does them, he shall live by them, and they turned a stubborn shoulder and stiffened their neck and would not obey.
verses.textEnNkjv: And testified against them, That You might bring them back to Your law. Yet they acted proudly, And did not heed Your commandments, But sinned against Your judgments, ‘Which if a man does, he shall live by them.’ And they shrugged their shoulders, Stiffened their necks, And would not hear.
verses.textEnNlt: "You warned them to return to your Law, but they became proud and obstinate and disobeyed your commands. They did not follow your regulations, by which people will find life if only they obey. They stubbornly turned their backs on you and refused to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: And admonished them in order to turn them back to Your Law. Yet they acted arrogantly and did not listen to Your commandments but sinned against Your ordinances, Which, if a person follows them, then he will live by them. And they turned a stubborn shoulder and stiffened their neck, and would not listen.
verses.textEn: "You warned them in order to turn them back to your law, but they became arrogant and disobeyed your commands. They sinned against your ordinances, of which you said, ‘The person who obeys them will live by them.’ Stubbornly they turned their backs on you, became stiff-necked and refused to listen.

verses.textZh: 你多年容忍他们， 你的灵借着你的众先知劝戒他们， 他们还是不侧耳而听， 所以你把他们交在各地的民族手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你多年容忍他们， 你的灵借着你的众先知劝戒他们， 他们还是不侧耳而听， 所以你把他们交在各地的民族手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你多年宽容他们，又用你的灵藉众先知劝戒他们，他们仍不听从，所以你将他们交在列国之民的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: For many years you were patient with them. By your Spirit you warned them through your prophets. Yet they paid no attention, so you gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: Many years you bore with them and warned them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not give ear. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet for many years You had patience with them, And testified against them by Your Spirit in Your prophets. Yet they would not listen; Therefore You gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.
verses.textEnNlt: In your love, you were patient with them for many years. You sent your Spirit, who warned them through the prophets. But still they wouldn’t listen! So once again you allowed the peoples of the land to conquer them.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, You remained patient with them for many years, And admonished them by Your Spirit through Your prophets, Yet they would not listen. Therefore You handed them over to the peoples of the lands.
verses.textEn: For many years you were patient with them. By your Spirit you warned them through your prophets. Yet they paid no attention, so you gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.

verses.textZh: 然而因你丰富的怜悯，你不把他们灭尽，也不撇弃他们， 因为你是有恩典有怜悯的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而因你丰富的怜悯，你不把他们灭尽，也不撇弃他们， 因为你是有恩典有怜悯的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而你大发怜悯，不全然灭绝他们，也不丢弃他们；因为你是有恩典、有怜悯的神。
verses.textEnNiv: But in your great mercy you did not put an end to them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, in your great mercies you did not make an end of them or forsake them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless in Your great mercy You did not utterly consume them nor forsake them; For You are God, gracious and merciful.
verses.textEnNlt: But in your great mercy, you did not destroy them completely or abandon them forever. What a gracious and merciful God you are!
verses.textEnNasb: "Nevertheless, in Your great compassion You did not make an end of them or abandon them, For You are a gracious and compassionate God.
verses.textEn: But in your great mercy you did not put an end to them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.

verses.textZh: "我们的神啊，你是至大、全能、至可畏、守约施慈爱的神，现在求你不要把我们、我们的君王和领袖、我们的祭司和先知、我们的列祖和你的众民， 从亚述列王的日子直到今日所遭遇的一切苦难，看为小事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们的神啊，你是至大、全能、至可畏、守约施慈爱的神，现在求你不要把我们、我们的君王和领袖、我们的祭司和先知、我们的列祖和你的众民， 从亚述列王的日子直到今日所遭遇的一切苦难，看为小事。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们的神啊，你是至大、至能、至可畏、守约施慈爱的神。我们的君王、首领、祭司、先知、列祖，和你的众民，从亚述列王的时候直到今日所遭遇的苦难，现在求你不要以为小。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now therefore, our God, the great God, mighty and awesome, who keeps his covenant of love, do not let all this hardship seem trifling in your eyes—the hardship that has come on us, on our kings and leaders, on our priests and prophets, on our ancestors and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now, therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and steadfast love, let not all the hardship seem little to you that has come upon us, upon our kings, our princes, our priests, our prophets, our fathers, and all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria until this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, our God, The great, the mighty, and awesome God, Who keeps covenant and mercy: Do not let all the trouble seem small before You That has come upon us, Our kings and our princes, Our priests and our prophets, Our fathers and on all Your people, From the days of the kings of Assyria until this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, our God, the great and mighty and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of unfailing love, do not let all the hardships we have suffered seem insignificant to you. Great trouble has come upon us and upon our kings and leaders and priests and prophets and ancestors—all of your people—from the days when the kings of Assyria first triumphed over us until now.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps His covenant and faithfulness, Do not let all the hardship seem insignificant before You, Which has happened to us, our kings, our leaders, our priests, our prophets, our fathers, and to all Your people, From the days of the kings of Assyria to this day.
verses.textEn: "Now therefore, our God, the great God, mighty and awesome, who keeps his covenant of love, do not let all this hardship seem trifling in your eyes—the hardship that has come on us, on our kings and leaders, on our priests and prophets, on our ancestors and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.

verses.textZh: 在一切临到我们身上的事上，你都是公义的； 因为你所行的是信实的，我们所行的是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在一切临到我们身上的事上，你都是公义的； 因为你所行的是信实的，我们所行的是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在一切临到我们的事上，你却是公义的；因你所行的是诚实，我们所做的是邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: In all that has happened to us, you have remained righteous; you have acted faithfully, while we acted wickedly.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you have been righteous in all that has come upon us, for you have dealt faithfully and we have acted wickedly.
verses.textEnNkjv: However You are just in all that has befallen us; For You have dealt faithfully, But we have done wickedly.
verses.textEnNlt: Every time you punished us you were being just. We have sinned greatly, and you gave us only what we deserved.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, You are righteous in everything that has happened to us; For You have dealt faithfully, but we have acted wickedly.
verses.textEn: In all that has happened to us, you have remained righteous; you have acted faithfully, while we acted wickedly.

verses.textZh: 我们的君王和领袖，我们的祭司和列祖，都没有遵行你的律法， 也没有留心听从你的诫命和你向他们郑重的警告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的君王和领袖，我们的祭司和列祖，都没有遵行你的律法， 也没有留心听从你的诫命和你向他们郑重的警告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的君王、首领、祭司、列祖都不遵守你的律法，不听从你的诫命和你警戒他们的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Our kings, our leaders, our priests and our ancestors did not follow your law; they did not pay attention to your commands or the statutes you warned them to keep.
verses.textEnEsv: Our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law or paid attention to your commandments and your warnings that you gave them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither our kings nor our princes, Our priests nor our fathers, Have kept Your law, Nor heeded Your commandments and Your testimonies, With which You testified against them.
verses.textEnNlt: Our kings, leaders, priests, and ancestors did not obey your Law or listen to the warnings in your commands and laws.
verses.textEnNasb: "For our kings, our leaders, our priests, and our fathers have not kept Your Law Or paid attention to Your commandments and Your admonitions with which You have admonished them.
verses.textEn: Our kings, our leaders, our priests and our ancestors did not follow your law; they did not pay attention to your commands or the statutes you warned them to keep.

verses.textZh: 他们在本国中， 享受你赐给他们的大福， 在你摆在他们面前这广大肥沃的地上， 却不事奉你，不转离他们的恶行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在本国中， 享受你赐给他们的大福， 在你摆在他们面前这广大肥沃的地上， 却不事奉你，不转离他们的恶行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在本国里沾你大恩的时候，在你所赐给他们这广大肥美之地上不事奉你，也不转离他们的恶行。
verses.textEnNiv: Even while they were in their kingdom, enjoying your great goodness to them in the spacious and fertile land you gave them, they did not serve you or turn from their evil ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Even in their own kingdom, and amid your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land that you set before them, they did not serve you or turn from their wicked works.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have not served You in their kingdom, Or in the many good things that You gave them, Or in the large and rich land which You set before them; Nor did they turn from their wicked works.
verses.textEnNlt: Even while they had their own kingdom, they did not serve you, though you showered your goodness on them. You gave them a large, fertile land, but they refused to turn from their wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: "But they, in their own kingdom, With Your great goodness which You gave them, With the broad and rich land which You placed before them, Did not serve You or turn from their evil deeds.
verses.textEn: Even while they were in their kingdom, enjoying your great goodness to them in the spacious and fertile land you gave them, they did not serve you or turn from their evil ways.

verses.textZh: 我们今天竟成了奴仆！ 就是在你赐给我们列祖享用其上果实和美物之地， 我们竟在这地上作了奴仆！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们今天竟成了奴仆！ 就是在你赐给我们列祖享用其上果实和美物之地， 我们竟在这地上作了奴仆！
verses.textZhCuv: 我们现今作了奴仆；至于你所赐给我们列祖享受其上的土产，并美物之地，看哪，我们在这地上作了奴仆！
verses.textEnNiv: "But see, we are slaves today, slaves in the land you gave our ancestors so they could eat its fruit and the other good things it produces.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, we are slaves this day; in the land that you gave to our fathers to enjoy its fruit and its good gifts, behold, we are slaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Here we are, servants today! And the land that You gave to our fathers, To eat its fruit and its bounty, Here we are, servants in it!
verses.textEnNlt: "So now today we are slaves in the land of plenty that you gave our ancestors for their enjoyment! We are slaves here in this good land.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, we are slaves today, And as for the land which You gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its bounty, Behold, we are slaves on it.
verses.textEn: "But see, we are slaves today, slaves in the land you gave our ancestors so they could eat its fruit and the other good things it produces.

verses.textZh: 这地丰富的出产都归给列王， 就是你因我们的罪派来管辖我们的； 他们也随意管辖我们的身体 和我们的牲畜； 我们遭遇大患难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地丰富的出产都归给列王， 就是你因我们的罪派来管辖我们的； 他们也随意管辖我们的身体 和我们的牲畜； 我们遭遇大患难。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地许多出产归了列王，就是你因我们的罪所派辖制我们的。他们任意辖制我们的身体和牲畜，我们遭了大难。」
verses.textEnNiv: Because of our sins, its abundant harvest goes to the kings you have placed over us. They rule over our bodies and our cattle as they please. We are in great distress.
verses.textEnEsv: And its rich yield goes to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. They rule over our bodies and over our livestock as they please, and we are in great distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it yields much increase to the kings You have set over us, Because of our sins; Also they have dominion over our bodies and our cattle At their pleasure; And we are in great distress.
verses.textEnNlt: The lush produce of this land piles up in the hands of the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. They have power over us and our livestock. We serve them at their pleasure, and we are in great misery."
verses.textEnNasb: "And its abundant produce is for the kings Whom You have set over us because of our sins; They also rule over our bodies And over our cattle as they please, So we are in great distress.
verses.textEn: Because of our sins, its abundant harvest goes to the kings you have placed over us. They rule over our bodies and our cattle as they please. We are in great distress.

verses.textZh: 现在由于这一切事， 我们立下确实的约，写在文件上； 我们的领袖、利未人和祭司，都在上面盖了印。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在由于这一切事， 我们立下确实的约，写在文件上； 我们的领袖、利未人和祭司，都在上面盖了印。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因这一切的事，我们立确实的约，写在册上。我们的首领、利未人，和祭司都签了名。
verses.textEnNiv: "In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it."
verses.textEnEsv: "Because of all this we make a firm covenant in writing; on the sealed document are the names of our princes, our Levites, and our priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And because of all this, We make a sure covenant and write it; Our leaders, our Levites, and our priests seal it."
verses.textEnNlt: The people responded, "In view of all this, we are making a solemn promise and putting it in writing. On this sealed document are the names of our leaders and Levites and priests."
verses.textEnNasb: " Now because of all this We are making an agreement in writing; And on the sealed document are the names of our leaders, our Levites, and our priests."
verses.textEn: "In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it."

verses.textZh: 其余的民众：祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱的、作殿役的，以及一切跟各地民族分离，归向神律法的和他们的妻子和儿女，所有有知识能够明白的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的民众：祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱的、作殿役的，以及一切跟各地民族分离，归向神律法的和他们的妻子和儿女，所有有知识能够明白的，
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的民、祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱的、尼提宁，和一切离绝邻邦居民归服神律法的，并他们的妻子、儿女，凡有知识能明白的，
verses.textEnNiv: "The rest of the people—priests, Levites, gatekeepers, musicians, temple servants and all who separated themselves from the neighboring peoples for the sake of the Law of God, together with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand—
verses.textEnEsv: "The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all who have separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the Law of God, their wives, their sons, their daughters, all who have knowledge and understanding,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the people—the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the Nethinim, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the Law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, everyone who had knowledge and understanding—
verses.textEnNlt: Then the rest of the people—the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, Temple servants, and all who had separated themselves from the pagan people of the land in order to obey the Law of God, together with their wives, sons, daughters, and all who were old enough to understand—
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the Law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, all those who had knowledge and understanding,
verses.textEn: "The rest of the people—priests, Levites, gatekeepers, musicians, temple servants and all who separated themselves from the neighboring peoples for the sake of the Law of God, together with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand—

verses.textZh: 都坚持和他们的贵族兄弟参与发咒起誓，必遵行神藉他仆人摩西颁布的律法，必谨守遵行耶和华我们的主的一切诫命、典章和律例；
verses.textZhCnvs: 都坚持和他们的贵族兄弟参与发咒起誓，必遵行神藉他仆人摩西颁布的律法，必谨守遵行耶和华我们的主的一切诫命、典章和律例；
verses.textZhCuv: 都随从他们贵胄的弟兄，发咒起誓，必遵行神藉他仆人摩西所传的律法，谨守遵行耶和华－我们主的一切诫命、典章、律例；
verses.textEnNiv: all these now join their fellow Israelites the nobles, and bind themselves with a curse and an oath to follow the Law of God given through Moses the servant of God and to obey carefully all the commands, regulations and decrees of the Lord our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: join with their brothers, their nobles, and enter into a curse and an oath to walk in God’s Law that was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord and his rules and his statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: these joined with their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse and an oath to walk in God’s Law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and His ordinances and His statutes:
verses.textEnNlt: joined their leaders and bound themselves with an oath. They swore a curse on themselves if they failed to obey the Law of God as issued by his servant Moses. They solemnly promised to carefully follow all the commands, regulations, and decrees of the Lord our Lord:
verses.textEnNasb: are joining with their kinsmen, their nobles, and are taking on themselves a curse and an oath to walk in God’s Law, which was given through Moses, God’s servant, and to keep and to comply with all the commandments of God our Lord, and His ordinances and statutes;
verses.textEn: all these now join their fellow Israelites the nobles, and bind themselves with a curse and an oath to follow the Law of God given through Moses the servant of God and to obey carefully all the commands, regulations and decrees of the Lord our Lord.

verses.textZh: 我们必不把我们的女儿嫁给这地的外族人，也不为我们的儿子娶他们的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们必不把我们的女儿嫁给这地的外族人，也不为我们的儿子娶他们的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 并不将我们的女儿嫁给这地的居民，也不为我们的儿子娶他们的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: "We promise not to give our daughters in marriage to the peoples around us or take their daughters for our sons.
verses.textEnEsv: We will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: We would not give our daughters as wives to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;
verses.textEnNlt: "We promise not to let our daughters marry the pagan people of the land, and not to let our sons marry their daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and that we will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons.
verses.textEn: "We promise not to give our daughters in marriage to the peoples around us or take their daughters for our sons.

verses.textZh: 如果这地的外族人带来货物或五谷，在安息日贩卖，我们在安息日或圣日决不向他们买甚么；每逢第七年，我们必不耕种田地，并且豁免一切债务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果这地的外族人带来货物或五谷，在安息日贩卖，我们在安息日或圣日决不向他们买甚么；每逢第七年，我们必不耕种田地，并且豁免一切债务。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地的居民若在安息日，或什么圣日，带了货物或粮食来卖给我们，我们必不买。每逢第七年必不耕种，凡欠我们债的必不追讨。
verses.textEnNiv: "When the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we will forgo working the land and will cancel all debts.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the peoples of the land bring in goods or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on a holy day. And we will forgo the crops of the seventh year and the exaction of every debt.
verses.textEnNkjv: if the peoples of the land brought wares or any grain to sell on the Sabbath day, we would not buy it from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and we would forego the seventh year’s produce and the exacting of every debt.
verses.textEnNlt: "We also promise that if the people of the land should bring any merchandise or grain to be sold on the Sabbath or on any other holy day, we will refuse to buy it. Every seventh year we will let our land rest, and we will cancel all debts owed to us.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the peoples of the land who bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day; and we will forgo the crops of the seventh year and every debt.
verses.textEn: "When the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we will forgo working the land and will cancel all debts.

verses.textZh: 我们又为自己立下法规，各人每年要缴纳四克银子作我们神的殿的经费，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们又为自己立下法规，各人每年要缴纳四克银子作我们神的殿的经费，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们又为自己定例，每年各人捐银一舍客勒三分之一，为我们神殿的使用，
verses.textEnNiv: "We assume the responsibility for carrying out the commands to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of our God:
verses.textEnEsv: "We also take on ourselves the obligation to give yearly a third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:
verses.textEnNkjv: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to exact from ourselves yearly one-third of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:
verses.textEnNlt: "In addition, we promise to obey the command to pay the annual Temple tax of one-eighth of an ounce of silver for the care of the Temple of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: We also imposed on ourselves the obligation to contribute yearly a third of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:
verses.textEn: "We assume the responsibility for carrying out the commands to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of our God:

verses.textZh: 用来做陈设饼，常献的素祭，常献的燔祭，安息日、初一、定时的节期所献的祭；又为了做各样的圣物和为以色列人赎罪的赎罪祭，以及我们神殿里一切工作的费用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用来做陈设饼，常献的素祭，常献的燔祭，安息日、初一、定时的节期所献的祭；又为了做各样的圣物和为以色列人赎罪的赎罪祭，以及我们神殿里一切工作的费用。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是为陈设饼、常献的素祭，和燔祭，安息日、月朔、节期所献的与圣物，并以色列人的赎罪祭，以及我们神殿里一切的费用。
verses.textEnNiv: for the bread set out on the table; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals; for the holy offerings; for sin offerings to make atonement for Israel; and for all the duties of the house of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: for the showbread, the regular grain offering, the regular burnt offering, the Sabbaths, the new moons, the appointed feasts, the holy things, and the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the showbread, for the regular grain offering, for the regular burnt offering of the Sabbaths, the New Moons, and the set feasts; for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and all the work of the house of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: This will provide for the Bread of the Presence; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, the new moon celebrations, and the annual festivals; for the holy offerings; and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel. It will provide for everything necessary for the work of the Temple of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: for the showbread, for the continual grain offering, for the continual burnt offering, the Sabbaths, the new moons, for the appointed times, for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and all the work of the house of our God.
verses.textEn: for the bread set out on the table; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, at the New Moon feasts and at the appointed festivals; for the holy offerings; for sin offerings to make atonement for Israel; and for all the duties of the house of our God.

verses.textZh: 我们 抽签决定按照我们的宗族，每年在指定的时间把木柴奉到我们神的殿，好照着律法上所写的，烧在耶和华我们神的坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们 抽签决定按照我们的宗族，每年在指定的时间把木柴奉到我们神的殿，好照着律法上所写的，烧在耶和华我们神的坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祭司、利未人，和百姓都掣签，看每年是哪一族按定期将献祭的柴奉到我们神的殿里，照着律法上所写的，烧在耶和华－我们神的坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: "We—the priests, the Levites and the people—have cast lots to determine when each of our families is to bring to the house of our God at set times each year a contribution of wood to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, have likewise cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed, year by year, to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: We cast lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for bringing the wood offering into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at the appointed times year by year, to burn on the altar of the Lord our God as itis written in the Law.
verses.textEnNlt: "We have cast sacred lots to determine when—at regular times each year—the families of the priests, Levites, and the common people should bring wood to God’s Temple to be burned on the altar of the Lord our God, as is written in the Law.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise we cast lots for the supply of wood among the priests, the Levites, and the people so that they could bring it to the house of our God, according to our fathers’ households, at set times annually, to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the Law;
verses.textEn: "We—the priests, the Levites and the people—have cast lots to determine when each of our families is to bring to the house of our God at set times each year a contribution of wood to burn on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the Law.

verses.textZh: 又定下每年要把我们田地初熟之物，各样果树上一切初熟的果子，都带到耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又定下每年要把我们田地初熟之物，各样果树上一切初熟的果子，都带到耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 又定每年将我们地上初熟的土产和各样树上初熟的果子都奉到耶和华的殿里。
verses.textEnNiv: "We also assume responsibility for bringing to the house of the Lord each year the firstfruits of our crops and of every fruit tree.
verses.textEnEsv: We obligate ourselves to bring the firstfruits of our ground and the firstfruits of all fruit of every tree, year by year, to the house of the Lord ;
verses.textEnNkjv: And wemadeordinances to bring the firstfruits of our ground and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, to the house of the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: "We promise to bring the first part of every harvest to the Lord ’s Temple year after year—whether it be a crop from the soil or from our fruit trees.
verses.textEnNasb: and so that they could bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all the fruit of every tree to the house of the Lord annually,
verses.textEn: "We also assume responsibility for bringing to the house of the Lord each year the firstfruits of our crops and of every fruit tree.

verses.textZh: 又要照着律法所写的，把我们头胎的儿子和牲畜，就是我们头胎的牛羊，都带到我们神的殿，交给在我们神的殿供职的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要照着律法所写的，把我们头胎的儿子和牲畜，就是我们头胎的牛羊，都带到我们神的殿，交给在我们神的殿供职的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 又照律法上所写的，将我们头胎的儿子和首生的牛羊都奉到我们神的殿，交给我们神殿里供职的祭司；
verses.textEnNiv: "As it is also written in the Law, we will bring the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests ministering there.
verses.textEnEsv: also to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God, the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, as it is written in the Law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks;
verses.textEnNkjv: to bring the firstborn of our sons and our cattle, as itis written in the Law, and the firstborn of our herds and our flocks, to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;
verses.textEnNlt: We agree to give God our oldest sons and the firstborn of all our herds and flocks, as prescribed in the Law. We will present them to the priests who minister in the Temple of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: and bring to the house of our God the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, and the firstborn of our herds and our flocks as it is written in the Law, for the priests who are ministering in the house of our God.
verses.textEn: "As it is also written in the Law, we will bring the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests ministering there.

verses.textZh: 并且把我们最好的面粉和举祭，各样树上的果子、新酒、新油，都带给祭司，交到我们神殿的仓库；又要把我们田地出产的十分之一给利未人，利未人可以在我们所有城镇的耕地收取十分之一的出产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且把我们最好的面粉和举祭，各样树上的果子、新酒、新油，都带给祭司，交到我们神殿的仓库；又要把我们田地出产的十分之一给利未人，利未人可以在我们所有城镇的耕地收取十分之一的出产。
verses.textZhCuv: 并将初熟之麦子所磨的面和举祭、各样树上初熟的果子、新酒与油奉给祭司，收在我们神殿的库房里，把我们地上所产的十分之一奉给利未人，因利未人在我们一切城邑的土产中当取十分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: "Moreover, we will bring to the storerooms of the house of our God, to the priests, the first of our ground meal, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees and of our new wine and olive oil. And we will bring a tithe of our crops to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all the towns where we work.
verses.textEnEsv: and to bring the first of our dough, and our contributions, the fruit of every tree, the wine and the oil, to the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and to bring to the Levites the tithes from our ground, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all our towns where we labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: to bring the firstfruits of our dough, our offerings, the fruit from all kinds of trees, the new wine and oil, to the priests, to the storerooms of the house of our God; and to bring the tithes of our land to the Levites, for the Levites should receive the tithes in all our farming communities.
verses.textEnNlt: We will store the produce in the storerooms of the Temple of our God. We will bring the best of our flour and other grain offerings, the best of our fruit, and the best of our new wine and olive oil. And we promise to bring to the Levites a tenth of everything our land produces, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all our rural towns.
verses.textEnNasb: We will also bring the first of our dough, our contributions, the fruit of every tree, the new wine, and the oil to the priests at the chambers of the house of our God, and the tithe of our ground to the Levites, for the Levites are they who receive the tithes in all the rural towns.
verses.textEn: "Moreover, we will bring to the storerooms of the house of our God, to the priests, the first of our ground meal, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees and of our new wine and olive oil. And we will bring a tithe of our crops to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all the towns where we work.

verses.textZh: 利未人收取十分之一出产的时候，要有一个作祭司的亚伦的子孙与他们在一起；利未人要从这十分之一中，抽取十分之一奉到我们神的殿，交到库房的贮藏室。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人收取十分之一出产的时候，要有一个作祭司的亚伦的子孙与他们在一起；利未人要从这十分之一中，抽取十分之一奉到我们神的殿，交到库房的贮藏室。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人取十分之一的时候，亚伦的子孙中，当有一个祭司与利未人同在。利未人也当从十分之一中取十分之一，奉到我们神殿的屋子里，收在库房中。
verses.textEnNiv: A priest descended from Aaron is to accompany the Levites when they receive the tithes, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of the tithes up to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest, the son of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites receive the tithes. And the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the chambers of the storehouse.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest, the descendant of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites receive tithes; and the Levites shall bring up a tenth of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms of the storehouse.
verses.textEnNlt: "A priest—a descendant of Aaron—will be with the Levites as they receive these tithes. And a tenth of all that is collected as tithes will be delivered by the Levites to the Temple of our God and placed in the storerooms.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest, the son of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites receive tithes, and the Levites shall bring up the tenth of the tithes to the house of our God, to the chambers of the storehouse.
verses.textEn: A priest descended from Aaron is to accompany the Levites when they receive the tithes, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of the tithes up to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.

verses.textZh: 以色列人和利未人要把五谷、新酒、新油作举祭，带到贮存圣所器皿的贮藏室，就是供职的祭司、守门的和歌唱的居住的地方。我们决不会疏忽供应我们神的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人和利未人要把五谷、新酒、新油作举祭，带到贮存圣所器皿的贮藏室，就是供职的祭司、守门的和歌唱的居住的地方。我们决不会疏忽供应我们神的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人和利未人要将五谷、新酒，和油为举祭，奉到收存圣所器皿的屋子里，就是供职的祭司、守门的、歌唱的所住的屋子。这样，我们就不离弃我们神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Israel, including the Levites, are to bring their contributions of grain, new wine and olive oil to the storerooms, where the articles for the sanctuary and for the ministering priests, the gatekeepers and the musicians are also kept. "We will not neglect the house of our God."
verses.textEnEsv: For the people of Israel and the sons of Levi shall bring the contribution of grain, wine, and oil to the chambers, where the vessels of the sanctuary are, as well as the priests who minister, and the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not neglect the house of our God."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the grain, of the new wine and the oil, to the storerooms where the articles of the sanctuary are, where the priests who minister and the gatekeepers and the singers are; and we will not neglect the house of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: The people and the Levites must bring these offerings of grain, new wine, and olive oil to the storerooms and place them in the sacred containers near the ministering priests, the gatekeepers, and the singers. "We promise together not to neglect the Temple of our God."
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi shall bring the contribution of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the chambers; the utensils of the sanctuary, the priests who are ministering, the gatekeepers, and the singers are there. So we will not neglect the house of our God.
verses.textEn: The people of Israel, including the Levites, are to bring their contributions of grain, new wine and olive oil to the storerooms, where the articles for the sanctuary and for the ministering priests, the gatekeepers and the musicians are also kept. "We will not neglect the house of our God."

verses.textZh: 那时，民众的领袖住在耶路撒冷；其余的民众都抽签，抽出十分之一，住在圣城耶路撒冷，余下的十分之九就住在别的城镇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，民众的领袖住在耶路撒冷；其余的民众都抽签，抽出十分之一，住在圣城耶路撒冷，余下的十分之九就住在别的城镇。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓的首领住在耶路撒冷。其余的百姓掣签，每十人中使一人来住在圣城耶路撒冷，那九人住在别的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten of them to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the remaining nine were to stay in their own towns.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the leaders of the people lived in Jerusalem. And the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in Jerusalem the holy city, while nine out of ten remained in the other towns.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the leaders of the people dwelt at Jerusalem; the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine-tenths weretodwell in other cities.
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of the people were living in Jerusalem, the holy city. A tenth of the people from the other towns of Judah and Benjamin were chosen by sacred lots to live there, too, while the rest stayed where they were.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the leaders of the people lived in Jerusalem, but the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while nine-tenths remained in the other cities.
verses.textEn: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten of them to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the remaining nine were to stay in their own towns.

verses.textZh: 众人为所有自愿住在耶路撒冷的人祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人为所有自愿住在耶路撒冷的人祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡甘心乐意住在耶路撒冷的，百姓都为他们祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: The people commended all who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered to live in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: And the people commended everyone who volunteered to resettle in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The people commended all who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 以色列人、祭司、利未人、作殿役的和所罗门仆人的子孙，各住在犹大众城自己的地业中；犹大省的首领住在耶路撒冷的，有以下这些人：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人、祭司、利未人、作殿役的和所罗门仆人的子孙，各住在犹大众城自己的地业中；犹大省的首领住在耶路撒冷的，有以下这些人：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提宁，和所罗门仆人的后裔都住在犹大城邑，各在自己的地业中。本省的首领住在耶路撒冷的记在下面：
verses.textEnNiv: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem (now some Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants and descendants of Solomon’s servants lived in the towns of Judah, each on their own property in the various towns,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the towns of Judah everyone lived on his property in their towns: Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the descendants of Solomon’s servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the heads of the province who dwelt in Jerusalem. (But in the cities of Judah everyone dwelt in his own possession in their cities—Israelites, priests, Levites, Nethinim, and descendants of Solomon’s servants.)
verses.textEnNlt: Here is a list of the names of the provincial officials who came to live in Jerusalem. (Most of the people, priests, Levites, Temple servants, and descendants of Solomon’s servants continued to live in their own homes in the various towns of Judah,
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the heads of the provinces who lived in Jerusalem, but in the cities of Judah each lived on his own property in their cities—the Israelites, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the descendants of Solomon’s servants.
verses.textEn: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem (now some Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants and descendants of Solomon’s servants lived in the towns of Judah, each on their own property in the various towns,

verses.textZh: 有些犹大的子孙和便雅悯的子孙，住在耶路撒冷。犹大的子孙有：法勒斯的子孙乌西雅的儿子亚他雅；乌西雅是撒迦利雅的儿子，撒迦利雅是亚玛利雅的儿子，亚玛利雅是示法提雅的儿子，示法提雅是玛勒列的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些犹大的子孙和便雅悯的子孙，住在耶路撒冷。犹大的子孙有：法勒斯的子孙乌西雅的儿子亚他雅；乌西雅是撒迦利雅的儿子，撒迦利雅是亚玛利雅的儿子，亚玛利雅是示法提雅的儿子，示法提雅是玛勒列的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有些犹大人和便雅悯人。犹大人中有法勒斯的子孙、乌西雅的儿子亚他雅。乌西雅是撒迦利雅的儿子；撒迦利雅是亚玛利雅的儿子；亚玛利雅是示法提雅的儿子；示法提雅是玛勒列的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: while other people from both Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem): From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;
verses.textEnEsv: And in Jerusalem lived certain of the sons of Judah and of the sons of Benjamin. Of the sons of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, of the sons of Perez;
verses.textEnNkjv: Also in Jerusalem dwelt some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin. The children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
verses.textEnNlt: but some of the people from Judah and Benjamin resettled in Jerusalem.) From the tribe of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, of the family of Perez.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the sons of Judah and some of the sons of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. From the sons of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the sons of Perez;
verses.textEn: while other people from both Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem): From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;

verses.textZh: 又有巴录的儿子玛西雅；巴录是谷何西的儿子，谷何西是哈赛雅的儿子，哈赛雅是亚大雅的儿子，亚大雅是约雅立的儿子，约雅立是撒迦利雅的儿子，撒迦利雅是示罗尼的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有巴录的儿子玛西雅；巴录是谷何西的儿子，谷何西是哈赛雅的儿子，哈赛雅是亚大雅的儿子，亚大雅是约雅立的儿子，约雅立是撒迦利雅的儿子，撒迦利雅是示罗尼的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有巴录的儿子玛西雅。巴录是谷何西的儿子；谷何西是哈赛雅的儿子；哈赛雅是亚大雅的儿子；亚大雅是约雅立的儿子；约雅立是撒迦利雅的儿子；撒迦利雅是示罗尼的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Kol-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.
verses.textEnEsv: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, son of Col-hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, son of the Shilonite.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.textEnNlt: Also Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, of the family of Shelah.
verses.textEnNasb: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
verses.textEn: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Kol-Hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.

verses.textZh: 所有住在耶路撒冷的法勒斯子孙，共四百六十八人，他们都是勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有住在耶路撒冷的法勒斯子孙，共四百六十八人，他们都是勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在耶路撒冷、法勒斯的子孙共四百六十八名，都是勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of standing.
verses.textEnEsv: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were 468 valiant men.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the sons of Perez who dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred and sixty-eight valiant men.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 468 descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem—all outstanding men.
verses.textEnNasb: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were 468 able men.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled 468 men of standing.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯的子孙有：米书兰的儿子撒路；米书兰是约叶的儿子，约叶是毘大雅的儿子，毘大雅是哥赖雅的儿子，哥赖雅是玛西雅的儿子，玛西雅是以铁的儿子，以铁是耶筛亚的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯的子孙有：米书兰的儿子撒路；米书兰是约叶的儿子，约叶是毘大雅的儿子，毘大雅是哥赖雅的儿子，哥赖雅是玛西雅的儿子，玛西雅是以铁的儿子，以铁是耶筛亚的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人中有米书兰的儿子撒路。米书兰是约叶的儿子；约叶是毗大雅的儿子；毗大雅是哥赖雅的儿子；哥赖雅是玛西雅的儿子；玛西雅是以铁的儿子；以铁是耶筛亚的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah;
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah;
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,

verses.textZh: 他的众兄弟都是勇士 ，共九百二十八人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的众兄弟都是勇士 ，共九百二十八人。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次有迦拜、撒来的子孙，共九百二十八名。
verses.textEnNiv: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai—928 men.
verses.textEnEsv: and his brothers, men of valor, 928.
verses.textEnNkjv: and after him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.
verses.textEnNlt: After him were Gabbai and Sallai and a total of 928 relatives.
verses.textEnNasb: and after him Gabbai and Sallai, 928.
verses.textEn: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai—928 men.

verses.textZh: 细基利的儿子约珥是管理他们的官长；哈西努亚的儿子犹大是那城的副市长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 细基利的儿子约珥是管理他们的官长；哈西努亚的儿子犹大是那城的副市长。
verses.textZhCuv: 细基利的儿子约珥是他们的长官。哈西努亚的儿子犹大是耶路撒冷的副官。
verses.textEnNiv: Joel son of Zikri was their chief officer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the New Quarter of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Their chief officer was Joel son of Zicri, who was assisted by Judah son of Hassenuah, second-in-command over the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second in command of the city.
verses.textEn: Joel son of Zikri was their chief officer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the New Quarter of the city.

verses.textZh: 祭司有：约雅立的儿子耶大雅，又有雅斤，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司有：约雅立的儿子耶大雅，又有雅斤，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司中有雅斤，又有约雅立的儿子耶大雅；
verses.textEnNiv: From the priests: Jedaiah; the son of Joiarib; Jakin;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, and Jachin;
verses.textEnNlt: From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib; Jakin;
verses.textEnNasb: From the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
verses.textEn: From the priests: Jedaiah; the son of Joiarib; Jakin;

verses.textZh: 以及神殿的总管西莱雅；西莱雅是希勒家的儿子，希勒家是米书兰的儿子，米书兰是撒督的儿子，撒督是米拉约的儿子，米拉约是亚希突的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及神殿的总管西莱雅；西莱雅是希勒家的儿子，希勒家是米书兰的儿子，米书兰是撒督的儿子，撒督是米拉约的儿子，米拉约是亚希突的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 还有管理神殿的西莱雅。西莱雅是希勒家的儿子；希勒家是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是撒督的儿子；撒督是米拉约的儿子；米拉约是亚希突的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God,
verses.textEnEsv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, ruler of the house of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the leader of the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: and Seraiah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the supervisor of the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the overseer of the house of God,
verses.textEn: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God,

verses.textZh: 还有他们的亲族，在殿里工作事奉的，共八百二十二人；又有耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅；耶罗罕是毘拉利的儿子，毘拉利是暗洗的儿子，暗洗是撒迦利亚的儿子，撒迦利亚是巴施户珥的儿子，巴施户珥是玛基雅的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有他们的亲族，在殿里工作事奉的，共八百二十二人；又有耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅；耶罗罕是毘拉利的儿子，毘拉利是暗洗的儿子，暗洗是撒迦利亚的儿子，撒迦利亚是巴施户珥的儿子，巴施户珥是玛基雅的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 还有他们的弟兄在殿里供职的，共八百二十二名；又有耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅。耶罗罕是毗拉利的儿子；毗拉利是暗洗的儿子；暗洗是撒迦利亚的儿子；撒迦利亚是巴施户珥的儿子；巴施户珥是玛基雅的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: and their associates, who carried on work for the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,
verses.textEnEsv: and their brothers who did the work of the house, 822; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their brethren who did the work of the house were eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.textEnNlt: Also 822 of their associates, who worked at the Temple. Also Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malkijah,
verses.textEnNasb: and their kinsmen who did the work of the temple, 822; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.textEn: and their associates, who carried on work for the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,

verses.textZh: 还有他的亲族作族长的共二百四十二人；又有亚萨列的儿子亚玛帅；亚萨列是亚哈赛的儿子，亚哈赛是米实利末的儿子，米实利末是音麦的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有他的亲族作族长的共二百四十二人；又有亚萨列的儿子亚玛帅；亚萨列是亚哈赛的儿子，亚哈赛是米实利末的儿子，米实利末是音麦的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 还有他的弟兄作族长的，二百四十二名；又有亚萨列的儿子亚玛帅。亚萨列是亚哈赛的儿子；亚哈赛是米实利末的儿子；米实利末是音麦的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: and his associates, who were heads of families—242 men; Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.textEnEsv: and his brothers, heads of fathers’ houses, 242; and Amashsai, the son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,
verses.textEnNkjv: and his brethren, heads of the fathers’ houses, were two hundred and forty-two; and Amashai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.textEnNlt: along with 242 of his associates, who were heads of their families. Also Amashsai son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,
verses.textEnNasb: and his kinsmen, heads of fathers’ households, 242; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.textEn: and his associates, who were heads of families—242 men; Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.textZh: 又有他们的亲族，英勇的战士共一百二十八人；哈基多琳的儿子撒巴第业是管理他们的官长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有他们的亲族，英勇的战士共一百二十八人；哈基多琳的儿子撒巴第业是管理他们的官长。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有他们弟兄、大能的勇士共一百二十八名。哈基多琳的儿子撒巴第业是他们的长官。
verses.textEnNiv: and his associates, who were men of standing—128. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
verses.textEnEsv: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, 128; their overseer was Zabdiel the son of Haggedolim.
verses.textEnNkjv: and their brethren, mighty men of valor, were one hundred and twenty-eight. Their overseer was Zabdiel the son of oneof the great men.
verses.textEnNlt: and 128 of his outstanding associates. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
verses.textEnNasb: and their brothers, valiant warriors, 128. And their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
verses.textEn: and his associates, who were men of standing—128. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.

verses.textZh: 利未人有：哈述的儿子示玛雅；哈述是押利甘的儿子，押利甘是哈沙比雅的儿子，哈沙比雅是布尼的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人有：哈述的儿子示玛雅；哈述是押利甘的儿子，押利甘是哈沙比雅的儿子，哈沙比雅是布尼的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人中有哈述的儿子示玛雅。哈述是押利甘的儿子；押利甘是哈沙比雅的儿子；哈沙比雅是布尼的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.textEnEsv: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni;
verses.textEnNkjv: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.textEnNlt: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni.
verses.textEnNasb: Now from the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.textEn: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

verses.textZh: 又有利未人的族长沙比太和约撒拔，管理神殿的外务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有利未人的族长沙比太和约撒拔，管理神殿的外务。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有利未人的族长沙比太和约撒拔管理神殿的外事。
verses.textEnNiv: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who had charge of the outside work of the house of God;
verses.textEnEsv: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who were over the outside work of the house of God;
verses.textEnNkjv: Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the heads of the Levites, had the oversight of the business outside of the house of God;
verses.textEnNlt: Also Shabbethai and Jozabad, who were in charge of the work outside the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, from the leaders of the Levites, who were in charge of the outside work of the house of God;
verses.textEn: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who had charge of the outside work of the house of God;

verses.textZh: 米迦的儿子玛他尼，领导赞美，献上感谢的祷告；米迦是撒底的儿子，撒底是亚萨的儿子；八布迦在他的兄弟中作副手；还有沙母亚的儿子押大，沙母亚是加拉的儿子，加拉是耶杜顿的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦的儿子玛他尼，领导赞美，献上感谢的祷告；米迦是撒底的儿子，撒底是亚萨的儿子；八布迦在他的兄弟中作副手；还有沙母亚的儿子押大，沙母亚是加拉的儿子，加拉是耶杜顿的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 祈祷的时候，为称谢领首的是米迦的儿子玛他尼。米迦是撒底的儿子；撒底是亚萨的儿子；又有玛他尼弟兄中的八布迦为副。还有沙母亚的儿子押大。沙母亚是加拉的儿子；加拉是耶杜顿的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the director who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.textEnEsv: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, son of Zabdi, son of Asaph, who was the leader of the praise, who gave thanks, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the leader who began the thanksgiving with prayer; Bakbukiah, the second among his brethren; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.textEnNlt: Also Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zabdi, a descendant of Asaph, who led in thanksgiving and prayer. Also Bakbukiah, who was Mattaniah’s assistant, and Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.
verses.textEnNasb: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the leader in beginning the thanksgiving at prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his kinsmen; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.textEn: Mattaniah son of Mika, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, the director who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.textZh: 所有在圣城的利未人，共二百八十四人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有在圣城的利未人，共二百八十四人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在圣城的利未人共二百八十四名。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.
verses.textEnEsv: All the Levites in the holy city were 284.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred and eighty-four.
verses.textEnNlt: In all, there were 284 Levites in the holy city.
verses.textEnNasb: All the Levites in the holy city were 284.
verses.textEn: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.

verses.textZh: 守门的有：亚谷和达们，以及他们的亲族，看守各门，共一百七十二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守门的有：亚谷和达们，以及他们的亲族，看守各门，共一百七十二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 守门的是亚谷和达们，并守门的弟兄，共一百七十二名。
verses.textEnNiv: The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.
verses.textEnEsv: The gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were 172.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren who kept the gates, were one hundred and seventy-two.
verses.textEnNlt: From the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and 172 of their associates, who guarded the gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their kinsmen who kept watch at the gates, were 172.
verses.textEn: The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men.

verses.textZh: 其余的以色列人、祭司、利未人各住在犹大众城自己的地业中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的以色列人、祭司、利未人各住在犹大众城自己的地业中。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的以色列人、祭司、利未人都住在犹大的一切城邑，各在自己的地业中。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, each on their ancestral property.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of Israel, and of the priests and the Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of Israel, of the priests and Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: The other priests, Levites, and the rest of the Israelites lived wherever their family inheritance was located in any of the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The rest of Israel, of the priests and of the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, each on his own inheritance.
verses.textEn: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, each on their ancestral property.

verses.textZh: 作殿役的住在俄斐勒；西哈和基斯帕管理作殿役的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作殿役的住在俄斐勒；西哈和基斯帕管理作殿役的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼提宁却住在俄斐勒；西哈和基斯帕管理他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.
verses.textEnEsv: But the temple servants lived on Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel. And Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Temple servants, however, whose leaders were Ziha and Gishpa, all lived on the hill of Ophel.
verses.textEnNasb: But the temple servants were living in Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of the temple servants.
verses.textEn: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷管理利未人的，是巴尼的儿子乌西，巴尼是哈沙比雅的儿子，哈沙比雅是玛他尼的儿子，玛他尼是米迦的儿子，他是亚萨的子孙，就是那些管理神殿事务的歌唱者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷管理利未人的，是巴尼的儿子乌西，巴尼是哈沙比雅的儿子，哈沙比雅是玛他尼的儿子，玛他尼是米迦的儿子，他是亚萨的子孙，就是那些管理神殿事务的歌唱者。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷、利未人的长官，管理神殿事务的是歌唱者亚萨的子孙、巴尼的儿子乌西。巴尼是哈沙比雅的儿子；哈沙比雅是玛他尼的儿子；玛他尼是米迦的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mika. Uzzi was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the musicians responsible for the service of the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the work of the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha, of the sons of Asaph, the singers in charge of the service of the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica, a descendant of Asaph, whose family served as singers at God’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, from the sons of Asaph, who were the singers for the service of the house of God.
verses.textEn: The chief officer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mika. Uzzi was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the musicians responsible for the service of the house of God.

verses.textZh: 王命令他们，规定歌唱者每天当尽的责任。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王命令他们，规定歌唱者每天当尽的责任。
verses.textZhCuv: 王为歌唱的出命令，每日供给他们必有一定之粮。
verses.textEnNiv: The musicians were under the king’s orders, which regulated their daily activity.
verses.textEnEsv: For there was a command from the king concerning them, and a fixed provision for the singers, as every day required.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itwas the king’s command concerning them that a certain portion should be for the singers, a quota day by day.
verses.textEnNlt: Their daily responsibilities were carried out according to the terms of a royal command.
verses.textEnNasb: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them and a royal command for the singers day by day.
verses.textEn: The musicians were under the king’s orders, which regulated their daily activity.

verses.textZh: 犹大的儿子谢拉的子孙中，米示萨别的儿子毘他希雅是王的助手，统管一切民事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的儿子谢拉的子孙中，米示萨别的儿子毘他希雅是王的助手，统管一切民事。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大儿子谢拉的子孙、米示萨别的儿子毗他希雅辅助王办理犹大民的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in all affairs relating to the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the sons of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s side in all matters concerning the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was the king’s deputy in all matters concerning the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, a descendant of Zerah son of Judah, was the royal adviser in all matters of public administration.
verses.textEnNasb: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the sons of Zerah the son of Judah, was the king’s representative for every matter concerning the people.
verses.textEn: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in all affairs relating to the people.

verses.textZh: 至于村庄和所属的田地，有些犹大人住在基列．亚巴和属于基列．亚巴的乡村，有些住在底本和属于底本的乡村，有些住在叶甲薛和属于叶甲薛的村庄，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于村庄和所属的田地，有些犹大人住在基列．亚巴和属于基列．亚巴的乡村，有些住在底本和属于底本的乡村，有些住在叶甲薛和属于叶甲薛的村庄，
verses.textZhCuv: 至于村庄和属村庄的田地，有犹大人住在基列‧亚巴和属基列‧亚巴的乡村；底本和属底本的乡村；叶甲薛和属叶甲薛的村庄；
verses.textEnNiv: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its surrounding settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the villages, with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba and its villages, and in Dibon and its villages, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt in Kirjath Arba and its villages, Dibon and its villages, Jekabzeel and its villages;
verses.textEnNlt: As for the surrounding villages with their open fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba with its settlements, Dibon with its settlements, and Jekabzeel with its villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the villages with their fields, some of the sons of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,
verses.textEn: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its surrounding settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

verses.textZh: 利未人有耶书亚、宾内、甲篾、示利比、犹大、玛他尼和他的兄弟们，负责颂赞的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人有耶书亚、宾内、甲篾、示利比、犹大、玛他尼和他的兄弟们，负责颂赞的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人是耶书亚、宾内、甲篾、示利比、犹大、玛他尼。这玛他尼和他的弟兄管理称谢的事。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who, together with his associates, was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who with his brothers was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah wholed the thanksgiving psalms, he and his brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites who returned with them were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who with his associates was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah who was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving, he and his brothers.
verses.textEn: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who, together with his associates, was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.

verses.textZh: 他们的兄弟八布迦和乌尼按着班次，与他们相对站立。

verses.textZhCuv: 他们的弟兄八布迦和乌尼照自己的班次与他们相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood opposite them in the services.

verses.textEnNkjv: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, stood across from them in their duties.
verses.textEnNlt: Their associates, Bakbukiah and Unni, stood opposite them during the service.
verses.textEnNasb: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brothers, stood opposite them in their service divisions.
verses.textEn: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood opposite them in the services.

verses.textEn: Joiada the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan the father of Jaddua.

verses.textZh: 在约雅金的日子，祭司作族长的，属西莱雅族的，有米拉雅；属耶利米族的，有哈拿尼雅；
