verses.textZhCuv: 哈琳族有押拿；米拉约族有希勒恺；
verses.textEnNiv: of Harim’s, Adna; of Meremoth’s, Helkai;
verses.textEnEsv: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.textEnNlt: Adna was leader of the family of Harim. Helkai was leader of the family of Meremoth.
verses.textEnNasb: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.textEn: of Harim’s, Adna; of Meremoth’s, Helkai;

verses.textZh: 属易多族的，有撒迦利亚；属近顿族的，有米书兰；
verses.textZhCnvs: 属易多族的，有撒迦利亚；属近顿族的，有米书兰；
verses.textZhCuv: 易多族有撒迦利亚；近顿族有米书兰；
verses.textEnNiv: of Iddo’s, Zechariah; of Ginnethon’s, Meshullam;
verses.textEnEsv: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah was leader of the family of Iddo. Meshullam was leader of the family of Ginnethon.
verses.textEnNasb: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.textEn: of Iddo’s, Zechariah; of Ginnethon’s, Meshullam;

verses.textZh: 属亚比雅族的，有细基利；属米拿民族的，有某一位；属摩亚底族的，有毘勒太；
verses.textZhCnvs: 属亚比雅族的，有细基利；属米拿民族的，有某一位；属摩亚底族的，有毘勒太；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比雅族有细基利；米拿民族某；摩亚底族有毗勒太；
verses.textEnNiv: of Abijah’s, Zikri; of Miniamin’s and of Moadiah’s, Piltai;
verses.textEnEsv: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Abijah, Zichri; theson of Minjamin; of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.textEnNlt: Zicri was leader of the family of Abijah. There was also a leader of the family of Miniamin. Piltai was leader of the family of Moadiah.
verses.textEnNasb: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.textEn: of Abijah’s, Zikri; of Miniamin’s and of Moadiah’s, Piltai;

verses.textZh: 属璧迦族的，有沙母亚；属示玛雅族的，有约拿单；
verses.textZhCnvs: 属璧迦族的，有沙母亚；属示玛雅族的，有约拿单；
verses.textZhCuv: 璧迦族有沙母亚；示玛雅族有约拿单；
verses.textEnNiv: of Bilgah’s, Shammua; of Shemaiah’s, Jehonathan;
verses.textEnEsv: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.textEnNlt: Shammua was leader of the family of Bilgah. Jehonathan was leader of the family of Shemaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.textEn: of Bilgah’s, Shammua; of Shemaiah’s, Jehonathan;

verses.textZh: 属约雅立族的，有玛特乃；属耶大雅族的，有乌西；
verses.textZhCnvs: 属约雅立族的，有玛特乃；属耶大雅族的，有乌西；
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅立族有玛特乃；耶大雅族有乌西；
verses.textEnNiv: of Joiarib’s, Mattenai; of Jedaiah’s, Uzzi;
verses.textEnEsv: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.textEnNlt: Mattenai was leader of the family of Joiarib. Uzzi was leader of the family of Jedaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.textEn: of Joiarib’s, Mattenai; of Jedaiah’s, Uzzi;

verses.textZh: 属撒来族的，有加莱；属亚木族的，有希伯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 属撒来族的，有加莱；属亚木族的，有希伯；
verses.textZhCuv: 撒来族有加莱；亚木族有希伯；
verses.textEnNiv: of Sallu’s, Kallai; of Amok’s, Eber;
verses.textEnEsv: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.textEnNlt: Kallai was leader of the family of Sallu. Eber was leader of the family of Amok.
verses.textEnNasb: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.textEn: of Sallu’s, Kallai; of Amok’s, Eber;

verses.textZh: 属希勒家族的，有哈沙比雅；属耶大雅族的，有拿坦业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属希勒家族的，有哈沙比雅；属耶大雅族的，有拿坦业。
verses.textZhCuv: 希勒家族有哈沙比雅；耶大雅族有拿坦业。
verses.textEnNiv: of Hilkiah’s, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah’s, Nethanel.
verses.textEnEsv: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; and of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
verses.textEnNlt: Hashabiah was leader of the family of Hilkiah. Nethanel was leader of the family of Jedaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; and of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
verses.textEn: of Hilkiah’s, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah’s, Nethanel.

verses.textZh: 在以利亚实、耶何耶大、约哈难和押杜亚的日子，利未人的族长都登记了，同样，波斯王大利乌在位时的祭司也都登记了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以利亚实、耶何耶大、约哈难和押杜亚的日子，利未人的族长都登记了，同样，波斯王大利乌在位时的祭司也都登记了。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于利未人，当以利亚实、耶何耶大、约哈难、押杜亚的时候，他们的族长记在册上。波斯王大流士在位的时候，作族长的祭司也记在册上。
verses.textEnNiv: The family heads of the Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, as well as those of the priests, were recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.textEnEsv: In the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, the Levites were recorded as heads of fathers’ houses; so too were the priests in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.textEnNkjv: During the reign of Darius the Persian, a record wasalsokept of the Levites and priests whohadbeen heads of their fathers’ houses in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua.
verses.textEnNlt: A record of the Levite families was kept during the years when Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua served as high priest. Another record of the priests was kept during the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the Levites, the heads of fathers’ households were registered in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua; so were the priests in the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.textEn: The family heads of the Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, as well as those of the priests, were recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.textZh: 作族长的利未人登记在编年录上，直到以利亚实的孙子约哈难的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作族长的利未人登记在编年录上，直到以利亚实的孙子约哈难的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人作族长的记在历史上，直到以利亚实的儿子约哈难的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: The family heads among the descendants of Levi up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the book of the annals.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the sons of Levi, their heads of fathers’ houses were written in the Book of the Chronicles until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Levi, the heads of the fathers’ houses until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib, were written in the book of the chronicles.
verses.textEnNlt: A record of the heads of the Levite families was kept in The Book of History down to the days of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Levi, the heads of fathers’ households, were registered in the Book of the Chronicles up to the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.textEn: The family heads among the descendants of Levi up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the book of the annals.

verses.textZh: 利未人的族长是哈沙比雅、示利比、甲篾的儿子耶书亚与他们的兄弟相对站立，照着神人大卫的命令，按着班次赞美称颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人的族长是哈沙比雅、示利比、甲篾的儿子耶书亚与他们的兄弟相对站立，照着神人大卫的命令，按着班次赞美称颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人的族长是哈沙比雅、示利比、甲篾的儿子耶书亚，与他们弟兄的班次相对，照着神人大卫的命令一班一班地赞美称谢。
verses.textEnNiv: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their associates, who stood opposite them to give praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers who stood opposite them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, watch by watch.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the heads of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers across from them, to praise and give thanks, group alternating with group, according to the command of David the man of God.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the family leaders of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, and other associates, who stood opposite them during the ceremonies of praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as commanded by David, the man of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And the heads of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers opposite them, to praise and give thanks, as prescribed by David the man of God, division corresponding to division.
verses.textEn: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their associates, who stood opposite them to give praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.

verses.textZh: 玛他尼、八布迦、俄巴底亚、米书兰、达们和亚谷都是守门的，守卫城门的库房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛他尼、八布迦、俄巴底亚、米书兰、达们和亚谷都是守门的，守卫城门的库房。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛他尼、八布迦、俄巴底亚、米书兰、达们、亚谷是守门的，就是在库房那里守门。
verses.textEnNiv: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.
verses.textEnEsv: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers standing guard at the storehouses of the gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storerooms of the gates.
verses.textEnNlt: This included Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, and Obadiah. Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were the gatekeepers in charge of the storerooms at the gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping watch at the storerooms of the gates.
verses.textEn: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.

verses.textZh: 这些人是在约撒达的孙子、耶书亚的儿子约雅金的日子，以及在省长尼希米和祭司兼经学家以斯拉的日子任职。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人是在约撒达的孙子、耶书亚的儿子约雅金的日子，以及在省长尼希米和祭司兼经学家以斯拉的日子任职。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是在约撒达的孙子、耶书亚的儿子约雅金和省长尼希米，并祭司文士以斯拉的时候，有职任的。
verses.textEnNiv: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Joshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra, the priest and scribe.
verses.textEnNkjv: These lived in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
verses.textEnNlt: These all served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, son of Jehozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest and scribe.
verses.textEnNasb: These men served in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe.
verses.textEn: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Joshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷城墙举行奉献典礼的时候，众民在各地寻找利未人，带他们到耶路撒冷来，要他们称谢、歌唱、敲钹、弹琴鼓瑟，欢欢喜喜地举行奉献典礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷城墙举行奉献典礼的时候，众民在各地寻找利未人，带他们到耶路撒冷来，要他们称谢、歌唱、敲钹、弹琴鼓瑟，欢欢喜喜地举行奉献典礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷城墙告成的时候，众民就把各处的利未人招到耶路撒冷，要称谢、歌唱、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，欢欢喜喜地行告成之礼。
verses.textEnNiv: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from where they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate joyfully the dedication with songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps and lyres.
verses.textEnEsv: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites in all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication with gladness, with thanksgivings and with singing, with cymbals, harps, and lyres.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought out the Levites in all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings and singing, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps.
verses.textEnNlt: For the dedication of the new wall of Jerusalem, the Levites throughout the land were asked to come to Jerusalem to assist in the ceremonies. They were to take part in the joyous occasion with their songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps, and lyres.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought out the Levites from all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem so that they could celebrate the dedication with joy, with songs of thanksgiving and with songs to the accompaniment of cymbals, harps, and lyres.
verses.textEn: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from where they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate joyfully the dedication with songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps and lyres.

verses.textZh: 歌唱者从耶路撒冷四围的平原，从尼陀法的村庄，
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌唱者从耶路撒冷四围的平原，从尼陀法的村庄，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司和利未人就洁净自己，也洁净百姓和城门，并城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The musicians also were brought together from the region around Jerusalem—from the villages of the Netophathites,
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of the singers gathered together from the district surrounding Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of the singers gathered together from the countryside around Jerusalem, from the villages of the Netophathites,
verses.textEnNlt: The singers were brought together from the region around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of the singers were assembled from the territory around Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathites,
verses.textEn: The musicians also were brought together from the region around Jerusalem—from the villages of the Netophathites,

verses.textZh: 从伯．吉甲，从迦巴和押玛弗的田庄聚集前来；因为歌唱者在耶路撒冷四围为自己建造村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从伯．吉甲，从迦巴和押玛弗的田庄聚集前来；因为歌唱者在耶路撒冷四围为自己建造村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 我带犹大的首领上城，使称谢的人分为两大队，排列而行：第一队在城上往右边向粪厂门行走，
verses.textEnNiv: from Beth Gilgal, and from the area of Geba and Azmaveth, for the musicians had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: also from Beth-gilgal and from the region of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built for themselves villages around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: from the house of Gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth; for the singers had built themselves villages all around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: They also came from Beth-gilgal and the rural areas near Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built their own settlements around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: from Beth-gilgal and from their fields in Geba and Azmaveth, because the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: from Beth Gilgal, and from the area of Geba and Azmaveth, for the musicians had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 祭司和利未人洁净了自己，然后洁净民众，以及城门和城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司和利未人洁净了自己，然后洁净民众，以及城门和城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们后头的有何沙雅与犹大首领的一半，
verses.textEnNiv: When the priests and Levites had purified themselves ceremonially, they purified the people, the gates and the wall.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and they purified the people and the gates and the wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priests and Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests and Levites first purified themselves; then they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; they also purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
verses.textEn: When the priests and Levites had purified themselves ceremonially, they purified the people, the gates and the wall.

verses.textZh: 我带领犹大的领袖上了城墙，组织了两大队颂赞的人，一队在城墙右边，向着粪门前进，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我带领犹大的领袖上了城墙，组织了两大队颂赞的人，一队在城墙右边，向着粪门前进，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有亚撒利雅、以斯拉、米书兰、
verses.textEnNiv: I had the leaders of Judah go up on top of the wall. I also assigned two large choirs to give thanks. One was to proceed on top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up onto the wall and appointed two great choirs that gave thanks. One went to the south on the wall to the Dung Gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I brought the leaders of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two large thanksgiving choirs. One went to the right hand on the wall toward the Refuse Gate.
verses.textEnNlt: I led the leaders of Judah to the top of the wall and organized two large choirs to give thanks. One of the choirs proceeded southward along the top of the wall to the Dung Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I had the leaders of Judah come up on top of the wall, and I appointed two large choirs, the first proceeding to the right on top of the wall toward the Dung Gate.
verses.textEn: I had the leaders of Judah go up on top of the wall. I also assigned two large choirs to give thanks. One was to proceed on top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.

verses.textZh: 跟随他们后面的是何沙雅和犹大的一半领袖；
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟随他们后面的是何沙雅和犹大的一半领袖；
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大、便雅悯、示玛雅、耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed them,
verses.textEnEsv: And after them went Hoshaiah and half of the leaders of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: After them went Hoshaiah and half of the leaders of Judah,
verses.textEnNlt: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed them,
verses.textEnNasb: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders of Judah followed them,
verses.textEn: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed them,

verses.textZh: 还有亚撒利雅、以斯拉、米书兰、
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有亚撒利雅、以斯拉、米书兰、
verses.textZhCuv: 还有些吹号之祭司的子孙，约拿单的儿子撒迦利亚。约拿单是示玛雅的儿子；示玛雅是玛他尼的儿子；玛他尼是米该亚的儿子；米该亚是撒刻的儿子；撒刻是亚萨的儿子；
verses.textEnNiv: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
verses.textEnEsv: and Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
verses.textEnNkjv: and Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
verses.textEnNlt: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
verses.textEnNasb: with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
verses.textEn: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,

verses.textZh: 犹大、便雅悯、示玛雅、耶利米；
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大、便雅悯、示玛雅、耶利米；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有撒迦利亚的弟兄示玛雅、亚撒利、米拉莱、基拉莱、玛艾、拿坦业、犹大、哈拿尼，都拿着神人大卫的乐器，文士以斯拉引领他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
verses.textEnEsv: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
verses.textEnNlt: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
verses.textEn: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

verses.textZh: 还有拿着号筒的祭司：约拿单的儿子撒迦利亚；约拿单是示玛雅的儿子，示玛雅是玛他尼的儿子，玛他尼是米该亚的儿子，米该亚是撒刻的儿子，撒刻是亚萨的儿子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有拿着号筒的祭司：约拿单的儿子撒迦利亚；约拿单是示玛雅的儿子，示玛雅是玛他尼的儿子，玛他尼是米该亚的儿子，米该亚是撒刻的儿子，撒刻是亚萨的儿子；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们经过泉门往前，从大卫城的台阶随地势而上，在大卫宫殿以上，直行到朝东的水门。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zakkur, the son of Asaph,
verses.textEnEsv: and certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, son of Shemaiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Micaiah, son of Zaccur, son of Asaph;
verses.textEnNkjv: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets—Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,
verses.textEnNlt: Then came some priests who played trumpets, including Zechariah son of Jonathan, son of Shemaiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Micaiah, son of Zaccur, a descendant of Asaph.
verses.textEnNasb: and some of the sons of the priests with trumpets; and Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,
verses.textEn: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zakkur, the son of Asaph,

verses.textZh: 他的兄弟示玛雅、亚撒利、米拉莱、基拉莱、玛艾、拿坦业、犹大、哈拿尼拿着神人大卫的乐器。经学家以斯拉走在他们前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的兄弟示玛雅、亚撒利、米拉莱、基拉莱、玛艾、拿坦业、犹大、哈拿尼拿着神人大卫的乐器。经学家以斯拉走在他们前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二队称谢的人要与那一队相迎而行。我和民的一半跟随他们，在城墙上过了炉楼，直到宽墙；
verses.textEnNiv: and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani—with musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the teacher of the Law led the procession.
verses.textEnEsv: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God. And Ezra the scribe went before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and his brethren, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God. Ezra the scribe went before them.
verses.textEnNlt: And Zechariah’s colleagues were Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They used the musical instruments prescribed by David, the man of God. Ezra the scribe led this procession.
verses.textEnNasb: and his kinsmen, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God. And Ezra the scribe went before them.
verses.textEn: and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani—with musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the teacher of the Law led the procession.

verses.textZh: 他们到了泉门，就登上大卫城的台阶，随着城墙的升势，经过大卫的宫殿，走到东边的水门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了泉门，就登上大卫城的台阶，随着城墙的升势，经过大卫的宫殿，走到东边的水门。
verses.textZhCuv: 又过了以法莲门、古门、鱼门、哈楠业楼、哈米亚楼，直到羊门，就在护卫门站住。
verses.textEnNiv: At the Fountain Gate they continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the site of David’s palace to the Water Gate on the east.
verses.textEnEsv: At the Fountain Gate they went up straight before them by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, to the Water Gate on the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the Fountain Gate, in front of them, they went up the stairs of the City of David, on the stairway of the wall, beyond the house of David, as far as the Water Gate eastward.
verses.textEnNlt: At the Fountain Gate they went straight up the steps on the ascent of the city wall toward the City of David. They passed the house of David and then proceeded to the Water Gate on the east.
verses.textEnNasb: At the Fountain Gate they went directly up the steps of the city of David by the stairway of the wall, above the house of David to the Water Gate on the east.
verses.textEn: At the Fountain Gate they continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the site of David’s palace to the Water Gate on the east.

verses.textZh: 第二队颂赞的人往左边行，我和一半的人民跟着他们，在城墙上过了炉楼，直走到宽墙，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二队颂赞的人往左边行，我和一半的人民跟着他们，在城墙上过了炉楼，直走到宽墙，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，这两队称谢的人连我和官长的一半，站在神的殿里。
verses.textEnNiv: The second choir proceeded in the opposite direction. I followed them on top of the wall, together with half the people—past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
verses.textEnEsv: The other choir of those who gave thanks went to the north, and I followed them with half of the people, on the wall, above the Tower of the Ovens, to the Broad Wall,
verses.textEnNkjv: The other thanksgiving choir went the opposite way, and I was behind them with half of the people on the wall, going past the Tower of the Ovens as far as the Broad Wall,
verses.textEnNlt: The second choir giving thanks went northward around the other way to meet them. I followed them, together with the other half of the people, along the top of the wall past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
verses.textEnNasb: The second choir proceeded to the left, while I followed them with half of the people on the wall, above the Tower of Furnaces, to the Broad Wall,
verses.textEn: The second choir proceeded in the opposite direction. I followed them on top of the wall, together with half the people—past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,

verses.textZh: 过了以法莲门、古门、鱼门、哈楠业楼、哈米亚楼，直到羊门，就在护卫院的门前站住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了以法莲门、古门、鱼门、哈楠业楼、哈米亚楼，直到羊门，就在护卫院的门前站住。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有祭司以利亚金、玛西雅、米拿民、米该雅、以利约乃、撒迦利亚、哈楠尼亚吹号；
verses.textEnNiv: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. At the Gate of the Guard they stopped.
verses.textEnEsv: and above the Gate of Ephraim, and by the Gate of Yeshanah, and by the Fish Gate and the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, to the Sheep Gate; and they came to a halt at the Gate of the Guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: and above the Gate of Ephraim, above the Old Gate, above the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate; and they stopped by the Gate of the Prison.
verses.textEnNlt: then past the Ephraim Gate to the Old City Gate, past the Fish Gate and the Tower of Hananel, and on to the Tower of the Hundred. Then we continued on to the Sheep Gate and stopped at the Guard Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: and above the Gate of Ephraim, by the Ancient Gate, by the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate; and they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
verses.textEn: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. At the Gate of the Guard they stopped.

verses.textZh: 于是这两队颂赞的人就站在神的殿里，我和一半的官长也站在那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是这两队颂赞的人就站在神的殿里，我和一半的官长也站在那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有玛西雅、示玛雅、以利亚撒、乌西、约哈难、玛基雅、以拦，和以谢奏乐。歌唱的就大声歌唱，伊斯拉希雅管理他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The two choirs that gave thanks then took their places in the house of God; so did I, together with half the officials,
verses.textEnEsv: So both choirs of those who gave thanks stood in the house of God, and I and half of the officials with me;
verses.textEnNkjv: So the two thanksgiving choirs stood in the house of God, likewise I and the half of the rulers with me;
verses.textEnNlt: The two choirs that were giving thanks then proceeded to the Temple of God, where they took their places. So did I, together with the group of leaders who were with me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the two choirs took their positions in the house of God. So did I and half of the officials with me;
verses.textEn: The two choirs that gave thanks then took their places in the house of God; so did I, together with half the officials,

verses.textZh: 祭司以利亚金、玛西雅、米拿尼、米该雅、以利约乃、撒迦利亚和哈楠尼亚，拿着号筒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司以利亚金、玛西雅、米拿尼、米该雅、以利约乃、撒迦利亚和哈楠尼亚，拿着号筒；
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，众人献大祭而欢乐；因为神使他们大大欢乐，连妇女带孩童也都欢乐，甚至耶路撒冷中的欢声听到远处。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as the priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah with their trumpets—
verses.textEnEsv: and the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.textEnNkjv: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Minjamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.textEnNlt: We went together with the trumpet-playing priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah—
verses.textEnNasb: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with the trumpets;
verses.textEn: as well as the priests—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah with their trumpets—

verses.textZh: 又有玛西雅、示玛雅、以利亚撒、乌西、约哈难、玛基雅、以拦和以谢；歌唱者在伊斯拉希雅领导下，高声歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有玛西雅、示玛雅、以利亚撒、乌西、约哈难、玛基雅、以拦和以谢；歌唱者在伊斯拉希雅领导下，高声歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，派人管理库房，将举祭、初熟之物和所取的十分之一，就是按各城田地，照律法所定归给祭司和利未人的分，都收在里头。犹大人因祭司和利未人供职，就欢乐了。
verses.textEnNiv: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam and Ezer. The choirs sang under the direction of Jezrahiah.
verses.textEnEsv: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang with Jezrahiah as their leader.
verses.textEnNkjv: also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loudly with Jezrahiah the director.
verses.textEnNlt: and the singers—Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam, and Ezer. They played and sang loudly under the direction of Jezrahiah the choir director.
verses.textEnNasb: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang, with Jezrahiah their leader,
verses.textEn: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam and Ezer. The choirs sang under the direction of Jezrahiah.

verses.textZh: 那一天，众人献上极大的祭祀，而且非常欢乐，因为神使他们大大欢乐；连妇女和孩童也都欢乐；耶路撒冷欢乐的声音在老远的地方都可以听见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，众人献上极大的祭祀，而且非常欢乐，因为神使他们大大欢乐；连妇女和孩童也都欢乐；耶路撒冷欢乐的声音在老远的地方都可以听见。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司利未人遵守神所吩咐的，并守洁净的礼。歌唱的、守门的，照着大卫和他儿子所罗门的命令也如此行。
verses.textEnNiv: And on that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The sound of rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard far away.
verses.textEnEsv: And they offered great sacrifices that day and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; the women and children also rejoiced. And the joy of Jerusalem was heard far away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard afar off.
verses.textEnNlt: Many sacrifices were offered on that joyous day, for God had given the people cause for great joy. The women and children also participated in the celebration, and the joy of the people of Jerusalem could be heard far away.
verses.textEnNasb: and on that day they offered great sacrifices and rejoiced because God had given them great joy, and the women and children rejoiced as well, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard from far away.
verses.textEn: And on that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The sound of rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard far away.

verses.textZh: 那时，有一些人被委派管理存放举祭、初熟之物和十分之一供物的库房，把各城的田地，照着律法所规定归给祭司和利未人的部分收集到那里。犹大人为侍立供职的祭司和利未人欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有一些人被委派管理存放举祭、初熟之物和十分之一供物的库房，把各城的田地，照着律法所规定归给祭司和利未人的部分收集到那里。犹大人为侍立供职的祭司和利未人欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 古时，在大卫和亚萨的日子，有歌唱的伶长，并有赞美称谢神的诗歌。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits and tithes. From the fields around the towns they were to bring into the storerooms the portions required by the Law for the priests and the Levites, for Judah was pleased with the ministering priests and Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day men were appointed over the storerooms, the contributions, the firstfruits, and the tithes, to gather into them the portions required by the Law for the priests and for the Levites according to the fields of the towns, for Judah rejoiced over the priests and the Levites who ministered.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at the same time some were appointed over the rooms of the storehouse for the offerings, the firstfruits, and the tithes, to gather into them from the fields of the cities the portions specified by the Law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced over the priests and Levites who ministered.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the offerings, the first part of the harvest, and the tithes. They were responsible to collect from the fields outside the towns the portions required by the Law for the priests and Levites. For all the people of Judah took joy in the priests and Levites and their work.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day men were also appointed over the chambers for the supplies, the contributions, the first fruits, and the tithes, to gather into them from the fields of the cities the portions required by the Law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced over the priests and the Levites who served.
verses.textEn: At that time men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits and tithes. From the fields around the towns they were to bring into the storerooms the portions required by the Law for the priests and the Levites, for Judah was pleased with the ministering priests and Levites.

verses.textZh: 祭司和利未人谨守他们的神所吩咐的，谨守洁净的礼；歌唱者和守门的也照着大卫和他的儿子所罗门的命令去行，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司和利未人谨守他们的神所吩咐的，谨守洁净的礼；歌唱者和守门的也照着大卫和他的儿子所罗门的命令去行，
verses.textZhCuv: 当所罗巴伯和尼希米的时候，以色列众人将歌唱的、守门的，每日所当得的分供给他们，又给利未人当得的分；利未人又给亚伦的子孙当得的分。
verses.textEnNiv: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did also the musicians and gatekeepers, according to the commands of David and his son Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the command of David and his son Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both the singers and the gatekeepers kept the charge of their God and the charge of the purification, according to the command of David and Solomon his son.
verses.textEnNlt: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as commanded by David and his son Solomon, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers.
verses.textEnNasb: For they performed the worship of their God and the service of purification, together with the singers and the gatekeepers in accordance with the command of David and of his son Solomon.
verses.textEn: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did also the musicians and gatekeepers, according to the commands of David and his son Solomon.

verses.textZh: 因为远在大卫和亚萨的时代，已有诗班长，并且有赞美称颂神的诗歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为远在大卫和亚萨的时代，已有诗班长，并且有赞美称颂神的诗歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为远在大卫和亚萨的时代，已有诗班长，并且有赞美称颂神的诗歌。
verses.textEnNiv: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors for the musicians and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEnEsv: For long ago in the days of David and Asaph there were directors of the singers, and there were songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in the days of David and Asaph of old therewere chiefs of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEnNlt: The custom of having choir directors to lead the choirs in hymns of praise and thanksgiving to God began long ago in the days of David and Asaph.
verses.textEnNasb: For in the days of David and Asaph, in ancient times, there were leaders of the singers, songs of praise and songs of thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEn: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors for the musicians and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

verses.textZh: 在所罗巴伯和尼希米的日子，以色列众人把歌唱的和守门的每日应得的分供给他们；又把分别为圣的分给利未人；而利未人也把分别为圣的分给亚伦的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在所罗巴伯和尼希米的日子，以色列众人把歌唱的和守门的每日应得的分供给他们；又把分别为圣的分给利未人；而利未人也把分别为圣的分给亚伦的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 在所罗巴伯和尼希米的日子，以色列众人把歌唱的和守门的每日应得的分供给他们；又把分别为圣的分给利未人；而利未人也把分别为圣的分给亚伦的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the musicians and the gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the other Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the daily portions for the singers and the gatekeepers; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah all Israel gave the portions for the singers and the gatekeepers, a portion for each day. They also consecrated holythings for the Levites, and the Levites consecrated them for the children of Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: So now, in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel brought a daily supply of food for the singers, the gatekeepers, and the Levites. The Levites, in turn, gave a portion of what they received to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: So all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah gave the portions due the singers and the gatekeepers as each day required, and they set apart the consecrated portion for the Levites, and the Levites set apart the consecrated portion for the sons of Aaron.
verses.textEn: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all Israel contributed the daily portions for the musicians and the gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the other Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the descendants of Aaron.

verses.textZh: 那时，他们宣读摩西的书给众民听，见书上写着说：亚扪人和摩押人永远不可进入神的会，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们宣读摩西的书给众民听，见书上写着说：亚扪人和摩押人永远不可进入神的会，
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，人念摩西的律法书给百姓听，遇见书上写着说，亚扪人和摩押人永不可入神的会；
verses.textEnNiv: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and there it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,
verses.textEnEsv: On that day they read from the Book of Moses in the hearing of the people. And in it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever enter the assembly of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day they read from the Book of Moses in the hearing of the people, and in it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever come into the assembly of God,
verses.textEnNlt: On that same day, as the Book of Moses was being read to the people, the passage was found that said no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be permitted to enter the assembly of God.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud as the people listened; and there was found written in it that no Ammonite or Moabite was ever to enter the assembly of God,
verses.textEn: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and there it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,

verses.textZh: 因为他们没有拿食物和水来迎接以色列人，反而雇用了巴兰来与他们作对，咒诅他们；但是我的神使咒诅变为祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们没有拿食物和水来迎接以色列人，反而雇用了巴兰来与他们作对，咒诅他们；但是我的神使咒诅变为祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们没有拿食物和水来迎接以色列人，且雇了巴兰咒诅他们，但我们的神使那咒诅变为祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: because they had not met the Israelites with food and water but had hired Balaam to call a curse down on them. (Our God, however, turned the curse into a blessing.)
verses.textEnEsv: for they did not meet the people of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them—yet our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they had not met the children of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.textEnNlt: For they had not provided the Israelites with food and water in the wilderness. Instead, they hired Balaam to curse them, though our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: because they did not meet the sons of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.textEn: because they had not met the Israelites with food and water but had hired Balaam to call a curse down on them. (Our God, however, turned the curse into a blessing.)

verses.textZh: 众民听见了这律法，就跟一切闲杂人分离。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民听见了这律法，就跟一切闲杂人分离。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列民听见这律法，就与一切闲杂人绝交。
verses.textEnNiv: When the people heard this law, they excluded from Israel all who were of foreign descent.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as the people heard the law, they separated from Israel all those of foreign descent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when they had heard the Law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When this passage of the Law was read, all those of foreign descent were immediately excluded from the assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: So when they heard the Law, they excluded all foreigners from Israel.
verses.textEn: When the people heard this law, they excluded from Israel all who were of foreign descent.

verses.textZh: 这事以前，受委派管理我们神殿的库房的以利亚实祭司，与多比雅的关系很密切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以前，受委派管理我们神殿的库房的以利亚实祭司，与多比雅的关系很密切。
verses.textZhCuv: 先是蒙派管理我们神殿中库房的祭司以利亚实与多比雅结亲，
verses.textEnNiv: Before this, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God. He was closely associated with Tobiah,
verses.textEnEsv: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the chambers of the house of our God, and who was related to Tobiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, having authority over the storerooms of the house of our God, was allied with Tobiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Before this had happened, Eliashib the priest, who had been appointed as supervisor of the storerooms of the Temple of our God and who was also a relative of Tobiah,
verses.textEnNasb: Now prior to this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the chambers of the house of our God, being related to Tobiah,
verses.textEn: Before this, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God. He was closely associated with Tobiah,

verses.textZh: 他为多比雅预备了一间大房间，那里以前是用来收存素祭、乳香和器皿，还有祭司的举祭，以及按照命令供给利未人、歌唱者和守门的那些五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为多比雅预备了一间大房间，那里以前是用来收存素祭、乳香和器皿，还有祭司的举祭，以及按照命令供给利未人、歌唱者和守门的那些五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 便为他预备一间大屋子，就是从前收存素祭、乳香、器皿，和照命令供给利未人、歌唱的、守门的五谷、新酒，和油的十分之一，并归祭司举祭的屋子。
verses.textEnNiv: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil prescribed for the Levites, musicians and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.
verses.textEnEsv: prepared for Tobiah a large chamber where they had previously put the grain offering, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of grain, wine, and oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, singers, and gatekeepers, and the contributions for the priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he had prepared for him a large room, where previously they had stored the grain offerings, the frankincense, the articles, the tithes of grain, the new wine and oil, which were commanded tobegiven to the Levites and singers and gatekeepers, and the offerings for the priests.
verses.textEnNlt: had converted a large storage room and placed it at Tobiah’s disposal. The room had previously been used for storing the grain offerings, the frankincense, various articles for the Temple, and the tithes of grain, new wine, and olive oil (which were prescribed for the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers), as well as the offerings for the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: had prepared a large room for him, where previously they used to put the grain offerings, the frankincense, the utensils and the tithes of grain, wine, and oil prescribed for the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the contributions for the priests.
verses.textEn: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil prescribed for the Levites, musicians and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.

verses.textZh: 这事发生的时候，我不在耶路撒冷；因为在巴比伦王亚达薛西三十二年，我回到王那里去；过了一段时期，我又向王告了假，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事发生的时候，我不在耶路撒冷；因为在巴比伦王亚达薛西三十二年，我回到王那里去；过了一段时期，我又向王告了假，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我不在耶路撒冷；因为巴比伦王亚达薛西三十二年，我回到王那里。过了多日，我向王告假。
verses.textEnNiv: But while all this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Some time later I asked his permission
verses.textEnEsv: While this was taking place, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king. And after some time I asked leave of the king
verses.textEnNkjv: But during all this I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Then after certain days I obtained leave from the king,
verses.textEnNlt: I was not in Jerusalem at that time, for I had returned to King Artaxerxes of Babylon in the thirty-second year of his reign, though I later asked his permission to return.
verses.textEnNasb: But during all this time I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had come to the king. After some time, however, I requested a leave of absence from the king,
verses.textEn: But while all this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Some time later I asked his permission

verses.textZh: 回到耶路撒冷，那时我才知道以利亚实在神殿的院子里，为多比雅预备一间房间那件恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 回到耶路撒冷，那时我才知道以利亚实在神殿的院子里，为多比雅预备一间房间那件恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我来到耶路撒冷，就知道以利亚实为多比雅在神殿的院内预备屋子的那件恶事。
verses.textEnNiv: and came back to Jerusalem. Here I learned about the evil thing Eliashib had done in providing Tobiah a room in the courts of the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: and came to Jerusalem, and I then discovered the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, preparing for him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I came to Jerusalem and discovered the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing a room for him in the courts of the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: When I arrived back in Jerusalem, I learned about Eliashib’s evil deed in providing Tobiah with a room in the courtyards of the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and I came to Jerusalem and learned about the evil that Eliashib had committed for Tobiah, by preparing a room for him in the courtyards of the house of God.
verses.textEn: and came back to Jerusalem. Here I learned about the evil thing Eliashib had done in providing Tobiah a room in the courts of the house of God.

verses.textZh: 我十分恼怒，就把多比雅的一切家具，都从房间里拋出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我十分恼怒，就把多比雅的一切家具，都从房间里拋出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我甚恼怒，就把多比雅的一切家具从屋里都抛出去，
verses.textEnNiv: I was greatly displeased and threw all Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.
verses.textEnEsv: And I was very angry, and I threw all the household furniture of Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it grieved me bitterly; therefore I threw all the household goods of Tobiah out of the room.
verses.textEnNlt: I became very upset and threw all of Tobiah’s belongings out of the room.
verses.textEnNasb: It was very displeasing to me, so I threw all of Tobiah’s household articles out of the room.
verses.textEn: I was greatly displeased and threw all Tobiah’s household goods out of the room.

verses.textZh: 又吩咐人洁净那几间房间，然后把神殿的器皿，与素祭和乳香搬回那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又吩咐人洁净那几间房间，然后把神殿的器皿，与素祭和乳香搬回那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐人洁净这屋子，遂将神殿的器皿和素祭、乳香又搬进去。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave orders to purify the rooms, and then I put back into them the equipment of the house of God, with the grain offerings and the incense.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I gave orders, and they cleansed the chambers, and I brought back there the vessels of the house of God, with the grain offering and the frankincense.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I commanded them to cleanse the rooms; and I brought back into them the articles of the house of God, with the grain offering and the frankincense.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I demanded that the rooms be purified, and I brought back the articles for God’s Temple, the grain offerings, and the frankincense.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I gave an order, and they cleansed the rooms; and I returned the utensils of the house of God there with the grain offering and the frankincense.
verses.textEn: I gave orders to purify the rooms, and then I put back into them the equipment of the house of God, with the grain offerings and the incense.

verses.textZh: 我发觉利未人应得的分，没有人供给他们，甚至供职的利未人和歌唱者，各人都跑回自己的田地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我发觉利未人应得的分，没有人供给他们，甚至供职的利未人和歌唱者，各人都跑回自己的田地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见利未人所当得的分无人供给他们，甚至供职的利未人与歌唱的俱各奔回自己的田地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: I also learned that the portions assigned to the Levites had not been given to them, and that all the Levites and musicians responsible for the service had gone back to their own fields.
verses.textEnEsv: I also found out that the portions of the Levites had not been given to them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had fled each to his field.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also realized that the portions for the Levites had not been given them; for each of the Levites and the singers who did the work had gone back to his field.
verses.textEnNlt: I also discovered that the Levites had not been given their prescribed portions of food, so they and the singers who were to conduct the worship services had all returned to work their fields.
verses.textEnNasb: I also discovered that the portions of the Levites had not been given to them, so the Levites and the singers who performed the service had gone away, each to his own field.
verses.textEn: I also learned that the portions assigned to the Levites had not been given to them, and that all the Levites and musicians responsible for the service had gone back to their own fields.

verses.textZh: 于是我责备众官长说："为甚么疏忽供应神的殿呢？"我就再召集利未人，使他们重站原来的岗位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我责备众官长说："为甚么疏忽供应神的殿呢？"我就再召集利未人，使他们重站原来的岗位。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就斥责官长说：「为何离弃神的殿呢？」我便招聚利未人，使他们照旧供职。
verses.textEnNiv: So I rebuked the officials and asked them, "Why is the house of God neglected?" Then I called them together and stationed them at their posts.
verses.textEnEsv: So I confronted the officials and said, "Why is the house of God forsaken?" And I gathered them together and set them in their stations.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I contended with the rulers, and said, "Why is the house of God forsaken?" And I gathered them together and set them in their place.
verses.textEnNlt: I immediately confronted the leaders and demanded, "Why has the Temple of God been neglected?" Then I called all the Levites back again and restored them to their proper duties.
verses.textEnNasb: So I reprimanded the officials and said, "Why has the house of God been neglected?" Then I gathered them together and stationed them at their posts.
verses.textEn: So I rebuked the officials and asked them, "Why is the house of God neglected?" Then I called them together and stationed them at their posts.

verses.textZh: 犹大众人就把五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一，奉到库房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大众人就把五谷、新酒和新油的十分之一，奉到库房。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大众人就把五谷、新酒，和油的十分之一送入库房。
verses.textEnNiv: All Judah brought the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil into the storerooms.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, wine, and oil into the storehouses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil to the storehouse.
verses.textEnNlt: And once more all the people of Judah began bringing their tithes of grain, new wine, and olive oil to the Temple storerooms.
verses.textEnNasb: All Judah then brought the tithe of the grain, wine, and oil into the storehouses.
verses.textEn: All Judah brought the tithes of grain, new wine and olive oil into the storerooms.

verses.textZh: 我委派示利米雅祭司、经学家撒督和利未人毘大雅作库官，管理库房；他们的助手是玛他尼的孙子、撒刻的儿子哈难；这些人都是忠信可靠的；他们的责任是把人奉献的各物分给他们的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我委派示利米雅祭司、经学家撒督和利未人毘大雅作库官，管理库房；他们的助手是玛他尼的孙子、撒刻的儿子哈难；这些人都是忠信可靠的；他们的责任是把人奉献的各物分给他们的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 我派祭司示利米雅、文士撒督，和利未人毗大雅作库官管理库房；副官是哈难。哈难是撒刻的儿子；撒刻是玛他尼的儿子。这些人都是忠信的，他们的职分是将所供给的分给他们的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: I put Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and a Levite named Pedaiah in charge of the storerooms and made Hanan son of Zakkur, the son of Mattaniah, their assistant, because they were considered trustworthy. They were made responsible for distributing the supplies to their fellow Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: And I appointed as treasurers over the storehouses Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah of the Levites, and as their assistant Hanan the son of Zaccur, son of Mattaniah, for they were considered reliable, and their duty was to distribute to their brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I appointed as treasurers over the storehouse Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah; and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were considered faithful, and their task was to distribute to their brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: I assigned supervisors for the storerooms: Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah, one of the Levites. And I appointed Hanan son of Zaccur and grandson of Mattaniah as their assistant. These men had an excellent reputation, and it was their job to make honest distributions to their fellow Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: To be in charge of the storehouses, I appointed Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah from the Levites, and in addition to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were considered reliable, and it was their task to distribute to their kinsmen.
verses.textEn: I put Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and a Levite named Pedaiah in charge of the storerooms and made Hanan son of Zakkur, the son of Mattaniah, their assistant, because they were considered trustworthy. They were made responsible for distributing the supplies to their fellow Levites.

verses.textZh: "我的神啊，求你因这事记念我，不要涂抹我为我神的殿和一切敬拜的礼仪所行的忠诚的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的神啊，求你因这事记念我，不要涂抹我为我神的殿和一切敬拜的礼仪所行的忠诚的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你因这事记念我，不要涂抹我为神的殿与其中的礼节所行的善。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember me for this, my God, and do not blot out what I have so faithfully done for the house of my God and its services.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and do not wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God and for his service.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and do not wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its services!
verses.textEnNlt: Remember this good deed, O my God, and do not forget all that I have faithfully done for the Temple of my God and its services.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember me for this, my God, and do not wipe out my loyal deeds which I have performed for the house of my God and its services.
verses.textEn: Remember me for this, my God, and do not blot out what I have so faithfully done for the house of my God and its services.

verses.textZh: 那时，我在犹大看见有人在安息日踹压酒池，搬运禾捆，驮在驴上，又把酒、葡萄、无花果和各样的担子，在安息日运到耶路撒冷；我就在他们卖粮食的那天警戒他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我在犹大看见有人在安息日踹压酒池，搬运禾捆，驮在驴上，又把酒、葡萄、无花果和各样的担子，在安息日运到耶路撒冷；我就在他们卖粮食的那天警戒他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些日子，我在犹大见有人在安息日榨酒 ，搬运禾捆驮在驴上，又把酒、葡萄、无花果，和各样的担子在安息日担入耶路撒冷，我就在他们卖食物的那日警戒他们。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, together with wine, grapes, figs and all other kinds of loads. And they were bringing all this into Jerusalem on the Sabbath. Therefore I warned them against selling food on that day.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days I saw in Judah people treading winepresses on the Sabbath, and bringing in heaps of grain and loading them on donkeys, and also wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of loads, which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. And I warned them on the day when they sold food.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days I saw people in Judah treading wine presses on the Sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kindsof burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. And I warned them about the day on which they were selling provisions.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days I saw men of Judah treading out their winepresses on the Sabbath. They were also bringing in grain, loading it on donkeys, and bringing their wine, grapes, figs, and all sorts of produce to Jerusalem to sell on the Sabbath. So I rebuked them for selling their produce on that day.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days I saw in Judah people who were treading wine presses on the Sabbath, and bringing in sacks of grain and loading them on donkeys, as well as wine, grapes, figs, and every kind of load, and they were bringing them into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. So I admonished them on the day they sold food.
verses.textEn: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, together with wine, grapes, figs and all other kinds of loads. And they were bringing all this into Jerusalem on the Sabbath. Therefore I warned them against selling food on that day.

verses.textZh: 又有推罗人住在耶路撒冷城中，他们把鱼和各样的货物运进来，在安息日卖给犹大人，而且在耶路撒冷贩卖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有推罗人住在耶路撒冷城中，他们把鱼和各样的货物运进来，在安息日卖给犹大人，而且在耶路撒冷贩卖。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有泰尔人住在耶路撒冷；他们把鱼和各样货物运进来，在安息日卖给犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: People from Tyre who lived in Jerusalem were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them in Jerusalem on the Sabbath to the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Tyrians also, who lived in the city, brought in fish and all kinds of goods and sold them on the Sabbath to the people of Judah, in Jerusalem itself!
verses.textEnNkjv: Men of Tyre dwelt there also, who brought in fish and all kinds of goods, and sold them on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Some men from Tyre, who lived in Jerusalem, were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise. They were selling it on the Sabbath to the people of Judah—and in Jerusalem at that!
verses.textEnNasb: Also people of Tyre were living there who imported fish and all kinds of merchandise, and sold them to the sons of Judah on the Sabbath, even in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: People from Tyre who lived in Jerusalem were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them in Jerusalem on the Sabbath to the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 于是我责备犹大的贵族，对他们说："你们怎么行这恶事，亵渎安息日呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我责备犹大的贵族，对他们说："你们怎么行这恶事，亵渎安息日呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我就斥责犹大的贵胄说：「你们怎么行这恶事犯了安息日呢？
verses.textEnNiv: I rebuked the nobles of Judah and said to them, "What is this wicked thing you are doing—desecrating the Sabbath day?
verses.textEnEsv: Then I confronted the nobles of Judah and said to them, "What is this evil thing that you are doing, profaning the Sabbath day?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, "What evil thing is this that you do, by which you profane the Sabbath day?
verses.textEnNlt: So I confronted the nobles of Judah. "Why are you profaning the Sabbath in this evil way?" I asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I reprimanded the nobles of Judah and said to them, "What is this evil thing that you are doing, by profaning the Sabbath day?
verses.textEn: I rebuked the nobles of Judah and said to them, "What is this wicked thing you are doing—desecrating the Sabbath day?

verses.textZh: 从前你们的列祖不是这样行，以致我们的神使这一切灾祸临到我们和这城吗？现在你们亵渎安息日，使神的忿怒越发临到以色列。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前你们的列祖不是这样行，以致我们的神使这一切灾祸临到我们和这城吗？现在你们亵渎安息日，使神的忿怒越发临到以色列。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前你们列祖岂不是这样行，以致我们神使一切灾祸临到我们和这城吗？现在你们还犯安息日，使忿怒越发临到以色列！」
verses.textEnNiv: Didn’t your ancestors do the same things, so that our God brought all this calamity on us and on this city? Now you are stirring up more wrath against Israel by desecrating the Sabbath."
verses.textEnEsv: Did not your fathers act in this way, and did not our God bring all this disaster on us and on this city? Now you are bringing more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: Did not your fathers do thus, and did not our God bring all this disaster on us and on this city? Yet you bring added wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNlt: "Wasn’t it just this sort of thing that your ancestors did that caused our God to bring all this trouble upon us and our city? Now you are bringing even more wrath upon Israel by permitting the Sabbath to be desecrated in this way!"
verses.textEnNasb: Did your fathers not do the same, so that our God brought on us and on this city all this trouble? Yet you are adding to the wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath."
verses.textEn: Didn’t your ancestors do the same things, so that our God brought all this calamity on us and on this city? Now you are stirring up more wrath against Israel by desecrating the Sabbath."

verses.textZh: 所以在安息日的前一天，黄昏的阴影临到耶路撒冷城门的时候，我就吩咐人把城门关闭；我又下令不许开门，直到安息日过了，我又派我的仆人在城门站岗，免得有人在安息日挑担子进来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以在安息日的前一天，黄昏的阴影临到耶路撒冷城门的时候，我就吩咐人把城门关闭；我又下令不许开门，直到安息日过了，我又派我的仆人在城门站岗，免得有人在安息日挑担子进来。
verses.textZhCuv: 在安息日的前一日，耶路撒冷城门有黑影的时候，我就吩咐人将门关锁，不过安息日不准开放。我又派我几个仆人管理城门，免得有人在安息日担什么担子进城。
verses.textEnNiv: When evening shadows fell on the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered the doors to be shut and not opened until the Sabbath was over. I stationed some of my own men at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as it began to grow dark at the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut and gave orders that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. And I stationed some of my servants at the gates, that no load might be brought in on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, at the gates of Jerusalem, as it began to be dark before the Sabbath, that I commanded the gates to be shut, and charged that they must not be opened till after the Sabbath. Then I posted some of my servants at the gates, sothat no burdens would be brought in on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I commanded that the gates of Jerusalem should be shut as darkness fell every Friday evening, not to be opened until the Sabbath ended. I sent some of my own servants to guard the gates so that no merchandise could be brought in on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about that just as it became dark at the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered that the doors be shut, and that they were not to open them until after the Sabbath. Then I stationed some of my servants at the gates so that no load would enter on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEn: When evening shadows fell on the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered the doors to be shut and not opened until the Sabbath was over. I stationed some of my own men at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.

verses.textZh: 于是商人和贩卖各样货物的，一次两次在耶路撒冷城外过夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是商人和贩卖各样货物的，一次两次在耶路撒冷城外过夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是商人和贩卖各样货物的，一两次住宿在耶路撒冷城外。
verses.textEnNiv: Once or twice the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods spent the night outside Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares lodged outside Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares lodged outside Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.textEnNlt: The merchants and tradesmen with a variety of wares camped outside Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.textEnNasb: Once or twice the traders and merchants of every kind of merchandise spent the night outside Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Once or twice the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods spent the night outside Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 我警告他们，对他们说："你们为甚么要在城墙前面过夜呢？如果你们再这样，我就要动手对付你们。"从那时起，他们在安息日就不敢再来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我警告他们，对他们说："你们为甚么要在城墙前面过夜呢？如果你们再这样，我就要动手对付你们。"从那时起，他们在安息日就不敢再来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就警戒他们说：「你们为何在城外住宿呢？若再这样，我必下手拿办你们。」从此以后，他们在安息日不再来了。
verses.textEnNiv: But I warned them and said, "Why do you spend the night by the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you." From that time on they no longer came on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: But I warned them and said to them, "Why do you lodge outside the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you." From that time on they did not come on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I warned them, and said to them, "Why do you spend the night around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you!" From that time on they came no more on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: But I spoke sharply to them and said, "What are you doing out here, camping around the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you!" And that was the last time they came on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I warned them and said to them, "Why do you spend the night in front of the wall? If you do so again, I will use force against you." From that time on they did not come on the Sabbath.
verses.textEn: But I warned them and said, "Why do you spend the night by the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you." From that time on they no longer came on the Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 我吩咐利未人洁净自己，然后来看守城门，使安息日分别为圣。"我的神啊，求你也因这事记念我，照着你丰盛的慈爱怜恤我！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我吩咐利未人洁净自己，然后来看守城门，使安息日分别为圣。"我的神啊，求你也因这事记念我，照着你丰盛的慈爱怜恤我！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我吩咐利未人洁净自己，来守城门，使安息日为圣。我的神啊，求你因这事记念我，照你的大慈爱怜恤我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and go and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, my God, and show mercy to me according to your great love.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves and come and guard the gates, to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember this also in my favor, O my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should go and guard the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of Your mercy!
verses.textEnNlt: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and to guard the gates in order to preserve the holiness of the Sabbath. Remember this good deed also, O my God! Have compassion on me according to your great and unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: And I ordered the Levites that they were to purify themselves and come as gatekeepers to sanctify the Sabbath day. For this also remember me, my God, and have compassion on me according to the greatness of Your mercy.
verses.textEn: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and go and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, my God, and show mercy to me according to your great love.

verses.textZh: 那些日子，我也发现有些犹大人娶了亚实突、亚扪和摩押的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些日子，我也发现有些犹大人娶了亚实突、亚扪和摩押的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些日子，我也见犹大人娶了亚实突、亚扪、摩押的女子为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, in those days I saw men of Judah who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon and Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days also I saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days I also saw Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: About the same time I realized that some of the men of Judah had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days I also saw that the Jews had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
verses.textEn: Moreover, in those days I saw men of Judah who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon and Moab.

verses.textZh: 他们的儿女有一半说亚实突话，其他就说他们民族的语言，他们却不会说犹大话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的儿女有一半说亚实突话，其他就说他们民族的语言，他们却不会说犹大话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的儿女说话，一半是亚实突的话，不会说犹大的话，所说的是照着各族的方言。
verses.textEnNiv: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and did not know how to speak the language of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod, and they could not speak the language of Judah, but only the language of each people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod, and could not speak the language of Judah, but spoke according to the language of one or the other people.
verses.textEnNlt: Furthermore, half their children spoke the language of Ashdod or of some other people and could not speak the language of Judah at all.
verses.textEnNasb: As for their children, half spoke in the language of Ashdod, and none of them knew how to speak the language of Judah, but only the language of his own people.
verses.textEn: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and did not know how to speak the language of Judah.

verses.textZh: 我就责备他们，咒诅他们，击打他们中间的几个人，拔下他们的头发，叫他们指着神起誓，说："你们决不可把自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，也决不可为儿子或为自己娶他们的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就责备他们，咒诅他们，击打他们中间的几个人，拔下他们的头发，叫他们指着神起誓，说："你们决不可把自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，也决不可为儿子或为自己娶他们的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就斥责他们，咒诅他们，打了他们几个人，拔下他们的头发，叫他们指着神起誓，必不将自己的女儿嫁给外邦人的儿子，也不为自己和儿子娶他们的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath in God’s name and said: "You are not to give your daughters in marriage to their sons, nor are you to take their daughters in marriage for your sons or for yourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: And I confronted them and cursed them and beat some of them and pulled out their hair. And I made them take an oath in the name of God, saying, "You shall not give your daughters to their sons, or take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I contended with them and cursed them, struck some of them and pulled out their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, "You shall not give your daughters as wives to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons or yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: So I confronted them and called down curses on them. I beat some of them and pulled out their hair. I made them swear in the name of God that they would not let their children intermarry with the pagan people of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So I quarreled with them and cursed them, and struck some of them and pulled out their hair, and made them swear by God, "You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take any of their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.
verses.textEn: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath in God’s name and said: "You are not to give your daughters in marriage to their sons, nor are you to take their daughters in marriage for your sons or for yourselves.

verses.textZh: 以色列王所罗门不是在这些事上犯了罪吗？在许多国中并没有一个王能比得上他的；他蒙他的神所爱，神立他作全以色列的王，可是连他也被外族的女子引诱犯罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王所罗门不是在这些事上犯了罪吗？在许多国中并没有一个王能比得上他的；他蒙他的神所爱，神立他作全以色列的王，可是连他也被外族的女子引诱犯罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又说：「以色列王所罗门不是在这样的事上犯罪吗？在多国中并没有一王像他，且蒙他神所爱，神立他作以色列全国的王；然而连他也被外邦女子引诱犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Was it not because of marriages like these that Solomon king of Israel sinned? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel, but even he was led into sin by foreign women.
verses.textEnEsv: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin on account of such women? Among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was beloved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless, foreign women made even him to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, who was beloved of his God; and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless pagan women caused even him to sin.
verses.textEnNlt: "Wasn’t this exactly what led King Solomon of Israel into sin?" I demanded. "There was no king from any nation who could compare to him, and God loved him and made him king over all Israel. But even he was led into sin by his foreign wives.
verses.textEnNasb: Did Solomon the king of Israel not sin regarding these things? Yet among the many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel; yet the foreign women caused even him to sin.
verses.textEn: Was it not because of marriages like these that Solomon king of Israel sinned? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel, but even he was led into sin by foreign women.

verses.textZh: 难道我们要听从你们，行这大恶，娶外族的女子为妻，对我们神不忠吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我们要听从你们，行这大恶，娶外族的女子为妻，对我们神不忠吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 如此，我岂听你们行这大恶，娶外邦女子干犯我们的神呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Must we hear now that you too are doing all this terrible wickedness and are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?"
verses.textEnEsv: Shall we then listen to you and do all this great evil and act treacherously against our God by marrying foreign women?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Should we then hear of your doing all this great evil, transgressing against our God by marrying pagan women?"
verses.textEnNlt: How could you even think of committing this sinful deed and acting unfaithfully toward God by marrying foreign women?"
verses.textEnNasb: Has it not then been reported about you that you have committed all this great evil by acting unfaithfully against our God, by marrying foreign women?"
verses.textEn: Must we hear now that you too are doing all this terrible wickedness and are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?"

verses.textZh: 大祭司以利亚实的孙子耶何耶大的一个儿子，是和伦人参巴拉的女婿，我就驱逐他离开我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司以利亚实的孙子耶何耶大的一个儿子，是和伦人参巴拉的女婿，我就驱逐他离开我。
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司以利亚实的孙子、耶何耶大的一个儿子是和伦人参巴拉的女婿，我就从我这里把他赶出去。
verses.textEnNiv: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. And I drove him away from me.
verses.textEnEsv: And one of the sons of Jehoiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was the son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite. Therefore I chased him from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was a son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I drove him from me.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest had married a daughter of Sanballat the Horonite, so I banished him from my presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Even one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, became a son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite, so I chased him away from me.
verses.textEn: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. And I drove him away from me.

verses.textZh: "我的神啊，求你记住他们，因为他们玷污了祭司的职分，也污辱了祭司职分和利未人的约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的神啊，求你记住他们，因为他们玷污了祭司的职分，也污辱了祭司职分和利未人的约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你记念他们的罪；因为他们玷污了祭司的职任，违背你与祭司利未人所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember them, my God, because they defiled the priestly office and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember them, O my God, because they have desecrated the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember them, O my God, for they have defiled the priesthood and the solemn vows of the priests and Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
verses.textEn: Remember them, my God, because they defiled the priestly office and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

verses.textZh: 这样，我就洁净了他们，使他们脱离一切外族人的污秽，又重新指派祭司和利未人的职责，各人有自己的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我就洁净了他们，使他们脱离一切外族人的污秽，又重新指派祭司和利未人的职责，各人有自己的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我洁净他们，使他们离绝一切外邦人，派定祭司和利未人的班次，使他们各尽其职。
verses.textEnNiv: So I purified the priests and the Levites of everything foreign, and assigned them duties, each to his own task.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus I cleansed them from everything foreign, and I established the duties of the priests and Levites, each in his work;
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I cleansed them of everything pagan. I also assigned duties to the priests and the Levites, each to his service,
verses.textEnNlt: So I purged out everything foreign and assigned tasks to the priests and Levites, making certain that each knew his work.
verses.textEnNasb: So I purified them from everything foreign, and assigned duties to the priests and the Levites, each in his work,
verses.textEn: So I purified the priests and the Levites of everything foreign, and assigned them duties, each to his own task.

verses.textZh: 我又指派人按时供应木柴和奉献初熟之物。"我的神啊，求你记念我，施恩给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又指派人按时供应木柴和奉献初熟之物。"我的神啊，求你记念我，施恩给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又派百姓按定期献柴和初熟的土产。我的神啊，求你记念我，施恩与我。
verses.textEnNiv: I also made provision for contributions of wood at designated times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me with favor, my God.
verses.textEnEsv: and I provided for the wood offering at appointed times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
verses.textEnNkjv: and tobringing the wood offering and the firstfruits at appointed times. Remember me, O my God, for good!
verses.textEnNlt: I also made sure that the supply of wood for the altar and the first portions of the harvest were brought at the proper times. Remember this in my favor, O my God.
verses.textEnNasb: and I arranged for the delivery of wood at appointed times and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.
verses.textEn: I also made provision for contributions of wood at designated times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me with favor, my God.
